paper.title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
paper.abstract: Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation.   We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend a

summary.core_problem: 生产级分页 Serving 引擎对 KV Cache 使用统一分页粒度，但多 Agent 负载中长共享前缀需要连续性、每请求后缀需要细粒度分配，两者需求相反。
summary.importance: 系统创新，首次将非对称分页粒度应用于生产级分页 Serving 引擎的 KV Cache，针对多 Agent 长共享前缀场景给出直接可用的吞吐优化。
summary.technical_approach: GraniKV 将共享前缀分配在连续 HOT 池、后缀分配在 token 级 COLD 池；配合 per-step dispatcher 在双后端间按 compute/memory/communication bound 选择后端。
summary.experiments: Lp=16K 共享 token 时，Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2、Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 上输出 token 吞吐分别达生产基线的 2.16×、1.98×、1.57×。

summary_en.core_problem: Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to KV cache, but multi-agent workloads have opposite storage needs: long shared prefixes demand contiguity while per-request suffixes demand fine-grained allocation.
summary_en.importance: Systems innovation; first work to apply asymmetric paging granularity to KV cache in a production paged-serving engine, yielding directly usable throughput gains for multi-agent long-shared-prefix scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: GraniKV allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher that selects among dual backends based on compute/memory/communication boundedness.
summary_en.experiments: At Lp=16K shared tokens, achieves 2.16×, 1.98×, and 1.57× output-token throughput over production baseline on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, and Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 respectively.

recommendation.zh: 非对称分页粒度的洞察干净直接，多 Agent 长前缀场景下 2× 吞吐有实际部署价值；看 §3 设计和 §5 分解实验即可。
recommendation.en: The asymmetric granularity insight is clean and direct; 2× throughput for multi-agent long-prefix serving is deployable—read §3 design and §5 breakdown.

paper.title: S2-MoE: Enabling Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts on Edge Devices
paper.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for inference on edge devices is challenging due to severe memory and bandwidth constraints. While speculative decoding and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have been proposed to improve inference efficiency, naively combining them often incurs excessive verification overhead and poor expert reuse, limiting their effectiveness in memory-bound edge settings. In this work, we propose S2-MoE, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for MoE inference on edge d

summary.core_problem: 在边缘设备上部署 MoE LLM 时，朴素自推测解码会产生过高验证开销并导致专家复用不足。
summary.importance: 工程型推理优化工作，针对 MoE 路由结构改造自推测解码，并在 llama.cpp 中落地。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 S2-MoE：路由感知的自适应推测扩展减少冗余验证，复用感知的专家门控提高验证效率，并通过共享上下文对齐 draft 与 target 执行。
summary.experiments: 在多种 MoE 模型和数据集上，相比标准自回归解码最高加速 5.3 倍，平均约 2.0 倍；实现基于 llama.cpp。

summary_en.core_problem: Naive self-speculative decoding for MoE LLMs on edge devices incurs high verification overhead and poor expert reuse under memory and bandwidth constraints.
summary_en.importance: An engineering-oriented inference-optimization system that adapts self-speculative decoding to MoE routing and integrates it into llama.cpp.
summary_en.technical_approach: S2-MoE uses routing-aware adaptive speculative expansion, reuse-aware expert gating, and shared context to align draft and target execution.
summary_en.experiments: Across MoE models and datasets on edge devices, it reports up to 5.3x speedup and about 2.0x average speedup over standard autoregressive decoding in a llama.cpp implementation.

recommendation.zh: 边缘 MoE 推理的工程组合优化，看摘要和加速表即可；对预训练侧无直接启发，做端侧部署可参考专家复用设计。
recommendation.en: An engineering combo for edge MoE inference; read the abstract and speedup tables. Useful for deployment, but no direct pretraining insight.

paper.title: Dual-Flow Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
paper.abstract: As large language models serve more requests, cumulative inference cost is becoming increasingly important relative to one-time training cost. The two inference phases stress hardware differently: prompt prefill is parallel and typically compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and often memory-bandwidth-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling increases both costs together because every added layer is evaluated in both phases. We ask whether additional learned computation ca

summary.core_problem: LLM推理的prefill（并行处理prompt，受计算吞吐量约束）和decode（逐token生成，受内存带宽约束）两个阶段硬件瓶颈差异显著。传统的宽度/深度缩放会同步提升两个阶段的成本，现有测试时计算缩放方法（如思维链、暂停token）要么增加序列长度开销，要么需要修改持久化状态，无法在保持标准prefill主路径和KV cache结构不变的前提下独立扩展decode侧的计算量。
summary.importance: 为推理侧计算缩放提供了新的架构路径，对预训练研究的具体启发包括：1）共享权重的主辅流设计可在不改变基础模型prefill路径和KV cache接口的前提下，通过decode侧额外计算提升预测质量，为部署感知的架构设计提供参考；2）MoE模型中主辅流独立配置专家激活数的思路，让同一预训练模型可适配不同prefill/decode负载的部署场景；3）混合似然训练目标为多路径模型的监督信号设计提供了可复用的方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双流Transformer架构，采用非对称的共享KV设计：主路径是完整的标准因果Transformer，独立处理全量prompt，产生唯一的持久化KV cache，不依赖辅助流；辅助流仅读取主路径的状态和KV cache，不写入持久状态，也不反馈到主路径。两个流共享所有注意力、MLP、输出矩阵，仅使用独立的token embedding和轻量可学习耦合向量。辅助流不参与全prompt的prefill计算，仅在最后一个prompt token位置和后续每个生成token位置执行，因此prefill阶段的计算量和KV cache大小与标准Transformer基本一致。训练时采用两个流next-token分布的混合似然作为监督信号。针对MoE模型，辅助流复用主路径选中的专家并使用自身的混合权重，主辅流的专家激活数可独立配置，形成prefill成本、decode成本、预测质量的三方权衡空间。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类设置：NanoGPT受控数据缩放、LLaMA风格稠密模型尺寸缩放、稀疏MoE基础配置。在相同训练token预算下，双流Transformer持续降低验证集损失；消融实验验证了跨流耦合和混合输出头的独立贡献。MoE变体的实验验证了两种配置模式：固定prefill计算量时增加decode计算可提升性能，固定decode计算量时可在两阶段间重分配计算以适配不同负载，均符合预期的成本-性能权衡规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注架构设计中主辅流的解耦机制、共享KV的实现逻辑、MoE场景下的专家分配方案，以及消融实验结果。可跳过底层实现细节。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM inference has two phases with distinct hardware bottlenecks: prompt prefill processes all tokens in parallel and is compute-throughput bound, while autoregressive decode generates tokens sequentially and is memory-bandwidth bound due to repeated weight and KV cache reads. Conventional width or depth scaling raises costs for both phases proportionally. Existing test-time compute scaling methods (e.g. chain-of-thought, pause tokens) either add sequence length overhead or require modified persistent state, and cannot independently scale decode-side computation while preserving the standard prefill path and KV cache structure.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a new architectural path for test-time compute scaling, with concrete implications for pretraining research: first, the shared-weight primary/auxiliary flow design provides a reference for deployment-aware architecture design, as it improves prediction quality via extra decode compute without changing the base model's prefill path or KV cache interface. Second, independent expert fan-out configuration for primary and auxiliary flows in MoE models allows a single pretrained checkpoint to adapt to deployment workloads with different prefill/decode ratios. Third, the mixture likelihood training objective is a reusable design for supervising multi-path models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-Flow Transformer uses an asymmetric shared-KV design. The primary flow is a full standard causal Transformer that processes the entire prompt independently and produces the only persistent KV cache, with no dependency on the auxiliary flow. The auxiliary flow only reads the primary flow's states and KV cache, never writes persistent state, and never feeds back into the primary flow. The two flows share all attention, MLP, and output matrices, with only separate token embeddings and lightweight learned coupling vectors. The auxiliary flow is not evaluated across the full prompt during prefill — it only runs at the final prompt token position and each subsequent generated token, so prefill compute cost and KV cache size are nearly identical to a standard Transformer. Training uses a mixture likelihood over the two flows' next-token distributions as the supervision signal. For MoE variants, the auxiliary flow reuses the primary flow's selected experts with its own mixture weights, and the expert fan-outs of the two flows can be configured independently to create a three-way trade-off between prefill cost, decode cost, and prediction quality.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover three settings: controlled NanoGPT data scaling, dense LLaMA-style model size scaling, and sparse MoE base configurations. Under matched training token budgets, Dual-Flow consistently reduces validation loss. Ablation studies isolate the individual contributions of cross-flow coupling and the mixture readout head. For MoE variants, experiments verify two allocation regimes: increasing decode compute while holding prefill compute fixed improves performance, and reallocating compute between the two phases while holding decode compute fixed adapts to different workloads, both matching the expected cost-performance trade-off.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the architecture section (focus on primary/auxiliary flow decoupling, shared KV mechanism), the MoE expert allocation design, and ablation experiment results. Skip low-level implementation details. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这个想法值得看，因为它直接挑战“模型容量必须同时付 prefill 税”的默认设计；先盯住质量-延迟曲线和 KV 状态是否真干净。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it challenges the default assumption that extra capacity must always pay the prefill tax; focus on the quality-latency tradeoff and whether the KV-state story is actually clean.

paper.title: ImpactHO: Importance-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Multi-User Edge LLM Handover
paper.abstract: Edge LLMs must preserve inference continuity when a user hands over between edge nodes, requiring key-value (KV) cache transfer to the target node. However, simultaneous handovers saturate the backhaul, preventing full cache delivery within the mobility-imposed transfer window. Rather than allocating bandwidth as if all cache entries were equally valuable, we order each user's KV cache by importance and transmit only its most informative fraction, turning token-level sparsity into communication

summary.core_problem: 解决边缘 LLM 服务中用户跨边缘节点切换时 KV cache 需要迁移、但多用户同时切换会让回传带宽不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理服务系统优化。它不是预训练方法，但对长上下文服务、KV cache 价值分布、部分 cache 保留后的精度退化建模有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 ImpactHO：先按重要性对每个用户的 KV cache entry 排序，只传输信息量最高的一部分；再把多用户 cache 迁移建模成回传带宽分配问题，以平均准确率最大化为目标。每个用户的 partial-cache accuracy 被拟合成 sigmoid utility，并利用重要性排序带来的前段高收益进行资源分配。
summary.experiments: 实验在 RULER benchmark 上测量不同模型和上下文长度下的部分 KV cache 精度曲线，sigmoid 拟合达到 R²>0.99。摘要称重要性排序让准确率曲线的凹区几乎覆盖整个 cache，使分配器能把用户保持在高边际收益区间；未给出具体 LLM 参数量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache transfer during edge-LLM handover, where simultaneous user mobility can exceed the available backhaul bandwidth.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-serving optimization. It does not change pretraining, but it is relevant to long-context serving, KV-cache value distribution, and accuracy degradation under partial cache retention.
summary_en.technical_approach: ImpactHO ranks each user's KV-cache entries by importance and transfers only the most informative fraction. It then formulates multi-user cache transfer as a backhaul allocation problem that maximizes average accuracy. Each user's partial-cache accuracy is modeled as a sigmoid utility curve, exploiting the high-value prefix created by importance ordering.
summary_en.experiments: The paper measures partial-cache accuracy on the RULER benchmark across models and context lengths, fitting the utility curves with R² above 0.99. The abstract claims importance ordering makes the concave region span nearly the whole cache, enabling the allocator to keep users in a high-marginal-gain region. Model sizes are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看 partial KV accuracy 的 sigmoid 拟合和排序策略；对训练无直接作用，但能补 KV cache 价值分布的直觉。
recommendation.en: Skim the sigmoid fit for partial-KV accuracy and the ranking policy; not a training paper, but useful intuition on KV-cache value distribution.

paper.title: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
paper.abstract: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) post-training pipelines for large language models (LLMs) increasingly combine rollout workloads across multiple domains and feedback paradigms. Prefix-aware routing improves inference efficiency through cache reuse and load balancing, but it does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity. When reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and agentic rollouts share an

summary.core_problem: RL 后训练中 RLVR、RLHF、agentic rollout 共享异步推理服务时，异构 workload 对 KV-cache 的竞争未被现有 prefix-aware 路由控制，且不能扭曲 trainer 指定的 workload 混合比例。
summary.importance: 系统工作：针对混合 RL rollout 场景的 KV-cache 调度，解决 prefix-aware 路由只关注 cache 复用和负载均衡、不处理异构 session 对 KV 容量竞争的问题。
summary.technical_approach: MISA-T 是路由层的准入策略，结合三部分：自适应 session 准入、workload 感知的 KV 容量分配、驻留时间感知的 KV 计费。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或 baseline 对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Zetao Hong、Song Yuan、Yuanhao Ding、Yibo Zhu、Daxin Jiang、Zhibin Wang、Chen Tian；机构未在摘要中明确。

summary_en.core_problem: When RLVR, RLHF, and agentic rollouts share an asynchronous inference service, existing prefix-aware routing does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity, and must not distort the workload mixture specified by the trainer.
summary_en.importance: System work on KV-cache scheduling for mixed RL rollout serving, addressing the gap that prefix-aware routing only optimizes cache reuse and load balancing without handling KV-capacity competition across heterogeneous sessions.
summary_en.technical_approach: MISA-T is a routing-layer admission policy combining adaptive session admission, workload-aware KV-capacity allocation, and residency-time-aware KV accounting.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental results or baselines are provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Zetao Hong, Song Yuan, Yuanhao Ding, Yibo Zhu, Daxin Jiang, Zhibin Wang, Chen Tian; institution not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 RL 后训练 serving 的人可看，核心是 KV-cache 按 workload 异构性分配容量；对纯预训练研究员参考价值有限。
recommendation.en: Useful for RL post-training serving teams; the core idea is workload-aware KV-cache allocation. Limited direct value for pure pretraining researchers.

paper.title: LibraSpec: Dynamic Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding via Marginal-Gain-Driven Optimization
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens for parallel verification, with efficiency critically determined by the speculative length selected at each decoding round. Existing dynamic speculation methods select the speculation length by estimating how many tokens will be accepted, which is reasonable for autoregressive drafters that generates tokens sequentially. The recent wave of diffusion-based drafters, however, generates candidate blocks in p

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion-based speculative decoding 里的动态投机长度选择问题。已有方法通常预测“会接受多少 token”，这适合自回归 draft model，因为草稿 token 也是顺序生成的；但 diffusion drafter 可以低成本并行生成一个候选块，真正昂贵的是把多少候选 token 送给 target model 验证。因此问题从 accepted length prediction 变成了 expected speedup optimization。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型推理系统有明确参考价值。它抓住了 diffusion drafter 与 AR drafter 的成本结构差异：draft 成本下降后，验证成本和早拒绝造成的无效计算成为主要约束。这个视角对研究非 AR 语言模型如何嵌入现有 LLM serving pipeline 有启发，尤其是 diffusion LM 作为辅助模型，而不是直接替代主模型的路径。
summary.technical_approach: LibraSpec 把每轮 speculative length 的选择写成期望加速比优化。核心不是先估计最终能接受多少 token，而是判断“再多验证一段候选 token 是否能带来足够的边际收益”。论文定义了 acceptance gain 与 verification cost 的比值，推导出 beneficial adjustment 的必要充分条件，并证明在其速度模型下，expected speedup 关于 speculative length 呈单峰结构。基于这个性质，算法可以从当前长度出发迭代做有益调整，有限步收敛到全局最优长度区间。实现上不训练额外 predictor，而是直接使用 diffusion drafter 输出的 confidence score 来近似验证前不可得的接受概率，因此可以插到现有 diffusion speculative decoding 方法中。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个 LLM、3 种 diffusion-based speculative decoding 方法，并在数学推理、代码生成、聊天任务上测试，同时包含 greedy decoding 和 sampling setting。主要结果是 LibraSpec 相比原有 diffusion speculative decoding 进一步提升端到端加速比约 0.5 到 1.5 倍；相对普通自回归解码最高达到 8.49 倍加速。论文还用 oracle exhaustive search 的最优长度作参照，显示 LibraSpec 能较好跟踪每个 decoding round 的最优投机长度变化。关键消融点在于：仅预测接受长度不足以最大化速度，因为 diffusion drafter 的候选生成成本已不是主要瓶颈；直接使用边际收益准则能更好处理“高接受概率但验证收益不够”的候选后缀。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 AR drafter 和 diffusion drafter 成本结构差异的分析，再看 Methodology 里 expected speedup、beneficial adjustment、单峰性证明和迭代长度选择算法。实验部分主要看 oracle length 对比图、不同任务和不同 decoding setting 下的端到端 speedup。若关注 serving，可以深挖它的成本模型假设：target verification latency 是否线性随长度增长、batching 和 KV-cache 行为是否会改变边际准则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies dynamic speculative-length selection for diffusion-based speculative decoding. Prior dynamic methods usually estimate how many drafted tokens will be accepted, which matches autoregressive drafters because drafting itself is sequential. With diffusion drafters, candidate blocks are generated in parallel at much lower cost, so the main decision becomes how many already-generated candidates are worth verifying with the target model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on inference rather than pretraining, but it is relevant for base-model researchers tracking non-AR language models. It clarifies a practical role for diffusion LMs: they may serve as efficient block drafters inside an AR target model pipeline. The useful point is the changed cost structure. Once drafting becomes cheap, verification cost and wasted suffix computation after early rejection dominate the length-selection problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: LibraSpec formulates length selection as expected-speedup optimization instead of accepted-length prediction. The method evaluates whether extending the speculative prefix improves the ratio between acceptance gain and verification cost. The paper derives necessary and sufficient conditions for a beneficial length adjustment and proves that, under its speed model, expected speedup is unimodal with respect to the speculative length. This allows iterative local adjustments to monotonically improve speedup and converge in finite steps to a globally optimal length interval. In implementation, LibraSpec is training-free. It uses confidence scores from the diffusion drafter as proxies for acceptance-related quantities that are unavailable before verification, and can be plugged into existing diffusion speculative decoding systems.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses six LLMs and three diffusion-based speculative decoding methods, covering math reasoning, code generation, and chat benchmarks under both greedy and sampling settings. LibraSpec improves end-to-end speedup over the underlying diffusion speculative decoding methods by about 0.5x to 1.5x, and reaches up to 8.49x speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding. The paper also compares against an oracle length obtained by exhaustive search and shows that LibraSpec closely tracks the round-wise optimal length. The key experimental message is that accepted-length estimation alone is not enough: a likely accepted suffix can still be a poor choice if its marginal verification cost is too high.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s distinction between AR and diffusion drafter cost structures, then read the methodology around expected speedup, beneficial adjustment, unimodality, and the iterative length-selection rule. In the experiments, look for the oracle-length comparison and end-to-end speedup tables across tasks and decoding modes. For serving work, the most important part to inspect is the latency model: assumptions about verification cost, sequence length scaling, batching, and KV-cache behavior determine how portable the marginal criterion is.

recommendation.zh: 只看边际收益推导和成本模型；若验证开销建模干净，可直接迁移到内部推测解码 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the marginal-gain derivation and cost model; if verification cost is measured cleanly, it is directly reusable for internal speculative-decoding ablations.

paper.title: Tied Trit-Planes: Constraining PTQTP to a Uniform Nine-Level Quantizer, with a Persistent Folded Format for Disk-Streamed Mixture-of-Experts Serving
paper.abstract: PTQTP decomposes LLM weight matrices into two ternary (trit) planes with two free per-group scales. Tying the scales to a fixed ratio of three collapses the decomposition into a single uniform nine-level quantizer, a known balanced-ternary identity. To our knowledge, at the time of writing, this work is the first to impose that identity as a constraint inside PTQTP's solver. The two trit planes then fold losslessly into one 4-bit code plane that we make the persistent serving representation: dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但很现实的 serving 问题：超大 MoE 模型在消费级硬件上部署时，专家参数远大于内存，必须从 SSD 流式读取；这时吞吐主要受“每个 token 需要搬多少字节”控制，而质量则受量化误差控制。作者关心的核心不是再发明一种抽象量化理论，而是：能否把 PTQTP 这种双 ternary-plane 的后训练量化，约束成一个统一的 9-level 量化器，从而把专家权重永久存成单一 4-bit 代码格式，做到磁盘、缓存、kernel 输入三处字节完全一致，避免任何转码，同时把质量损失控制在可接受范围内。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接价值有限，它更偏推理系统与量化部署；但对大规模 MoE 的研究工程仍有现实启发。第一，它说明在 MoE serving 场景里，量化格式设计不能只看 perplexity，还要看 persistent format、I/O 路径和 kernel 兼容性，尤其是专家从 NVMe 流式加载时，格式是否需要中间转码会直接影响端到端延迟。第二，它给出一个明确取舍：把 PTQTP 的自由双尺度约束成 ratio-3 tied scales，会损失一部分重构自由度，但换来统一 9-level code 和更干净的系统实现。这个取舍对未来做 MoE-friendly quantization 或训练时感知部署格式的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 PTQTP 的两层 ternary 分解
W≈α1T1+α2T2，约束为 α=(3s,s)。这样组合码 c=3t1+t2，t1,t2∈{-1,0,1}，自然落在一个均匀间隔的 9-level 网格上。原本 PTQTP 每个 group 有两个自由 scale，可以拟合更灵活的非均匀九级量化；作者这里主动放弃这部分自由度，换来一个单尺度、均匀九级的表示。由于 9 个有效值可以塞进 4 bit code，两个 ternary plane 就能无损折叠成一个 4-bit composite code plane。

真正有意思的是系统落地。作者不是只在论文里说“可以 pack 成 int4”，而是把这种 folded 4-bit code 直接作为 persistent serving representation：磁盘上的专家文件、内存中的 expert cache、以及 CPU-SIMD kernel 的输入，三者使用同一份字节布局，不做 transcode。文中实现了名为 tq2_0_fx4 的 block format：每个 block 覆盖四列乘 256 个元素，总大小 520 bytes，对应 4.0625 bits/weight。这样做的系统收益是，expert projection miss 时只需要一次连续读取，NVMe 分层缓存也能按 block 粒度直接条带化热点前缀，而不是先读压缩格式再转成另一种 kernel-friendly 格式。

质量评估上，作者没有只报 perplexity，而是强调与官方 serving API 的 step-level reference fidelity。具体做法是用 greedy decoding，在捕获的 fixtures 上比较 decoded-text prefix agreement，而不是 token id 完全一致；同时设置一个“expert-lossless serving arm”作为经验控制组，即把官方发布的 MXFP4 专家字节重打包但不再量化，用来锚定误差主要来自专家量化而不是其他系统因素。作者还提到 process isolation protocol，因为他们测到 fixture 级别存在不稳定性。这些细节说明工作重点是部署可用性，而不是离线量化指标。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验围绕一个 284B-A13B 的生产级 MoE 模型展开，专家部分参数量极大，作者给出的 serving 文件中约 145 GiB 是 q4_k 级别的专家 payload，总 serving 文件约 153.3 GiB，trunk 和 embedding 约 8 GiB。量化对象是官方发布 checkpoint 的专家权重；作者特别说明该 post-trained artifact 公开可得的是 MXFP4 专家，而不是更高精度版本，因此评测是围绕真实可部署工件进行的。

实验比较的重点不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是三条轴：重构/困惑度、与官方 API 的输出一致性、以及实际 serving 速度。作者明确指出一个核心经验结论：这些轴并不总是一致。也就是说，perplexity 更好不一定意味着 step-level reference fidelity 更高，后者更高也不必然带来更好的下游问答分数。这一点对量化研究很重要，因为很多工作默认离线 perplexity 足够代表部署质量。

系统侧，作者声称 ratio-3 tied nine-level folded code 让 persistent bytes、cache bytes、kernel input bytes 完全一致，这正是速度结果成立的前提。文中还把它与 q4_k 等现有格式放在同一部署环境里比较，并使用 CPU-first、可选 Metal/CUDA GEMM offload 的开源栈 fucina 实现。虽然给出的节选里没有完整数值表，但从正文叙述可知，作者把“无转码 SSD 流式专家 serving”作为主要卖点，并用官方 API 对齐、MMLU 描述性比较和 perplexity 并列报告，强调质量判断不能只看单一指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着系统问题去读，而不是当成通用量化论文精读。先看 Introduction，抓住两个判断：一是作者的贡献很窄，主要是把 PTQTP 约束成 tied ratio-3 nine-level quantizer；二是他们真正关心的是 persistent format 与 serving path 的统一，而不是单纯压低 bit 数。

然后重点看方法部分里关于 balanced ternary identity、folded 4-bit code 和 tq2_0_fx4 block format 的定义。这里要想清楚：为什么自由双尺度 PTQTP 更灵活，但作者仍愿意加约束；以及为什么“磁盘字节=缓存字节=kernel 输入字节”在 SSD-streamed MoE 里比多一点离线重构精度更值钱。

实验部分建议优先看 reference fidelity protocol、expert-lossless control arm、以及速度测试设置。如果时间有限，30 分钟内可以只看：Introduction、格式定义图表、quality evaluation protocol、serving throughput 结果。需要保留的判断是：这不是通用 LLM 量化结论，而是一个面向超大 MoE 流式部署的格式-系统联合设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a very specific but practical serving problem: for very large MoE models on consumer hardware, routed experts dominate the parameter footprint, exceed RAM, and must be streamed from SSD. In that regime, throughput is governed by bytes moved per token, while quality is governed by quantization damage. The central question is whether PTQTP-style two-plane ternary post-training quantization can be constrained into a uniform 9-level quantizer so that expert weights can be stored persistently in a single folded 4-bit code format, reused unchanged on disk, in cache, and at kernel input, with no transcoding in the serving path and acceptable quality loss.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited; this is primarily an inference-systems and quantized-serving paper. Still, it is useful for anyone working on large MoE systems. First, it shows that in SSD-streamed MoE serving, quantization format design is not just about perplexity. Persistent representation, I/O path, cache layout, and kernel compatibility matter just as much. Second, it presents a clear engineering trade-off: tying PTQTP’s two scales to a fixed 3:1 ratio reduces reconstruction flexibility, but buys a uniform 9-level code and a much cleaner end-to-end serving stack. That trade-off is relevant for future MoE-aware quantization and for training-time methods that may want to target deployment-native formats.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is to start from PTQTP’s decomposition
W≈α1T1+α2T2 with Ti∈{-1,0,1}, and impose α=(3s,s). Under that constraint, the composite code c=3t1+t2 lands on a uniformly spaced 9-level grid with a single scale. Standard PTQTP allows two free per-group scales and therefore a more flexible non-uniform 9-level approximation. This paper deliberately gives up that flexibility in exchange for a simpler, deployment-friendly representation. Because there are only nine valid composite values, the two ternary planes can be folded losslessly into a single 4-bit code plane.

The more interesting part is the systems realization. The folded 4-bit code is not just an internal compute format; it becomes the persistent serving representation. Disk bytes, expert-cache bytes, and kernel input bytes are identical, so the system never transcodes expert weights between storage tiers. The implementation uses a block format called tq2_0_fx4: a 520-byte block covering four columns by 256 elements, corresponding to 4.0625 bits per weight. This matters because an expert miss can then be served by one contiguous read, and block-granular NVMe striping of hot expert prefixes becomes straightforward.

On the evaluation side, the paper does not rely on perplexity alone. It emphasizes step-level agreement with the official serving API using greedy decoding and decoded-text prefix agreement on captured fixtures rather than token-ID equality. It also introduces an expert-lossless control arm, where the released MXFP4 expert bytes are repacked without an additional quantization step, to anchor the claim that observed deficits are primarily due to expert quantization rather than unrelated system effects. The paper also mentions a process-isolation protocol motivated by measured fixture instability. Altogether, the work is much more about deployment fidelity than about abstract quantization theory.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are built around a production-scale 284B-A13B MoE model. The expert payload dominates the serving artifact: the paper cites roughly 145 GiB of q4_k-scale expert bytes inside a 153.3 GiB serving file, with only about 8 GiB for trunk and embeddings. The quantization target is the released checkpoint artifact, whose experts are available in MXFP4 rather than a higher-precision official release, so the study is grounded in a realistic deployment object rather than an idealized offline setting.

The main empirical comparison is along three axes: reconstruction/perplexity, agreement with the official API, and actual serving speed. One of the paper’s central observations is that these axes do not always agree. Better perplexity does not necessarily imply better step-level reference fidelity, and better reference fidelity does not automatically translate into better downstream benchmark behavior. That is an important point for quantization work, since many papers implicitly treat offline perplexity as a sufficient proxy for deployment quality.

On the systems side, the claimed speedups depend on the fact that the ratio-3 tied 9-level folded code is the persistent format itself, so persistent bytes, cache bytes, and kernel input bytes are identical. The implementation is done in the open-source fucina stack, which is CPU-first with optional Metal/CUDA GEMM offload. The excerpt provided here does not include the full result tables, but the paper clearly frames no-transcode SSD-streamed expert serving as the main practical gain, and reports official-API alignment, descriptive MMLU comparison, and perplexity side by side to argue against single-metric evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a format-and-serving co-design paper, not as a general quantization paper. Start with the Introduction and isolate two points: the contribution is intentionally narrow, and the real target is not merely lower bitwidth but a deployment-native persistent format for SSD-streamed MoE experts.

Then focus on the method section that defines the balanced-ternary identity, the folded 4-bit composite code, and the tq2_0_fx4 block format. The key question is why one would accept the loss of PTQTP’s free two-scale flexibility. The answer is in the serving path: if disk bytes, cache bytes, and kernel input bytes are identical, the system avoids transcoding and simplifies expert streaming substantially.

In the experiments, prioritize the reference-fidelity protocol, the expert-lossless control arm, and the throughput setup. If time is limited, a 30-minute skim should cover: Introduction, the format-definition figures/tables, the quality-evaluation protocol, and the serving-throughput section. The main takeaway to retain is that this is not a broad claim about LLM quantization; it is a targeted design for very large MoE deployment where storage format and runtime path are inseparable.

recommendation.zh: 做 MoE serving 的可以看：重点不是量化精度，而是“持久化格式=缓存=kernel 输入”这个系统取舍；只读格式设计和 kernel 路径，别把它当通用 PTQ 结论。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you care about MoE serving: the real idea is format unification across disk/cache/kernel, not a broadly convincing PTQ accuracy result.

paper.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
paper.abstract: A main promise of looped language models (LMs) is depth-adaptive inference. By iterating a block of shared layers a variable number of times, the model can use less compute for "easy" tokens and more for "hard" ones. However, this adaptivity breaks standard batching: tokens in the same batch now require a different number of loops, so there is no unified forward pass, making efficient inference difficult. Standard inference frameworks like vLLM schedule on the token level and cannot handle this

summary.core_problem: 循环语言模型的深度自适应推理机制会为“简单”token分配更少的循环核迭代次数、为“困难”token分配更多迭代，从而实现更优的计算-精度权衡，但这种自适应特性会破坏标准batching流水线。vLLM等框架使用的token级调度器无法处理同一前向传播内不同token的循环次数差异，而模型中的非循环边界层（embedding、LM head、非共享层）又进一步增加了调度复杂度。此前的循环级调度方案缺少端到端实现，导致自适应循环LM的实际效率收益无法落地。
summary.importance: 连续深度batching方案移除了深度自适应循环LM部署的核心系统瓶颈，将可变深度计算的理论算力节省转化为可实测的端到端吞吐、延迟收益。方案中明确的自适应计算架构与推理调度器的协同设计约束，对其他early exit、可变深度Transformer变体的落地也有通用参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 连续深度batching（CDB）以单次循环迭代为调度粒度，在前向传播内部将token路由到不同的模型计算阶段。方案提供两种执行模式：1）无填充（no-refill）模式：随着token完成循环退出，循环批次逐步缩小，所有退出的token等待整批循环完成后再统一执行coda阶段，实现复杂度最低；2）填充（refill）模式：通过优先级队列独立调度prelude、循环核、coda三个阶段，将边界层计算与循环步交错执行，循环层空出的计算槽位直接填入新token，最大化吞吐。方案设计了适配的KV cache布局，处理不同深度退出的token留下的cache空洞；引入提前一步的前瞻门（lookahead gate）做退出决策，将批次准备操作与GPU执行重叠，隐藏调度开销。此外，方案推导了自适应深度推理基于FLOPs的加速上界，通过硬件感知的roofline模型明确了填充模式能带来净收益的batch size区间。
summary.experiments: 在Ouro 1.4B、Huginn 3.5B两个循环LM上的测试显示，CDB可达到理论最大加速比的99%，对应离线吞吐提升1.5-1.9倍，在线服务场景下归一化延迟降低45%-90%。消融实验量化了边界层计算占比、循环次数分布、batch size对实际收益的影响：大batch size下填充模式收益最高，小batch size下无填充模式的调度开销更低。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读掌握核心思路即可。重点关注循环LM做batching的核心痛点拆解、两种CDB模式的设计权衡、roofline分析中架构参数（边界层占比、平均循环次数）和实际加速比的对应关系。如果不直接做自适应模型服务相关的系统工作，可以跳过底层系统实现细节。预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Depth-adaptive inference for looped language models allocates fewer recurrent core iterations to "easy" tokens and more to "hard" tokens, delivering improved compute-accuracy tradeoffs, but breaks standard batching pipelines. Token-level schedulers used in frameworks like vLLM cannot handle per-token variable loop counts within a single forward pass, and non-recurrent boundary stages (token embedding, LM head, unshared layers) add further scheduling complexity. Prior loop-level scheduling proposals lacked end-to-end implementations, leaving the practical efficiency gains of adaptive looped LMs unrealized.
summary_en.importance: Continuous Depth Batching removes the core systems bottleneck for deploying depth-adaptive looped LMs, translating theoretical compute savings from variable-depth computation into measurable end-to-end throughput and latency improvements. The work identifies concrete co-design constraints between adaptive compute architectures and inference schedulers, with insights generalizable to other early-exit and variable-depth Transformer variants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Continuous Depth Batching (CDB) schedules computation at the granularity of individual loop iterations, routing tokens between model stages within a forward pass. Two execution modes are provided: (1) No-refill mode shrinks the recurrent batch as tokens exit the loop, and runs the coda stage for all exited tokens only after the full batch completes looping, for minimal implementation complexity; (2) Refill mode uses a priority queue to schedule prelude, recurrent core, and coda stages independently, interleaving boundary stage computation with loop steps and filling freed recurrent batch slots with new tokens to maximize throughput. A modified KV cache layout handles gaps left by tokens exiting at different depths, and a lookahead gate makes exit decisions one loop step in advance to overlap batch preparation with GPU execution and hide scheduling overhead. A FLOPs-based upper bound on adaptive depth speedup is derived, and a hardware-aware roofline model is used to identify batch size regimes where refill mode provides net performance benefit.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Ouro 1.4B and Huginn 3.5B looped LMs, CDB achieves up to 99% of the theoretical maximum speedup. This translates to 1.5–1.9× higher offline throughput, and 45–90% lower normalized latency in online serving settings. Ablations quantify how boundary stage cost, loop count distribution, and batch size affect realized gains: refill mode delivers the largest benefits at large batch sizes, while no-refill incurs lower overhead at small batch sizes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core ideas. Focus on the breakdown of batching pain points for looped LMs, the design tradeoffs between the two CDB modes, and the roofline analysis linking architecture parameters (boundary stage fraction, average loop count) to real-world speedup. Skip low-level systems implementation details unless working directly on adaptive model serving. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看调度抽象和边界层处理即可；若内部在试 looped/early-exit LM，这篇是 serving 侧必补的坑。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduling abstraction and boundary-stage handling; if you are testing looped or early-exit LMs, this is the serving pitfall to reproduce.

paper.title: RotaryQuant: Fitting 120B MoE Models on Consumer Hardware via Fused Compressed-Space Attention
paper.abstract: Large mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models with 26--120 billion parameters exceed the memory capacity of consumer devices through three simultaneous pressures: resident weight matrices, key-value (KV) cache state that grows linearly with context, and dozens of expert sublayers that must be paged on demand. We present RotaryQuant, a three-axis compression system that addresses all three. Mixed-precision weight quantization assigns bit-widths by architectural role: 4-bit for dense layers, 2-bi

summary.core_problem: 26B–120B MoE语言模型在消费级硬件上同时面临权重驻留、KV缓存随上下文线性增长、专家子层按需分页三重内存压力，如何三轴压缩使其可运行。
summary.importance: 工程系统创新，针对MoE serving的真实瓶颈给出按架构角色区分位宽的量化方案，并提出新的KV缓存压缩方法IsoQuant；对MoE部署与KV量化有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 三轴压缩：(1) 混合精度权重量化——dense层4-bit、routed experts 2-bit、shared expert因激活高峰度（kurtosis）抗压缩差而用8-bit；(2) LRU专家卸载到磁盘；(3) IsoQuant——先做Walsh-Hadamard变换再用块对角SO(4)旋转使激活分布各向同性，然后3-bit标量量化，每头仅存256个参数、O(d log d)开销。
summary.experiments: 面向26B–120B MoE模型在消费级硬件上的部署；摘要未给出与vLLM/同类量化方案的具体端到端吞吐与精度对比数字，需读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: How to fit 26B–120B MoE language models on consumer hardware under three simultaneous memory pressures: resident weights, linearly growing KV cache, and on-demand expert paging.
summary_en.importance: A systems contribution targeting real MoE serving bottlenecks, with role-aware mixed-precision quantization and a novel KV-cache compression scheme (IsoQuant); directly relevant to MoE deployment and KV quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-axis compression: (1) mixed-precision weight quantization—4-bit dense, 2-bit routed experts, and 8-bit for the shared expert whose high activation kurtosis resists aggressive quantization; (2) LRU expert offloading to disk; (3) IsoQuant—Walsh-Hadamard transform followed by block-diagonal SO(4) rotations to isotropize activations before 3-bit scalar quantization, with 256 stored parameters per head and O(d log d) cost.
summary_en.experiments: Targets 26B–120B MoE models on consumer hardware; the abstract gives no concrete end-to-end throughput/accuracy numbers against vLLM or comparable quantization methods, so the body must be checked.

recommendation.zh: MoE按角色分配位宽的观察（shared expert需8-bit、routed可2-bit）值得在内部量化ablation复现；IsoQuant的WHT+SO(4)各向同性化看§方法即可。
recommendation.en: The role-aware bit-width observation (8-bit shared expert, 2-bit routed) is worth reproducing in internal quantization ablations; read the IsoQuant WHT+SO(4) section for the KV trick.

paper.title: Tevatron-Elastic: A Unified Abstraction for Training Elastic Retrievers and Rerankers
paper.abstract: A single model scale challenges the flexibility of a production retrieval system: some settings need it faster, others need a smaller index, and the right trade-off changes with the workload. In the context of information retrieval (IR), a transformer-based model can be made smaller in three ways---using fewer layers, passing fewer tokens through the upper layers, or producing a shorter embedding---and each way saves a different compute resource. These options have been studied one at a time, ea

summary.core_problem: 生产检索系统需要在速度、索引大小和精度之间动态取舍，但现有 retriever/reranker 通常只能按单一模型尺寸部署。
summary.importance: 贡献是检索模型的弹性训练抽象和工程统一，覆盖层数、token 经过上层的数量、embedding 维度三种压缩轴；它对 LLM serving 和 RAG 系统有参考价值，但不是基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: Tevatron-Elastic 用一个统一的 size object 表示模型可运行的任意配置，并用短 schedule 指定训练时采样的配置集合。训练后得到一个 checkpoint，部署时可选择不同层深、token 路由深度或向量维度；同一抽象覆盖 retriever 与 reranker，也覆盖 encoder 与 decoder 模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 数值或提升幅度。实验重点应是比较单轴弹性方法与统一多轴弹性训练在检索质量、延迟、索引大小和算力占用上的折中。
summary.authors_note: Jimmy Lin 是信息检索和 Tevatron 系列工作的代表作者；Vivek Srikumar 长期从事 NLP 与结构化学习研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Production retrieval systems need runtime trade-offs among latency, index size, and accuracy, while most retrievers and rerankers are trained and deployed at a single fixed scale.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a unified abstraction for elastic training of retrieval models, spanning layer depth, token depth through upper layers, and embedding dimensionality. It is relevant to LLM serving and RAG infrastructure, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tevatron-Elastic represents any executable model size with a single size object and uses a compact schedule to specify which sizes are trained. One checkpoint can then serve multiple configurations at deployment, varying depth, token processing, or embedding dimension. The abstraction is designed to cover both retrievers and rerankers, and both encoder and decoder models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, datasets, baseline numbers, or gains. The expected experimental focus is the quality-latency-index-size trade-off compared with separately trained single-axis elastic approaches.
summary_en.authors_note: Jimmy Lin is a well-known information retrieval researcher and a key figure behind the Tevatron line of work; Vivek Srikumar is known for NLP and structured prediction research.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法抽象和资源分解即可；它不会改变预训练 recipe，但对 RAG 检索侧的弹性 serving 有实用参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the abstraction and resource decomposition; it will not change a pretraining recipe, but it is useful for elastic retrieval-side serving in RAG systems.

paper.title: Runtime Observability for Heterogeneous Attention Memory
paper.abstract: Modern models no longer keep a plain KV cache: latent caches, learned sparse selectors and recurrent states each carry the model's memory in a different form, and each fails differently under compression. We give a runtime observability contract that covers all four memory classes with three operators, instantiate it on six model configurations across five architecture families, and compose the per-stage bounds into an executable request-level risk ledger. Contracts carry their error metric as a

summary.core_problem: 现代推理系统中的注意力内存不再只是标准 dense KV cache，还包括 latent compressed cache、learned sparse selector、recurrent state 等多种异构形式；这些内存在压缩、选择、读取各环节都会以不同模式出错，而现有 serving 栈缺少一个统一、可组合、可在运行时执行的观测与误差上界框架，导致静默缓存损坏只能在下游任务退化后才被发现。
summary.importance: 论文针对的是推理可靠性中一个被低估的问题：新架构下 attention memory 的失败模式已经碎片化，传统“查 KV cache 是否一致”已经无法覆盖真实风险。对做长上下文、压缩缓存、稀疏注意力、recurrent/hybrid 架构部署的人，这类 runtime observability 思路直接相关；对预训练研究者的价值更偏间接，主要在于揭示架构设计与部署误差传播之间的接口，即模型内部状态在被压缩/筛选/复用后，哪些扰动会变成用户可见退化。
summary.technical_approach: 把任意注意力内存抽象成三个算子：update（写入/更新状态）、select（选择参与注意力的条目）、read（解码为 attention 使用的表示）。每个阶段给出局部误差契约 e_out ≤ a·e_in + b，失败概率 δ，并要求契约中的量必须能由 serving 栈在运行时真实计算，而不是依赖无法获得的未压缩参考。局部契约通过仿射组合和 union bound 串联成请求级风险账本。每个数值携带强度标签：certified（有可证明上界且未饱和）、partially certified（仅在可判定子集上成立）、empirical（仅观测、无界）。组合结果自动继承最弱一环的层级，避免把含经验环节的链路误报成端到端可证明。论文还显式区分不同误差 caliber（例如 ℓ2 聚合与 max 聚合），并指出不同度量之间不能随意拼接；早期版本正是因为把需要参考缓存的量当作运行时可观测量，被这套类型检查机制直接拒掉。
summary.experiments: 在五个架构族、共六个模型配置上实例化了该观测框架，覆盖 dense KV、latent cache、sparse selector、recurrent state 四类内存。论文报告了各阶段本地界、跨度量桥接、以及 always-on 探针在并发场景下的开销。作者公开了测量数学、接受门槛、复现实验产物、图表生成器与 Lean 形式化开发，强调所有数字可单命令重跑，且 claim guard 会在不匹配时失败构建。具体模型名和绝对性能数字在提供的正文中没有完整展开；实验重点是框架可实例化、可组合、以及能在真实链路里抓出契约设计错误，而非报新的精度或速度 SOTA。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看引言里那个 production incident 的动机，再看 §2 的三算子抽象和 certified/partially certified/empirical 三级标签设计，重点理解为什么“可运行时计算”和“度量类型匹配”比单纯的误差上界代数更重要。对局部契约细节，重点看 block pooling 和 selection stage 的推导，理解错误传播里哪些阶段放大噪声、哪些只加偏置。若不做 serving/形式化，可以跳过 Lean 和完整 proof 细节；若做压缩 KV、sparse memory、hybrid RNN-Transformer 部署，值得对照自己的内存路径画一遍 update/select/read 链。预计阅读时间 25–40 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 metask-ai，论文附 GitHub 仓库 witprobe-attention-memory；更细的作者背景未在提供内容中明确。

summary_en.core_problem: Attention memory in modern serving systems is no longer a plain dense KV cache. Latent compressed caches, learned sparse selectors, and recurrent states all carry model state in different forms and fail in different ways under compression, yet the serving stack lacks a unified, composable, runtime-checkable observability framework. As a result, silent memory corruption can pass through structurally valid caches and only become visible as downstream task degradation.
summary_en.importance: The paper addresses an underappreciated reliability problem that grows as models move beyond standard dense attention: heterogeneous attention memories have fragmented failure modes, and ad hoc checks no longer suffice. Its direct relevance is strongest for long-context, compressed-cache, sparse-attention, and recurrent/hybrid serving. For pretraining researchers, the main value is indirect but real: it makes explicit the interface between architecture design and deployment-time error propagation, showing exactly how compression, selection, and reuse of internal state can turn into user-visible quality loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: Any attention memory is decomposed into three operators: update, select, and read. Each stage exposes a local contract e_out ≤ a·e_in + b with failure budget δ, with the key requirement that a, b, and δ be computable from quantities actually available at runtime rather than from an uncompressed reference. Local contracts compose by affine composition plus a union bound into a request-level risk ledger. Every number is labeled by proof strength: certified if a sound upper bound exists and is not saturated, partially certified if the bound holds only on a decidable subset, and empirical if it is an observation without a bound. Composition inherits the weakest tier, so a chain with any empirical stage cannot be reported as end-to-end certified. The framework also enforces metric typing: contracts with different error calibers, such as ℓ2 versus max aggregation, do not compose unless an explicit bridge is provided. This check caught a real bug in an early version of the authors’ own chain.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is instantiated on six model configurations across five architecture families, covering dense KV caches, latent caches, learned sparse selectors, and recurrent states. The paper reports per-stage local bounds, cross-metric bridges, and the concurrency cost of always-on probes. The authors release the measurement mathematics, acceptance gates, frozen artifacts, figure/claim generators, and a Lean development under Apache-2.0, with all numbers reproducible from a single command and build-time guards that fail on mismatch. The provided text does not include full model names or absolute accuracy/speed tables; the main empirical claim is that the framework is practical to deploy across memory classes and can catch contract-design errors in live pipelines rather than merely presenting algebraic bounds.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Start with the production incident in the introduction, then focus on Section 2 for the three-operator abstraction and the certified/partially certified/empirical labeling. The key idea is not the algebra itself but the insistence that every term be runtime-computable and metric-consistent. For the local contracts, pay attention to the block-pooling and selection derivations because they show which stages attenuate or preserve upstream error versus injecting bias. Readers not working on serving or formal methods can skip the Lean details. Those working on compressed KV, sparse memory, or hybrid RNN-Transformer deployment may want to map their own memory path through update/select/read. Estimated reading time: 25–40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from metask-ai, with an associated GitHub repository witprobe-attention-memory. More detailed author backgrounds are not specified in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 把异构 memory 的压缩误差用 typed contract 串起来这个角度新颖，做 KV cache/混合架构 Serving 的读 §3 和实验里的 tier 降级表即可。
recommendation.en: The typed-contract angle on composing compression errors across heterogeneous memories is fresh; if you work on KV-cache or hybrid-arch serving, read §3 and the tier-downgrade tables.

paper.title: Elbow-Based MoE Routing: A Training-Free Inference Time Plugin for Expert Selection
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable model scaling while maintaining low inference-time compute by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, conventional routing relies on a fixed top-k selection, forcing the model to spend the same compute regardless of how many experts are relevant. We introduce elbow-based routing, a training-free inference-time modification that dynamically adjusts the number of experts on a per-token basis. Our method examines the sorted router probability d

summary.core_problem: MoE模型传统固定top-k路由机制不区分token的专家需求度——部分仅需少量专家的token浪费算力，而需要更多专家的token可能被分配不足；现有动态路由方案均需要重新训练或超参数搜索，成本高且无法直接复用已训练完成的MoE checkpoint。
summary.importance: 提出了首个无需训练、无需额外超参数的MoE动态路由插件，可直接部署于已训练完成的MoE模型，在不损失精度的前提下降低推理延迟，为MoE推理优化提供了轻量可落地的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 对每个token的路由概率做降序排序，使用Kneedle算法识别概率曲线的肘点（即快速衰减的头部过渡到平坦尾部的拐点），将肘点作为该token的动态激活专家数，上限为原模型的固定top-K值；该方法仅裁剪原top-K中的低概率专家，不改变专家排序或引入新路径，从信号-噪声分解角度解释：高概率头部对应与输入相关的信号专家，平坦尾部对应正交残差驱动的噪声专家，肘点即为二者的分界。
summary.experiments: 在OLMoE模型上测试，覆盖MMLU、ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande六个基准；分析超过200万条路由概率曲线，99.7%存在清晰的尖锐肘点，且肘点分布跨数据集、跨层、跨学科主题一致；随机替换肘点后的低概率专家不影响精度，替换肘点前的专家则精度显著下降；最终实现平均5.3%的推理延迟降低，同时保持精度与专家负载平衡。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节的肘点检测算法和信号-噪声解释，图2的尾部分布随机化实验和图3的肘点分布统计；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，适合快速了解MoE推理侧的无训练优化思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional fixed top-k routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models applies uniform expert allocation across all tokens, wasting compute on tokens that only need a small number of relevant experts while potentially under-provisioning tokens that require more. Existing dynamic routing methods all require retraining, auxiliary losses, or expensive hyperparameter grid search, limiting their deployability on finished pretrained MoE checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces the first training-free, hyperparameter-free dynamic routing plugin for MoE models that can be directly applied to existing checkpoints. It delivers measurable latency reduction without accuracy loss, providing a lightweight, production-ready path for MoE inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each token, router probabilities are sorted in descending order. A Kneedle-style algorithm detects the elbow point on the sorted probability curve — the inflection point where the rapidly decaying high-probability head transitions to a flat low-probability tail. The number of active experts for the token is set to the minimum of the elbow index and the model's original fixed top-K value. The method only prunes low-probability experts from the original top-K set, preserving expert ordering and introducing no new routing paths. A signal-noise decomposition framework explains the approach: high-probability head experts correspond to signal aligned with input-relevant routing directions, while flat tail experts reflect noise from orthogonal residual variation, with the elbow marking the boundary between the two.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on the OLMoE model across six benchmarks: MMLU, ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, PIQA, and WinoGrande. Analysis of over 2 million router probability curves shows 99.7% have clear, sharp elbows, with elbow distributions consistent across datasets, router layers, and MMLU subject categories. Randomly replacing post-elbow low-probability experts has no measurable impact on accuracy, while replacing pre-elbow experts causes significant accuracy drops. The method achieves an average 5.3% inference latency reduction while preserving full benchmark accuracy and expert load balance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the elbow detection algorithm and signal-noise interpretation, Figure 2 for the tail randomization validation experiment, and Figure 3 for elbow distribution statistics. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. It is suitable for a quick overview of training-free MoE inference optimization strategies.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由分布分析和 latency setup；5.3% 不大，但 training-free，值得放进 MoE serving 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the router-distribution analysis and latency setup; 5.3% is modest, but the training-free nature makes it worth a MoE serving ablation.

paper.title: Oilbird: Training-Free Speculative Decoding with Keys the Verifier Already Computes
paper.abstract: Training-free speculative decoding drafts by matching an exact suffix of the context against a pool of earlier context. That lookup misses correct drafts already in the pool, most visibly on tool-calling traffic, where a request repeats almost everything but the few values minted for it, and where one rejected token discards the correct continuation behind it. We diagnose the failure position by position across ten benchmarks and find it to be a problem of addressing rather than of coverage: on

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 training-free speculative decoding 中 exact-suffix copy drafter 的寻址失败问题：正确续写已经在历史请求池里，但由于上下文中出现新 token，纯文本后缀匹配无法找到它。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率论文，但对基座研究有两个启发。第一，服务流量中的重复性不只是文本重复，也包含状态相似性；模型 hidden state 可以作为更稳定的语义地址。第二，训练-free 加速方法不一定只能扩大检索池，也可以改进 key 的定义。它对预训练目标没有直接贡献，但对 KV-cache、服务侧冗余利用、agent/tool-calling 场景下的解码加速有清晰价值。
summary.technical_approach: Oilbird 保留现有 copy-based speculative decoding 的基本框架，但把历史 token 位置重新用 verifier 已经计算过的 hidden state 做 key。每次 verifier commit 一个 token 时，系统把该位置的 hidden state 和后续 continuation 存入池中；之后每个生成位置都用当前 hidden state 查询相似历史位置，拿到语义相近位置后的 token 作为 draft。关键点有两个。其一，查询是 per-position 的，而不是只在 request level 做一次，这能绕过局部新 token 造成的匹配断崖。其二，Oilbird 不是在 lexical source 和 semantic source 之间二选一，而是把多个来源的 continuation 合并进同一个 multi-source attention tree；只有分叉节点才增加成本，因此可以在不改变节点预算和验证规则的情况下提高 accepted length。贪心验证下输出保持 lossless，作者还用独立 greedy run 做 token-level audit。
summary.experiments: 论文先做了一个与具体 drafter 无关的诊断，覆盖十个 workload 和两个模型族。在 API-Bank 这个 tool-calling 密集 benchmark 上，92% 的位置其后续 token 已经存在于历史池中，但最强 exact-match oracle 仍错过 13% 的位置；其中约一半属于 identifiability gap，即续写存在但文本后缀 key 无法寻址，占生成位置的 6.8%。这些 gap 后面平均有 6.4 个可逐字匹配的 token。语义 hidden-state key 可以触达其中约五分之四。系统结果上，在 Llama-3.1-8B 的 API-Bank 上达到 4.4× autoregressive decoding speed。per-position 查询相比 faithful request-level 实现提升 36%。在三个已有 drafter 内加入该 semantic source，在相同 pool 和节点预算下 accepted length 增加 24–29%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 分钟。先看 The Identifiability Gap 和 Figure 1，理解 exact-suffix key 为什么会在新值 token 后失效。再看 Table 7，确认作者把 coverage failure 和 addressing failure 分开测量的方式。方法部分重点看 hidden-state key 如何记录、检索和并入 attention tree。Figure 4 和系统实验值得看，因为它说明 Oilbird 不是替换已有 drafter，而是作为额外 draft source 嵌入已有树结构。局限也要注意：收益主要来自高重复的服务流量，尤其是 tool-calling；对开放式长文本生成不应直接外推。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an addressing failure in training-free speculative decoding: the correct continuation is often already present in the history pool, but exact suffix matching cannot retrieve it once a newly minted token appears in the context.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, but it has useful implications for foundation-model serving research. It shows that redundancy in production traffic is not only lexical; similar model states can identify reusable continuations even when the local text suffix fails. The result suggests that training-free acceleration can improve by changing the retrieval key, not only by increasing the store size. The work is most relevant to KV-cache usage, traffic-level reuse, and tool-calling agent serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Oilbird keeps the standard copy-based speculative decoding setup and adds a semantic draft source. Each committed token is tagged with the hidden state that the verifier has already computed. Later, at every generation position, the current hidden state queries past positions in the same pool, and the retrieved neighbors provide candidate continuations. Two design choices matter. First, the query is performed per position rather than once per request, which lets the method recover after local novel tokens such as identifiers or names. Second, semantic continuations are merged into the same multi-source attention tree used by lexical drafters, instead of choosing one source over another. The tree pays extra only where continuations diverge, so the method can preserve the verifier cost, node budget, and acceptance rule. Under greedy verification, the output remains lossless, and the authors audit it token by token against an independent greedy run.
summary_en.experiments: The paper provides a method-independent diagnosis on ten workloads and two model families. On API-Bank, a dense tool-calling benchmark, 92% of positions have their next-token continuation already available in the history pool. Yet a strong exact-match oracle still misses 13% of positions; about half of these misses are present-but-unreachable cases, forming a 6.8% identifiability gap. Behind those gap positions, a neighbor contains an average 6.4-token verbatim run. The hidden-state key reaches roughly four out of five of these positions. In system results, Oilbird reaches 4.4× autoregressive decoding speed on API-Bank with Llama-3.1-8B. Per-position querying improves over a faithful request-level implementation by 36%. When inserted into three existing drafters with the same pool and node budget, it increases accepted length by 24–29%.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is appropriate. Read The Identifiability Gap and Figure 1 first; they explain why exact suffix matching fails after a novel value token. Table 7 is useful for checking how the paper separates coverage failures from addressing failures. Then read the hidden-state key construction and the merge procedure for the multi-source attention tree. Figure 4 and the system results are the most important empirical parts, because they show that Oilbird complements existing drafters rather than replacing them. The main caveat is workload dependence: the gains are strongest in highly repetitive serving traffic, especially tool-calling traces, and should not be assumed for open-ended generation.

recommendation.zh: 推理组应读失败诊断和 ablation；对 pretrain 的启发是 hidden-state locality 可被服务端复用。
recommendation.en: Inference teams should read the failure diagnosis and ablations; the pretraining-side lesson is reusable hidden-state locality.

paper.title: Approximate Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying a draft block with a target model in parallel. Under standard greedy verification, decoding stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, discarding the remaining target-scored suffix. Although accepting such a mismatch changes the decoding trajectory, it can make a contiguous suffix reusable when its tokens remain target-greedy under the realized prefix. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Approximate

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 speculative decoding 中 verifier 过于保守的问题：标准 greedy verification 一旦遇到 draft token 与 target argmax 不一致，就截断整个 block，即使这个 mismatch 的 target-logit regret 很小，且后续 token 在接受该 mismatch 后仍然会被 target 判为 greedy token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，主要价值在推理效率和 serving。它有一个清晰的提醒：很多解码加速方法把“保持目标模型轨迹不变”作为硬约束，而 ASD 选择显式放松这个约束，用可计量的局部 regret 换取吞吐。这个思路对基座研究也有参考意义，尤其是研究训练目标、解码目标和任务正确性之间并不完全等价时。论文也比较克制地说明，ASD 只控制累计 local regret，不保证输出一致、语义一致或任务正确。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 training-free verifier 改造，不训练 draft model，也不增加额外 target forward。标准 speculative decoding 对 draft block 做 teacher-forced target pass，得到每个位置的 target logits。严格 verifier 只接受从开头开始完全等于 target argmax 的最长前缀。ASD 把它改成 budgeted longest-prefix selection：遇到 mismatch 时，计算 local target-logit regret，即 target argmax 相对 draft token 的 logit 差；只有 regret 小于阈值、当前 block 的 exception 数不超过上限、整个 request 的累计 regret budget 仍可用，才允许接受这个 mismatch。关键细节是 realized-prefix suffix reuse：如果接受了早期 mismatch，那么后续 teacher-forced target row 已经是在包含该 mismatch 的 draft prefix 上计算的；因此后面连续等于 target argmax 的 draft token 可以直接提交，不需要重新跑 target。这个设计区别于简单放宽 token match 的方法，因为它不是逐 token 独立放行，而是维护 request-level ledger，防止长输出中小偏差不断累积。
summary.experiments: 实验主要报告固定 workload 下的吞吐收益和接受率变化。Qwen3-14B 作为 target、DSpark-14B 作为 draft，在 7 个任务上，ASD 相比匹配设置下的严格 speculative decoding，最高提升 15.26% fixed-workload throughput，平均提升 7.78%。在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 285B 与 DSpark 的设置中，论文还报告了 FP4-to-FP8 compatibility 下的接受率改进：GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上约有 10% 到 16% 的提升。消融重点不是模型训练，而是 verifier 策略：local regret threshold、block-level exception cap、request-level budget，以及可复用 suffix 的出现频率。论文也指出 opportunity rate 和最终 TPS 不是严格因果对应关系，因为系统吞吐还受 batch、cache、内存带宽和实现细节影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 first-mismatch truncation 的问题定义，以及 Approximate Speculative Decoding 一节中 local target-logit regret、request-level budget 和 suffix reuse 的形式化。图 1 和图 3 值得看：前者解释为什么接受一个 mismatch 后后缀可以复用，后者给出这种机会在不同任务和阈值下的经验分布。实验部分主要看固定 workload TPS，而不是只看 acceptance rate。需要特别留意论文的边界条件：ASD 是近似解码，不是 lossless serving 优化；如果部署在高精度数学、代码生成或安全敏感场景，需要额外验证任务级错误率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an overly strict verification rule in speculative decoding. Standard greedy verification stops at the first draft token that differs from the target argmax, even when the mismatch has very small target-logit regret and the following draft tokens would still be target-greedy under the prefix that includes the accepted mismatch.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is inference efficiency rather than pretraining. Its useful lesson is that exact target-trajectory preservation is only one operating point. ASD makes a controlled tradeoff: it spends a measured local-regret budget to gain more reusable target-scored tokens. This is also a useful framing for pretraining researchers studying the gap between token-level objectives, decoding trajectories, and task-level correctness. The paper is careful about the limitation: ASD bounds accumulated local regret, but it does not guarantee identical outputs, semantic preservation, or task correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASD is a training-free verifier-side modification. It uses the same teacher-forced target pass as standard speculative decoding. Instead of accepting only the longest prefix that exactly matches the target argmax, it selects the longest prefix subject to three constraints: a local target-logit regret threshold for mismatched tokens, a per-block cap on the number of accepted exceptions, and a persistent request-level regret budget. The central mechanism is realized-prefix suffix reuse. Once an early mismatch is accepted, later target rows in the teacher-forced pass are already conditioned on the draft prefix containing that mismatch. If subsequent draft tokens equal the corresponding target argmax under that realized prefix, they can be committed without another target forward pass. This differs from a naive relaxed matcher because deviations are explicitly accounted for over the whole request rather than reset at every block.
summary_en.experiments: The reported gains are throughput-oriented. With Qwen3-14B as the target and DSpark-14B as the draft model, ASD improves fixed-workload throughput over matched strict speculative decoding by up to 15.26%, with a 7.78% average gain across seven tasks. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash at 285B parameters and DSpark, the paper reports roughly 10% to 16% acceptance improvements on GSM8K and MATH-500 under FP4-to-FP8 compatibility. The ablations focus on verifier controls: regret threshold, block exception cap, request-level budget, and the empirical frequency of reusable suffixes. The paper also notes that opportunity rate does not directly determine TPS, since serving performance depends on batching, cache handling, memory bandwidth, and implementation details.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the Introduction for the precise failure mode of first-mismatch truncation. Then focus on the ASD formulation: local target-logit regret, budget accounting, and realized-prefix suffix reuse. Figure 1 is the key intuition for suffix reuse; Figure 3 is useful for understanding how often low-regret mismatches followed by greedy suffixes appear. In the experiments, prioritize fixed-workload TPS over raw acceptance rate. The main caveat is important: ASD is approximate decoding, not a lossless serving optimization, so task-level error should be checked before use in math, code, or safety-sensitive generation.

recommendation.zh: 训练免费的推测解码实用改进，无需改模型即可提升接受率，部署侧可直接接入验证，只看§3算法和核心ablation即可。
recommendation.en: A practical training-free tweak to speculative decoding that boosts acceptance rate without model changes; skip to §3 for the algorithm and core ablation results for deployment validation.

paper.title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse
paper.abstract: Production deployments often swap between different-sized models in a family for cost-quality cascading, mid-conversation switching, and routing, and each swap forces the receiver to repay the prefill from scratch. We propose cross-model KV cache transfer, where the receiver reuses the source's KV cache, skipping prefill. We find that cross-model KV has substantial linear structure across matched-KV pairs, where source and target share KV head count and per-head dimension. On Qwen3 14B->32B, one

summary.core_problem: 多模型级联和会话中途切换会反复支付长上下文 prefill 成本。论文研究的问题是：在同一模型家族内，能否把一个模型已经算好的 KV cache 线性映射成另一个模型可用的 KV cache，从而跳过接收模型的 prefill。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏推理系统的工作，但对大模型研究有两个有用信号。第一，同一家族不同尺度模型的 KV 表示存在可测的线性对应关系，这说明 family scaling 过程中保留了相当强的层间表示结构。第二，单纯的重构误差不足以预测可用性，误差落在哪些 attention-sensitive subspaces 更关键。这对蒸馏、模型族联合训练、跨尺度复用、speculative serving 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法限定在 matched-KV pair：源模型和目标模型拥有相同 KV head 数和相同 per-head 维度，但层数、hidden size、参数量可以不同。作者把跨模型 cache transfer 分解为每个 target layer、每个 head 的 key/value 映射。核心是闭式 ridge regression，不做梯度训练。每个目标层先选择最能预测它的 top-k 源层，再用这些源层的 KV 作为输入拟合目标 KV。对 key，作者在去 RoPE 的 content space 中拟合映射，再在使用时恢复位置旋转，这样可以降低对校准长度的依赖。论文还比较了非线性 MLP 扩展，发现它不一定显著降低总体误差，但能把残差从 attention 敏感方向移开，因此在困难模型对上更有效。
summary.experiments: 作者先验证线性结构。在 Qwen3 14B 到 32B 的迁移中，一个源层可以解释目标 keys 56% 的方差、values 32% 的方差；使用多个源层后提升到 keys 79%、values 65%。主实验覆盖三个模型家族的六个 matched-KV pair。在线性 mapper 的较好模型对上，五个 benchmark 的平均准确率可保留目标模型 standalone accuracy 的 73–98%。小到大迁移方向上，prefill latency 相比重新 prefill 降低约 2.7–25 倍。困难的 Ministral pair 上，非线性 MLP 可带来最高 +37 个百分点的 HellaSwag retention 提升。作者还报告，attention-output cosine 与 HellaSwag retention 的 Pearson r 为 +0.57，优于直接用 KV 重构 R^2 预测，后者相关性为 -0.20。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看第 2 节的 matched-KV 定义和线性可解释方差实验，这是论文成立的前提。第 3 节重点看三步 mapper：per-head ridge、top-k source-layer selection、RoPE-stripped content mapping。第 4.4 和 4.5 节值得看，尤其是 MLP 为什么能通过改变误差位置提升 retention，以及 attention-output cosine 为什么比 R^2 更能预测下游效果。系统读者可以再看第 4.7 节的 prefill latency 对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-running deployments often switch between models in the same family for routing, cost-quality cascading, or mid-conversation upgrades. Each switch normally requires the target model to recompute prefill over the accumulated context. The paper studies whether a source model’s KV cache can be mapped into the target model’s KV-cache space and reused directly.
summary_en.importance: The serving motivation is clear, but the more general signal is representational. KV states across different scales of the same model family contain substantial linear structure. This is relevant for model-family training, cross-scale distillation, cache reuse, and speculative serving. The paper also shows that reconstruction quality alone is a weak proxy: downstream retention depends on whether residual error lies in attention-sensitive directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method targets matched-KV pairs, where source and target share the number of KV heads and per-head KV dimension, while layer count and model size may differ. For each target layer and head, the mapper predicts target keys and values from selected source-layer caches. The main estimator is closed-form ridge regression, fitted from a small calibration set without gradient training. Two design choices matter: each target layer uses its top-k most predictive source layers, and key mapping is performed in RoPE-stripped content space so that positional rotation is separated from semantic content and the fitted map transfers better across context lengths. The paper also evaluates an MLP extension, mainly useful on harder pairs because it relocates residual error away from directions that strongly affect attention output.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3 14B to 32B, a single source layer explains 56% of target key variance and 32% of value variance; using multiple source layers raises this to 79% and 65%. Across six matched-KV pairs from three model families, the best linear-transfer pairs retain 73–98% of standalone target accuracy averaged over five benchmarks. In small-to-large transfer, prefill latency is reduced by about 2.7–25x compared with recomputing target prefill. On harder Ministral pairs, the nonlinear MLP improves HellaSwag retention by up to 37 percentage points. Across 12 pair evaluations, attention-output cosine correlates with HellaSwag retention at Pearson r=+0.57, while KV reconstruction R^2 correlates poorly at r=-0.20.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Start with the matched-KV setting and the variance-explained analysis, since these define when the method is plausible. Then read the mapper design: per-head ridge regression, source-layer selection, and RoPE-stripped key mapping. The most informative experimental sections are the MLP analysis and the comparison between attention-output cosine and R^2 as predictors of downstream retention. The latency section is useful if the target application is production serving.

recommendation.zh: 只看线性可解释方差和去 RoPE ridge mapper；若质量损失可控，serving 级联会少一次昂贵 prefill。
recommendation.en: Read the variance analysis and RoPE-stripped ridge mapper; if quality loss is controlled, cascaded serving can avoid an expensive prefill.

paper.title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
paper.abstract: AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.   Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of spar

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是生产环境中 coding agent workload 缺少实证刻画的问题。现有 LLM serving 系统多按短请求、无状态 chat workload 设计，但 coding agent 会在一次任务中反复调用模型、执行工具、读取工具输出、再继续调用模型，两者的系统行为差异很大。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基础模型研究有间接价值。它给出了真实 agentic coding 分布中的上下文长度、工具调用、重试、cache 生命周期和用户异质性。这些信号会反过来影响模型训练目标和数据构造：工具调用轨迹不是孤立 turn，而是长链式 session；上下文压缩和工具失败会显著改变 prompt 分布；agent-initiated 调用占多数，说明训练数据如果只模拟用户直接提问，会低估 agent 自主循环中的状态转移。对 serving 研究的价值更直接：KV cache 不应只按单请求管理，而应按 session、turn、模型切换和 compaction 事件管理。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 GitHub Copilot coding agent 的生产采样 trace 做 workload characterization。数据覆盖 2026 年 6 月一周，包含 320 万用户、1300 万 sessions、7.61 亿次 LLM calls、95T tokens 和 7.75 亿次 tool invocations。分析单位包括 session、turn、LLM call、tool call、context compaction、model switch 和 idle interval。核心分析围绕五个方向：LLM 调用和工具调用的耦合关系；KV cache 在 turn 内、turn 边界、模型切换和上下文压缩时的命中率变化；工具失败及 retry loop 对 token 量的放大；用户群体的资源使用差异；GPU 推理阶段和 CPU/IO 工具执行阶段交替造成的 idle-time 分布。论文还给出轻量 idle-time predictor，把 turn boundary 作为资源回收和 cache eviction/offloading 的可操作信号。
summary.experiments: 关键数字较完整。87% 的 LLM 调用由 agent 自主触发，而不是用户直接触发；LLM 调用和工具执行接近 1:1 耦合。KV cache 在 turn 内平均命中率约 90%，但跨 turn boundary 下降到 55%；模型切换会把命中率压到约 8%。Context compaction 只在 7.8% 的 sessions 中触发，却影响 44% 的总 token，并会丢弃超过 70% 的 prompt tokens，同时像模型切换一样重置 cache 状态。工具失败出现在 9% 的 turns 中，会触发自主 retry loop，并因上下文窗口增长把计算量最多放大到 4 倍。用户被分为五类 archetypes，per-turn token 消耗跨度约 50 倍，从 23K 到 1.1M tokens，说明统一资源策略会对重度用户和轻量用户都不合适。agent 执行呈现 GPU-bound LLM 推理与 CPU/IO-bound 工具执行交替，turn 内 idle 通常是秒级，turn 间 idle 可到分钟级。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Table 1 和 Section 4，建立 workload 的总体结构。然后精看 Section 5.2 和 Section 6 的 KV cache 生命周期分析，这是对 serving 系统最有用的部分。Section 7 的 tool failure/retry loop 对训练数据也有启发，因为真实 agent 轨迹中失败和恢复不是噪声，而是高成本状态。Section 8 的 user archetypes 可以帮助判断 benchmark 是否覆盖真实使用分布。Section 9 的 idle-time predictor 更偏系统实现，但能说明 agent workload 不能只按请求级调度。对预训练研究者，重点不是 predictor，而是真实 agent trace 显示出的长链上下文、工具反馈和压缩事件分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of production-scale evidence for agentic coding workloads. Existing LLM serving stacks are largely optimized for short, stateless requests, while coding agents run multi-step loops of model calls, tool execution, tool-output ingestion, retries, and edits over long sessions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it provides useful signals for foundation-model researchers working on tool use, long-context training, and agent data. Real coding-agent traces are session-structured rather than turn-isolated. Most model calls are initiated by the agent itself. Context compaction, tool failures, model switches, and retry loops reshape the prompt distribution and token budget. These properties matter when constructing tool-use pretraining or post-training data. The direct contribution is to serving systems: KV cache should be managed as a session-aware resource, not merely as a per-request optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study characterizes sampled production traces from GitHub Copilot's coding agent over one week in June 2026. The dataset contains 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, 95T tokens, and 775M tool invocations. The analysis defines and measures sessions, turns, LLM calls, tool calls, context compaction events, model switches, and idle intervals. It focuses on five workload properties: the coupling between LLM calls and tool execution; KV-cache behavior within turns and across turn boundaries; cache invalidation from model switches and compaction; compute amplification caused by tool failures and retries; heterogeneity across user populations; and the alternation between GPU-bound inference and CPU/IO-bound tool phases. The paper also studies a lightweight idle-time predictor and identifies turn boundaries as useful signals for resource reclamation and cache eviction or offloading.
summary_en.experiments: The scale of the measurement is the main empirical contribution. 87% of LLM invocations are agent-initiated, and LLM calls are coupled with tool execution at roughly a 1:1 ratio. KV-cache hit rates average around 90% within a turn, drop to 55% across turn boundaries, and fall to about 8% after model switches. Context compaction occurs in only 7.8% of sessions but accounts for 44% of total tokens; it removes more than 70% of prompt tokens and resets cache state almost as severely as a model switch. Tool failures appear in 9% of turns and can trigger autonomous retry loops that increase compute by up to 4x. The paper identifies five user archetypes with a 50x range in per-turn token consumption, from 23K to 1.1M tokens. Agent execution alternates between GPU inference and CPU/IO tool execution, producing second-scale idle gaps within turns and minute-scale gaps across turns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with Table 1 and Section 4 to understand the workload structure. Then read Sections 5.2 and 6 carefully, since the KV-cache lifecycle is the most actionable systems result. Section 7 is useful for model and data researchers because failures and retries are part of real agent trajectories, not just noise. Section 8 helps assess whether coding-agent benchmarks cover realistic user distributions. Section 9 is more systems-oriented, but it clarifies why request-level scheduling is insufficient for agent workloads. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful takeaway is the observed distribution of long chained contexts, tool feedback, compaction events, and agent-initiated calls.

recommendation.zh: 只看 workload 和 KV-cache 部分；它会修正“agent serving 近似 chatbot serving”的系统假设。
recommendation.en: Read the workload and KV-cache sections; they directly challenge the assumption that agent serving is just chatbot serving with more calls.

paper.title: Rethinking Video Token Compression with a Global Codebook: Learning Once, Compressing Everywhere
paper.abstract: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) represent videos as dense sequences of visual tokens, whose length grows with the temporal and spatial extent of the input. These tokens often contain substantial redundancy arising from repeated visual patterns, leading to unnecessary computation in the subsequent language-model processing. Existing token compression methods, including pruning and merging, perform compression online during inference, repeatedly incurring additional computation for each i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Video-LLM 中视觉 token 过长的问题，但切入点不是再做一个在线剪枝或合并器，而是把“如何分组压缩视觉 token”的知识从单个视频中抽出来，预先学习成一个可复用的全局 codebook。核心问题是：视频中大量局部视觉模式会跨样本重复，是否可以把这种重复性离线建模，并在推理时用很低的额外成本完成压缩。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏向 VLM 推理效率和视觉 token 表示压缩。但它有一个有用的信号：视觉 token 压缩不一定要绑定下游 Video-LLM 的 attention 或重要性估计，也不一定要在每个输入上重新计算压缩结构。对于研究视觉 tokenizer、视频 token 预算、native multimodal pretrain 的人，这篇论文提供了一个可插拔的“全局视觉分组先验”思路。它不是重新训练视觉编码器，也不是学习离散视觉词表，而是在冻结特征空间中学习聚类先验，再用连续 embedding 的均值池化保持与现有 Video-LLM 的接口兼容。
summary.technical_approach: ONCE 的方法分成离线和在线两段。离线阶段先在冻结视觉特征空间中构造语料级 sketch。每个视频按时间轴分成 L 个 bin，避免只采到局部时间片段；sketch 数量按 m = min{N, clip(ceil(N/R), m_min, m_max)} 控制，其中 N 是源 token 数，R 是目标压缩比例。每个时间 bin 内使用 spherical Lloyd 聚类，得到归一化代表向量，并记录它代表的源 token 数量。随后把所有视频的代表向量汇总成带权 sketch 集合。为了避免常见场景和高频视觉模式占用过多 codeword，论文引入 balanced prototype fitting，并用源 token 数和类别频率修正形成 effective weight；没有类别标签时可退化为不做长尾校正。在线阶段给定一个视频，先用全局 codebook 找出当前视频支持度最高的 codeword，受预算 B 约束选择一组 codeword；然后把原始视觉 token 重新分配到这些 codeword，并对原始连续 embedding 做均值池化。关键点是输出仍然是连续视觉 token，而不是离散 code index，因此不需要改 Video-LLM 参数，也不需要针对每个输入做优化。
summary.experiments: 论文在 4 个视频理解 benchmark 和 2 个 Video-LLM backbone 上评估 ONCE，并与输入自适应的剪枝、合并类压缩方法比较。实验结论是 ONCE 在准确率和推理成本之间取得较好的折中，尤其在 token budget 较紧时准确率下降更小；同时由于压缩决策主要复用离线 codebook，推理阶段的额外开销更低。可用内容没有给出完整表格数字，因此不应把结果解读为某个具体任务上的绝对优势。更可靠的读法是：ONCE 的收益来自把 per-video 相似度估计和重要性估计改成 corpus-level grouping prior，而不是来自更复杂的在线压缩网络。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看 Method 中的两部分：temporal corpus sketching 和 balanced prototype fitting；它们决定了 codebook 是否能覆盖长视频中的时间多样性和低频视觉模式。然后看在线阶段的 budget-aware selection、token reassignment 和 mean pooling，确认它为什么能保持与冻结 Video-LLM 兼容。实验部分优先看 accuracy–efficiency 曲线、不同 token budget 下的结果，以及跨 backbone 的迁移实验。对于预训练研究，最值得深挖的是：这种全局 codebook 是否可以前移到视觉 tokenizer 或多模态预训练数据构建阶段，而不是只作为推理压缩模块。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the long visual-token sequence problem in Video-LLMs. Its main question is whether video-token compression has to be recomputed online for every input, or whether recurring visual patterns across videos can be captured once as a reusable global grouping prior.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to multimodal inference efficiency than to language-model pretraining itself. Still, it is useful for researchers working on visual tokenization and native multimodal pretraining. The key idea is to decouple compression from model-specific attention scores or online token merging. ONCE learns a global codebook in a frozen visual feature space and uses it only as a grouping guide; the compressed outputs remain continuous visual embeddings. This makes the method compatible with existing Video-LLMs without changing their parameters.
summary_en.technical_approach: ONCE has an offline-to-online design. Offline, it builds a compact corpus sketch from frozen visual features.
