summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or exact speed/accuracy numbers. The intended comparison is against serial block-wise dLLM decoding and prior post-training approaches that try to expose inter-block parallelism.

recommendation.zh: 只看解码调度和质量退化曲线；若结果干净，dLLM serving 的并行假设要重新评估。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduling design and quality-speed curves; if clean, it changes the serving prior for block-wise dLLMs.

paper.title: VDAR-Router: Adaptive LLMs Routing via Verbalized Query Difficulty Analysis Retrieval
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in practical systems, making efficient model selection important for reducing deployment cost. LLM routing has emerged as a practical solution for allocating each input query to an appropriate model under a desired cost-performance trade-off. Existing routing methods often estimate model suitability from the surface semantics or embedding similarity of the input query. However, such methods may ignore the underlying difficulty of a query, leading to su

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 服务中按查询动态选择模型的问题，目标是在成本和效果之间做更细粒度的路由。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理服务侧的路由方法改进。它把“查询难度”显式化，而不是只用输入语义或 embedding 相似度做模型选择，对多模型 serving 有一定参考价值，但不直接影响基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VDAR-Router：先让模型生成输入查询的 verbalized difficulty analysis，再检索具有相似难度画像的历史样例，根据历史记录估计候选模型适配度，并用同时考虑性能和成本的 reward function 选择模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在三个数据集上评估，比较现有基于语义或相似度的 routing 方法，展示难度感知检索能改善成本-性能权衡；具体模型规模、数据集名称和提升幅度在给定信息中未披露。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses per-query LLM routing for selecting an appropriate model under a cost-performance budget.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-serving routing method. It makes query difficulty explicit instead of relying only on surface semantics or embedding similarity, which is useful for multi-model deployment but only weakly connected to foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: VDAR-Router first generates a verbalized analysis of query difficulty, retrieves historical examples with similar difficulty profiles, estimates candidate model suitability from those records, and selects a model with a reward function balancing quality and cost.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on three datasets against existing routing methods based on semantic or similarity signals, showing better cost-performance trade-offs. Model sizes, dataset names, and exact gains are not available from the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 serving 路由备查即可；若做多模型调度，只看 difficulty verbalization 是否真的比 embedding 稳。
recommendation.en: Useful as serving-routing background; if you run model cascades, check whether difficulty verbalization is actually more stable than embeddings.

institutions: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

paper.title: Lossless but Not Free: An Empirical Anatomy of Speculative Decoding on Consumer Hardware
paper.abstract: Single-stream autoregressive decoding of large language models is bound by memory bandwidth: each generated token requires one full forward pass through the target model, and successive passes cannot be parallelized. Speculative decoding restructures this computation: a small draft model proposes $K$ tokens autoregressively, the target model scores all of them in one batched pass, and a rejection-sampling rule provably preserves the target model's output distribution. We present a from-scratch,

summary.core_problem: 评估 speculative decoding 在消费级硬件上是否真正带来端到端加速，以及分布无损性在实际实现中如何验证。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率工程实证。它不是新算法，但对 serving 和本地部署有参考价值，尤其提醒 speculative decoding 的理论无损不等于免费加速。
summary.technical_approach: 从零实现 device-agnostic speculative decoding，支持 CUDA、MPS 和 CPU。小 draft model 自回归提出 K 个 token，target model 一次 batched pass 验证，并用 rejection sampling 保持 target 分布不变。论文在多个 draft/target/backend 配置下测量接受率、wall-clock speedup 和分布一致性。
summary.experiments: 在消费级 Apple-silicon 笔记本上测试 5 种 draft/target 后端配置。分布等价性通过三层验证，包括约 9,200 个真实模型 token 的 two-sample test，χ²=162.5、dof=200、p=0.976，以及 greedy sequence exact agreement。最佳配置在 K=6 达到 1.61× wall-clock speedup，接受率从 69.7% 开始随位置下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether speculative decoding actually delivers end-to-end speedups on consumer hardware, and how to verify its lossless distributional property in practice.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency engineering study rather than a new decoding algorithm. Its useful contribution is an empirical reminder that distribution-preserving speculative decoding does not automatically translate into large wall-clock gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author implements device-agnostic speculative decoding from scratch across CUDA, MPS, and CPU. A small draft model proposes K autoregressive tokens, the target model verifies them in one batched pass, and rejection sampling preserves the target model distribution. The study measures acceptance profiles, wall-clock speed, and distribution equivalence across draft/target/backend configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five draft/target backend configurations on a consumer Apple-silicon laptop. Distributional equivalence is checked at three levels, including a two-sample test over about 9,200 real-model tokens with χ²=162.5, dof=200, p=0.976, plus exact greedy-sequence agreement. The best setup reaches a 1.61× wall-clock speedup at K=6, with acceptance starting at 69.7% and declining across positions.

recommendation.zh: 没有新算法，但实测很接地气；只看 acceptance 曲线和后端对比，别把 1.6× 当通用结论。
recommendation.en: No new algorithm, but the measurements are grounded; read the acceptance and backend tables, not the 1.6× number as a universal claim.

paper.title: DiTango: Cost-Effective Parallel Diffusion Generation with Selective Attention State Reuse
paper.abstract: Recent advances in AI-generated content have driven widespread adoption of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for high-resolution, long-duration content generation. While parallelization techniques accelerate diffusion inference, they face significant scalability challenges due to excessive communication overhead in multi-node environments.   We observe that sequence partitions in Context Parallelism (CP) exhibit distinct heterogeneity: spatially proximate partitions contribute more significantly to

summary.core_problem: 解决 Diffusion Transformer 在多节点并行推理中，Context Parallelism 因跨分区注意力通信过重而难以扩展的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于生成模型推理系统优化。对做统一多模态预训练或关注 DiT serving 的研究员有参考价值，但与 LLM 基座预训练主线距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DiTango，通过选择性 attention state reuse 降低通信成本。核心观察是 CP 中不同序列分区对注意力结果贡献不均，空间上更近的分区更重要；据此将异质贡献映射到分层通信拓扑，只精算高贡献分区，低贡献部分复用历史去噪步的状态。系统包含 anchor-guided state selection planner，用于决定哪些状态保留、复用和通信。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、节点数、分辨率、吞吐提升和质量损失。实验大概率在高分辨率图像或长视频 DiT 上，对比标准 context parallel 或并行推理框架，关注多节点扩展效率与生成质量折中。
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学、上海 AI Lab、清华大学团队。上海 AI Lab 在大模型与生成模型系统方向持续有产出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the poor scalability of Diffusion Transformer inference under multi-node context parallelism, where cross-partition attention communication becomes the bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: This is a generation-system efficiency contribution. It is relevant if you care about unified multimodal pretraining or DiT serving, but it is not central to LLM pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiTango introduces selective attention state reuse to reduce communication. The key observation is that sequence partitions in context parallelism contribute unevenly to attention outputs, with spatially nearby partitions mattering more. The system maps this heterogeneity to hierarchical communication topology, computes high-contribution partitions more faithfully, and reuses historical states for lower-contribution parts. An anchor-guided state selection planner decides what to keep, reuse, and communicate.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, node count, resolution, throughput gains, or quality trade-offs. Experiments likely benchmark high-resolution image or long-video DiTs against standard context-parallel inference setups, focusing on multi-node scaling efficiency versus generation quality.
summary_en.authors_note: From Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, and Tsinghua University. Shanghai AI Lab has been active in large-model and generative-model systems work.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“跨步复用注意力状态”这个想法对 DiT serving 有点意思；只看方法图和效率表，别指望它迁移到文本 LM 训练。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the cross-step attention-state reuse idea is mildly interesting for DiT serving; read the method figure and efficiency tables, not the full paper.

institutions: University of Science and Technology Beijing
Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory

paper.title: Polestar: Drift-Aware Cache Calibration and Token Commitment for Efficient Inference of Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: The inference efficiency of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is constrained by two challenges: bidirectional attention precludes efficient KV-cache reuse, while increasing decoding parallelism with static confidence thresholds can compromise generation quality. We observe that both challenges arise from a shared phenomenon: as tokens are decoded, their contextual integration through bidirectional attention causes token representations to drift (evolve) across decoding steps. This insight

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的两个耦合问题：一是双向注意力导致标准 AR 式 KV-cache 不能直接复用，每一步都要重算；二是为了减少 denoising 步数而做并行 token 提交时，固定阈值往往在不同样本、不同步数下失灵，容易把尚未稳定的 token 过早提交，带来质量下降。论文的关键判断是，这两个问题不是彼此独立的工程细节，而是都来自同一个机制：在迭代去噪过程中，token 表示会因为双向上下文持续重整而发生 drift，旧 cache 之所以失效、token 之所以不能安全提交，都是因为表示还在变。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于训练方法，而在于它把 dLLM 推理中的“缓存有效性”和“提交时机”统一成了一个可测的表示动力学信号。这个视角比只看置信度、attention 热点或固定 block 边界更接近 dLLM 的真实计算结构。若后续有人做 diffusion / masked / any-order LM 的训练-推理协同设计，这篇工作的价值在于给出了一个较清楚的中间量：表示 drift 可以作为推理控制信号，也可能反过来成为训练时的辅助目标、校准目标或 early-exit 信号。就当前工作本身看，它属于推理优化，但对非 AR 语言建模范式的系统化落地有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成两部分。第一部分是 Polestar-Cache。作者不再把 cache 是否过期交给粗粒度代理信号，而是在每个 decode step、每一层上直接比较 token 输入隐藏状态的变化，用 drift 来判断哪些位置的 KV 已经陈旧，需要刷新。这样做的出发点是：dLLM 中某个 token 即便本身没有被当前步直接更新，它的表示也可能因为周围 token 的去噪进展而显著变化，因此“块外不变”或“少数热点 token 代表全局”的假设都不稳。Polestar-Cache 于是采用稀疏、间歇式的 KV 更新，只刷新 drift 高的位置，其他位置继续复用旧 cache，从而在不完全重算的前提下控制 stale cache 带来的误差。

第二部分是 Polestar-Commit。作者观察到 token drift 在接近最终收敛前会出现尖峰，随后进入稳定区。这个现象被用来判断 token 是否可以提前 commit。和只看 softmax confidence 不同，drift 反映的是表示是否还在被上下文大幅改写，因此更适合 dLLM 这种双向迭代生成。论文据此设计了基于 drift 的提交策略，用来替代或补充静态 confidence threshold。

第三部分是系统实现。因为 drift 计算、cache 选择和刷新本身也有开销，作者做了 CPU offloading 与 latency hiding，把 Polestar 特有的控制逻辑与主干前向尽量重叠，避免“省下的算力又被调度开销吃掉”。这部分虽然是系统细节，但对方法是否真的带来吞吐收益很关键。

和已有方法相比，Fast-dLLM 主要依赖 block-wise cache reuse 与固定阈值提交，假设较强；Elastic-Cache、d2Cache 等方法使用 attention 或 uncertainty 作为代理信号，但没有直接刻画表示随步数和层数的联合演化。Polestar 的区别在于把 drift 当成统一的一阶控制量，同时服务于 cache refresh 和 token commitment。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖多个 dLLM family，以及数学、代码等任务。论文给出的总体结果是：相对已有基线，准确率最高提升 10.73%，平均提升 3.74%；吞吐最高达到 3.7×，平均约 1.6×；平均 decoding parallelism 可到 3.67 tokens per forward。作者强调的是 accuracy-throughput Pareto 改善，而不是只在单一指标上取胜。

从摘要和正文可见，实验重点不是单纯报一个最终分数，而是验证三个链条：第一，drift 是否真能刻画 cache staleness；第二，drift spike 是否与 token 收敛相关；第三，把两者联合起来后，是否比只做 cache 或只做 commit 更好。消融上值得注意的点通常包括：只开 Polestar-Cache、只开 Polestar-Commit、两者同时开启；不同 drift 度量或阈值设置；是否加入系统级 overlap 优化。论文主张其收益来自算法-系统协同，而不是某个单点 trick。

如果精读正文，建议重点核对几类数字：不同模型家族上的稳定性是否一致；长序列或高难样本上吞吐收益是否更明显；在更激进并行提交下，质量退化是否被显著抑制。这些决定它是“普适控制信号”还是“特定配置下有效”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，先建立问题图景：dLLM 推理慢，不只是因为步数多，也因为双向注意力让 cache 复用变难。然后直接看 Section 3，确认作者如何定义和测量 representational drift，以及它和 cache 失效、token 收敛之间的经验关系。这部分是整篇文章的支点。

接着看 Section 4.1 和 4.2。4.1 关注“哪些 KV 该刷新”，4.2 关注“哪些 token 可以提交”。如果时间有限，可以把公式细节略过，但要看清楚 drift 信号是在层内、步间、token 级别如何被聚合成控制决策的。最后看 Section 5 的 Pareto 图和消融表，判断收益是否来自统一信号而非额外超参堆叠。

预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若你做的是 diffusion / masked LM 推理或训练-推理联合设计，值得进一步深挖 Appendix 里关于 drift 现象普遍性的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two coupled bottlenecks in diffusion LLM inference: bidirectional attention prevents straightforward AR-style KV-cache reuse, and aggressive parallel token commitment often hurts quality when driven by static confidence thresholds. The central claim is that these are not separate engineering issues. Both stem from the same underlying phenomenon: token representations keep drifting across denoising steps as context is repeatedly re-integrated. Old cache entries become stale for the same reason that some tokens are not yet safe to commit.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model researchers is conceptual rather than purely systems-oriented. It reframes cache validity and commitment timing in dLLMs as a shared representation-dynamics problem. That is a cleaner abstraction than block boundaries, attention heuristics, or confidence alone. For future work on diffusion, masked, or any-order language models, this suggests that representational drift could become a general control signal at the train–inference interface: for calibration, adaptive compute, early exit, or even auxiliary training objectives. The current paper is an inference optimization work, but it is relevant because non-AR LMs need this kind of systems grounding to become practical.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. First, Polestar-Cache uses token-level representational drift to decide where KV-cache entries have become stale and should be refreshed. Instead of assuming that tokens outside the current block remain valid, or relying on coarse proxies such as attention concentration or uncertainty, it directly tracks hidden-state changes across steps and layers. The motivation is specific to dLLMs: even if a token is not explicitly updated at the current step, its representation may still change substantially because neighboring tokens are being denoised under bidirectional attention. Polestar-Cache therefore performs sparse and sporadic KV refreshes only at high-drift positions, while reusing the rest.

Second, Polestar-Commit uses drift as a convergence signal for token commitment. The paper reports that token drift often exhibits a sharp spike near the onset of convergence toward the final output representation, followed by stabilization. This is used to decide when a token can be committed earlier and more safely. Compared with confidence-only policies, drift is better aligned with whether the representation is still being materially rewritten by context, which matters more in iterative bidirectional generation.

Third, the paper includes system-level optimization. Since measuring drift and scheduling refreshes introduce overhead, the implementation uses CPU offloading and latency hiding to overlap Polestar-specific operations with the main forward pass. This matters because many inference-time ideas look good algorithmically but lose their gains once control overhead is included.

Relative to prior work, Fast-dLLM relies on block-wise cache reuse and static commitment thresholds; Elastic-Cache and d2Cache use attention- or uncertainty-based proxies. Polestar’s distinguishing move is to use drift as a unified first-order signal for both cache refresh and token commitment.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans multiple diffusion LLM families and reasoning-heavy domains such as math and coding. The headline numbers reported are up to 10.73% accuracy gain over prior baselines, 3.74% on average, up to 3.7× higher throughput, 1.6× on average, and decoding parallelism reaching 3.67 tokens per forward. The paper emphasizes improvement on the accuracy–throughput Pareto frontier rather than a single metric.

The more important experimental story is the validation chain behind those numbers. The paper aims to show: first, that drift is a useful indicator of cache staleness; second, that drift spikes correlate with token convergence; and third, that using drift for both cache refresh and commitment outperforms applying either idea in isolation. The key ablations are therefore likely to be: Polestar-Cache only, Polestar-Commit only, both together, different drift metrics or thresholds, and with versus without the system overlap optimizations.

When reading the full results, the most useful checks are whether gains hold across model families, whether longer generations benefit more, and whether quality degradation under more aggressive parallel commitment is meaningfully reduced. Those details determine whether drift is a robust control signal or a configuration-specific heuristic.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first two figures. They frame the real issue well: dLLM inference is slow not only because denoising takes multiple steps, but because bidirectional attention breaks the usual cache reuse assumptions. Then go directly to the section that defines and measures representational drift. That is the conceptual center of the paper, and it is where you can judge whether the method is grounded in model dynamics or just another heuristic.

After that, read the cache and commitment sections together. One answers where stale KV entries should be refreshed; the other answers when tokens can be safely committed. If time is limited, you can skim some formula details, but pay attention to how drift is aggregated across layers, steps, and tokens into actual control decisions. Finish with the Pareto plots and ablation tables to see whether the gains really come from the unified signal rather than extra tuning.

A useful skim should take around 30–45 minutes. If you work on diffusion or masked LMs, the appendix material on the prevalence of drift is worth a closer look.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 dLM serving，这篇比一般小修小补更像抓到了真正的控制变量；先看 drift 定义和 cache/commit 两个模块是否共享同一信号。
recommendation.en: If you care about dLM serving, this is more than a minor speed hack: check whether representation drift really is the right shared control variable for both cache reuse and token commitment.

paper.title: D-cut: Adaptive Verification Depth Pruning for Batched Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference without compromising output quality. Recent parallel drafting methods further improve single-request performance by decoupling draft length from drafting latency, enabling longer drafts and higher mean accepted tokens (MAT). However, under high request concurrency, long drafts waste substantial computation on rejected tokens, increasing verification cost and potentially making speculative decoding slower than autoregressive de

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 batched speculative decoding 在高并发下会失效的问题。长 draft 在低并发时通常有利，因为一次 verify 可以吞下更多候选 token；但并发升高后，verify 端从 memory-bound 逐渐转成 compute-bound，系统开始为大量最终会被拒绝的 draft token 付出真实算力。论文抓住的关键矛盾不是“draft 不够长”，而是“长 draft 的利用率在 batch 内高度不均匀，却仍被强制按统一深度验证”。结果是：某些请求只值得验证前几步，另一些请求却可以安全吃到更深位置，但现有方法把它们一视同仁，导致验证预算被低价值 token 吞掉，甚至让 speculative decoding 在大 batch 下落到低于 AR baseline。
summary.importance: 对基座研究员而言，这不是训练范式创新，而是 serving 侧一个很实在的系统问题：并行 draft 技术把单请求速度做上去之后，新的瓶颈转移到了批量验证的算力浪费。论文的贡献在于把 speculative decoding 的优化目标从“尽量拉长 draft”改成“在给定 runtime 条件下分配验证预算”。这个视角有启发性，因为它说明 speculative decoding 的最优策略不是静态的，也不是只由 acceptance rate 决定，而是由 acceptance 分布、batch 规模、模型结构、GPU 类型和并行实现共同决定。对 dense 与 MoE 模型都成立，尤其对 verify 成本结构更复杂的部署环境更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 D-cut，核心是训练无关的自适应深度裁剪。它包含两个机制。

第一是 cross-request pruning。作者观察到 acceptance length 在请求之间和时间步之间都有很大方差，而且 drafter 的 token-level confidence 与是否会被接受存在可利用的相关性。于是他们不再要求 batch 内每个请求都验证同样深度，而是把整个 batch 的所有 draft 位置看成共享预算池：先为每个请求生成长度为 D 的 draft，再依据 drafter 置信度对所有候选位置做全局排序，只保留更可能被接受的 token 进入 verify。直观上，这是把预算从“低置信度请求的长尾后缀”转移到“高置信度请求的更深 continuation”。这样做并不改变 target model 的接受规则，因此仍保持 lossless 输出分布；变化的只是哪些位置被送去验证。

第二是 runtime-adaptive depth selection。作者没有把裁剪深度写成固定超参，而是显式建模“多验证一个 token 到底要多贵”。这个代价依赖部署环境：dense/MoE 架构不同，张量并行和批处理策略不同，GPU 也不同。论文在启动时做 profile，估计不同验证深度下的实际 step latency，然后把这个 runtime-specific cost 放进选择目标里，求一个更合适的保留深度。换句话说，D-cut 不是单纯最大化 expected accepted tokens，而是在 accepted tokens 增益和 verify latency 增量之间做权衡。

从方法形态看，它更像是 speculative decoding 上的一层 scheduler，而不是新 drafter。它不改 target model，不要求额外训练，也不依赖特定 drafter 架构；论文主要结合 block-parallel drafter 场景展开，因为这类方法最容易出现“draft 很长但 verify 浪费更大”的问题。与固定 depth、per-request 独立裁剪相比，D-cut 的区别在于它允许 batch 内非均匀深度，并把决策目标直接对齐到真实 runtime，而不是离线 acceptance 统计。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是离线 acceptance 指标，而是端到端吞吐与不同 batch 下相对 AR 的真实加速。论文在 dense 和 MoE 模型上都做了评测，并覆盖不同并发规模。文中给出的代表性现象是：以 Qwen3-8B 配合 DFlash、draft length D=15 为例，平均 acceptance length 只有约 6，意味着约 60% 被验证的 draft token 最终会被拒绝；在 bs=64 时，vanilla DFlash 的吞吐已经可能低于标准 AR。D-cut 的作用就是在这种高并发区间把 speculative decoding 拉回到有效区。

结果层面，作者报告 D-cut 能在 dense 配置上恢复高并发下的加速收益，在原本会跌破 AR baseline 的区域重新取得正加速；在 MoE 模型上最高达到约 3.0× 相对 AR 的 speedup。论文还展示了几个支撑性实验：一是 acceptance length 在不同请求之间确实高度离散，说明统一验证深度不合理；二是 drafter confidence 对 acceptance 有可分性，支持用其做 pruning signal；三是不同 benchmark 的 acceptance 形态不同，例如 Math500、MBPP 更常出现长 acceptance，而 MT-Bench 更偏短前缀，这也解释了为什么固定深度策略在不同工作负载上表现不稳。

消融上，值得注意的点通常有三类：只做 confidence pruning 但不做 runtime adaptation，会在某些硬件/并行配置下选错深度；只做 per-request 裁剪而不做 cross-request 全局预算分配，收益明显更弱；继续盲目增大 draft length，在高并发下未必带来更高吞吐，反而可能因 verify 代价上升而恶化。论文的实验叙事比较完整，核心结论是 speculative decoding 的收益曲线随 batch 变化并非单调，系统最优点需要在线适配。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Motivation，抓住两个事实：一是高并发时 verify 成本结构变了，二是 acceptance 在 batch 内高度不均。然后重点看方法部分里 cross-request pruning 的形式化定义，以及 runtime profiling 如何进入目标函数。这里决定了 D-cut 不是简单 heuristic，而是面向真实延迟的预算分配。

实验部分建议优先看三类图表：吞吐/加速比随 batch size 变化的曲线；confidence 与 acceptance 的相关性分析；不同任务负载下 acceptance length 分布。前者回答“有没有用”，后两者回答“为什么有用”。如果时间有限，30-40 分钟足够把主要思想和适用边界看清。更值得深挖的点有两个：其一，confidence 作为 acceptance proxy 的稳健性，在不同 drafter 和温度设置下是否稳定；其二，runtime cost model 是否可以进一步做成在线闭环，而不只是启动时 profile 一次。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode of batched speculative decoding under high concurrency. Long drafts help at low concurrency because many candidate tokens can be verified in one target-model pass. But as batch size grows, verification shifts from being mostly memory-bound to meaningfully compute-bound, so rejected draft tokens are no longer cheap. The key mismatch is that current systems often verify the same draft depth for every request in the batch, even though acceptance lengths vary widely across requests and across decoding steps. This makes the system spend substantial verification budget on low-value suffix tokens and can even push speculative decoding below the autoregressive baseline at large batch sizes.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-side paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant because it reframes the optimization target of speculative decoding. The message is not simply “make the drafter longer” or “increase acceptance rate.” The useful objective is to allocate verification compute under actual runtime constraints. That depends jointly on acceptance distribution, batch size, model architecture, GPU characteristics, and parallelization strategy. The paper is a good reminder that once draft generation becomes cheap through block-parallel methods, verification becomes the dominant systems problem. That perspective matters for dense and MoE deployment alike.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, D-cut, is a training-free adaptive depth pruning layer on top of speculative decoding. It has two main components.

First, cross-request pruning removes the uniform-depth constraint. The authors observe large variance in accepted lengths across requests and show that drafter confidence is informative about whether a token will be accepted. Instead of verifying depth D for every request, D-cut treats all draft positions in the batch as a shared verification budget. It globally ranks candidate draft tokens using confidence and keeps the positions that are more likely to survive verification. In effect, it shifts budget away from low-confidence suffixes of weak requests toward deeper continuations of stronger requests. Because the target model still performs the same acceptance test on the retained positions, the output distribution remains lossless.

Second, runtime-adaptive depth selection explicitly models the cost of verifying extra tokens. That cost is deployment-specific: it depends on dense vs. MoE architecture, the parallelism scheme, and the GPU/runtime stack. D-cut profiles verification latency at startup and incorporates this measured cost into the selection objective. So the method is not maximizing expected accepted tokens alone; it is trading off accepted-token gain against incremental verification latency under the current runtime.

Conceptually, D-cut is a scheduler rather than a new drafter. It does not modify the target model, does not require training, and is compatible with existing speculative pipelines. The paper focuses on block-parallel drafters because they make long drafts cheap to produce, which amplifies the waste on the verification side. Compared with fixed-depth verification or per-request local pruning, the distinctive idea is batch-level non-uniform depth allocation guided by both confidence and measured runtime cost.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on end-to-end throughput and speedup relative to autoregressive decoding across batch sizes, not just offline acceptance metrics. The paper evaluates both dense and MoE models under varying concurrency. A representative result highlighted in the paper is that with Qwen3-8B plus DFlash at draft length D=15, the mean accepted length is only about 6, implying that roughly 60% of verified draft tokens are rejected. At batch size 64, vanilla DFlash can already fall below standard AR throughput. D-cut is designed precisely for this regime.

Empirically, D-cut recovers positive acceleration in dense settings where vanilla speculative decoding becomes worse than AR at high concurrency. On MoE models, the reported peak speedup reaches about 3.0× over AR. The supporting analyses are also important: accepted lengths are highly dispersed across requests, drafter confidence has predictive value for acceptance, and the acceptance profile differs by workload. For example, Math500 and MBPP tend to exhibit more long accepted continuations, while MT-Bench is dominated by short accepted prefixes, which explains why a fixed verification depth is unstable across workloads.

The ablations suggest three practical lessons. Confidence-based pruning without runtime adaptation can choose the wrong depth under some hardware/runtime configurations. Per-request pruning without cross-request global allocation leaves noticeable gains on the table. And simply increasing draft length does not guarantee higher throughput at high concurrency, because verification cost can dominate. The main experimental takeaway is that speculative decoding speedup is not monotonic in batch size, and the best operating point must be adapted to the runtime.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and motivation. The two facts to lock in are: verification becomes expensive at high concurrency, and accepted lengths are highly uneven within a batch. Then read the method section carefully, especially the formalization of cross-request pruning and how runtime profiling enters the objective. That is where the paper moves beyond a heuristic and becomes a latency-aware budget allocation method.

In the experiments, prioritize three figure types: throughput or speedup versus batch size, confidence-versus-acceptance analysis, and accepted-length distributions across tasks. The first tells you whether the method works, and the latter two explain why. A 30-40 minute skim is enough to extract the main idea and deployment boundary conditions. If you want to go deeper, two questions are worth following up: how robust confidence is as an acceptance proxy across drafters and decoding temperatures, and whether the runtime cost model could be turned into a closed-loop online controller rather than a one-time startup profile.

recommendation.zh: 这是 serving 侧很实在的一刀：别再盯单请求 MAT，直接看高并发下验证预算怎么分；读方法和吞吐曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: A useful serving-side correction: stop optimizing single-request MAT in isolation and look at verification-budget allocation under concurrency.

paper.title: Full-Pipeline Inference Optimization for MiMo-V2.5 Series: Pushing Hybrid SWA Efficiency to the Limit
paper.abstract: We present a full-pipeline inference optimization for the MiMo-V2.5 model family, which combines Hybrid Sliding Window Attention (Hybrid SWA), sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and multimodal encoders. While Hybrid SWA can ideally reduce both attention compute and KVCache storage significantly compared to Full Attention, realizing these gains in production requires substantial engineering effort. We systematically optimize the KVCache system with layerwise prefetch, SWA-aware prefix cache trees,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工程报告解决的是 Hybrid Sliding Window Attention 在生产推理中的落地问题：理论上 SWA 能显著降低 KVCache 和 attention 计算，但默认 serving 系统往往会把它退化成近似全量 KV 存储。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构—系统协同。Hybrid SWA、MoE 和多模态 encoder 常被作为长上下文模型的效率设计，但训练时看到的理论复杂度不等于线上成本。该报告说明，如果 KVCache 池、prefix cache、调度器、跨层预取和分布式缓存没有按 SWA 语义重写，架构节省会被系统抽象吃掉。它对是否在基座模型中采用混合注意力有实际参考价值：预训练架构选择不能只看训练吞吐和 perplexity，还要看 decode 阶段的缓存形态、prefix 复用和多租户调度。
summary.technical_approach: 报告围绕 MiMo-V2.5 系列的完整推理链路做优化。模型侧包含 Hybrid SWA、稀疏 MoE 和多模态 encoder。以 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 为例，共 70 层，其中 10 层 Full Attention，60 层 SWA，窗口大小为 128。系统侧的关键改动是重构 KVCache：物理上拆成 Full KV pool 和 SWA KV pool，Full Attention 层按全序列存储，SWA 层只保留窗口内 KV，从而使 SWA 存储严格保持 O(W)，而不是被统一 KV 池拉回 O(N)。逻辑上仍向上层暴露统一的 sequence view，以 Full Attention 索引为权威引用，并维护 Full 到 SWA 的映射，避免 prefix tree、scheduler 和传输协议感知过多底层细节。调度时同时检查 Full KV 和 SWA KV 容量，避免只按单一缓存维度 admission。报告还提出 layerwise prefetch、SWA-aware prefix cache tree、专门的 cache placement、RDMA 优化的分布式 GCache，以及 KVCache-affinity router，用于提高 prefix 命中、减少重复 prefill，并在 MoE 负载均衡和缓存亲和之间做折中。多模态部分针对大图和长视频 encoder 吞吐瓶颈做流水线优化。
summary.experiments: 已给出的关键量化锚点主要来自架构上界：MiMo-V2.5-Pro 的 70 层中有 60 层为 SWA，窗口为 128，因此 SWA 层占 6/7；在 chunked prefill 场景下，Hybrid SWA 的 attention 计算理论上约为全注意力的 1/7；长上下文 decode 中，KVCache 体积也接近降到全注意力的 1/7。报告还比较了不同参数规模模型的 KVCache 存储，称 MiMo-V2.5 和 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 在各自规模组内 KV 需求较低，仅次于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro。完整片段没有给出端到端 QPS、TTFT、TPOT、cache hit rate 或成本下降的具体表格，因此应把这些数字看作系统设计的理论和结构性依据，而不是完整性能结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Background 中对 Hybrid SWA 理论边界的计算，以及 KVCache System Refactor 中 Full/SWA 双池、统一逻辑视图、Full 到 SWA 映射和 admission 约束。对基座预训练研究员，最有用的问题不是具体用了哪套 serving 框架，而是这种注意力结构会给后续推理系统带来哪些硬约束。若只关心训练，可快速扫过 GCache、RDMA 和 router；若在设计长上下文模型架构，需要仔细看 prefix cache tree 和 SWA 语义的一致性处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The report addresses a practical gap in serving Hybrid Sliding Window Attention: the architecture promises much lower attention and KV-cache cost, but standard inference stacks can silently fall back to near-full KV storage.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for pretraining is that long-context architecture choices must be evaluated together with inference systems. Hybrid SWA, sparse MoE, and multimodal encoders may look efficient on paper, yet the realized gain depends on cache layout, prefix reuse, admission control, prefetching, routing, and distributed storage. This matters when choosing a base-model architecture: a lower training-time attention cost is not enough if decode-time KV semantics are hard to serve. The report is therefore useful as architecture-system feedback for future long-context model design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The optimization targets the MiMo-V2.5 family, which combines Hybrid SWA, sparse MoE, and multimodal encoders. For MiMo-V2.5-Pro, the document describes a 70-layer model with 10 full-attention layers and 60 SWA layers, using a window size of 128. The central system change is a KV-cache refactor. Instead of a single KV pool that forces all layers to reserve O(N) sequence storage, the system separates full-attention KV from SWA KV. Full-attention layers retain full-sequence keys and values, while SWA layers keep only window-local entries, enforcing O(W) storage for the SWA part. A unified logical sequence view is still exposed to prefix trees, schedulers, and transport layers, with full-attention indices used as the authoritative reference and mappings maintained from full positions to SWA positions. Admission control checks both full and SWA cache constraints. The broader pipeline adds layerwise prefetching, SWA-aware prefix-cache trees, specialized placement policies, an RDMA-optimized distributed cache named GCache, and a KV-cache-affinity router to trade off cache reuse against load balance. Multimodal encoder throughput is treated as another bottleneck, especially for large images and long videos.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text gives structural numbers rather than a complete performance table. The key anchors are the 70-layer configuration, 10 full-attention layers, 60 SWA layers, and window size 128. Since SWA accounts for 6/7 of the layers, the theoretical attention compute in chunked prefill is described as roughly 1/7 of full attention, and long-context KV-cache storage can also approach 1/7 of a full-attention implementation. The report also states that MiMo-V2.5 and MiMo-V2.5-Pro have low estimated KV-cache requirements within their parameter-scale groups, behind only the corresponding DeepSeek-V4 Flash/Pro variants in the comparison shown. Concrete end-to-end serving metrics such as TTFT, TPOT, QPS, cache hit rate, and cost per token are not visible in the supplied content, so the numerical evidence should be read mainly as architectural and systems rationale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Read the background section for the cost model of Hybrid SWA, then focus on the KVCache refactor: the split full/SWA pools, unified logical indexing, full-to-SWA mapping, and dual-capacity admission control. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the constraint that this architecture imposes on downstream serving. GCache, RDMA, and routing details can be skimmed unless serving cost is part of the model-design loop. If designing a long-context base model, spend more time on the interaction between SWA semantics and prefix-cache reuse.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文或 MoE serving 的人该看，尤其缓存树和 affinity router；不改建模 prior，但会改你对 SWA 落地成本的估计。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on long-context or MoE serving, especially for the cache-tree and affinity-router design; it won’t change modeling priors, but it may change your estimate of SWA’s real deployment cost.

paper.title: Less Experts, Faster Decoding: Cost-Aware Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), but their inference efficiency depends strongly on expert activation patterns. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel, yet existing draft selection strategies primarily optimize acceptance likelihood. In large-scale MoE models, however, selecting draft tokens also determines the union of experts activated during

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 模型中 speculative decoding 只追求草稿 token 接受率、却忽略专家权重访存成本的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与 MoE 成本建模。它指出 MoE 推理的瓶颈不只是 token 数和接受率，还取决于验证阶段被草稿树触发的专家集合大小；这个观察对 MoE serving、路由设计和推测解码策略都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 EcoSpec，在 draft-tree 选择时加入预测的边际专家激活成本。相较于只按 token 概率或接受概率扩展草稿，它把候选 token 会引入的新专家权重访存纳入目标函数，从而减少 expert scattering，即高概率候选路由到互不重叠专家导致的访存扩散。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验围绕大规模 MoE 推理中的 speculative decoding 展开，对比现有以接受率为中心的草稿选择策略。给定信息未提供具体 MoE 模型、参数量、专家数、硬件配置、吞吐提升或延迟下降幅度，因此需要读正文确认收益是否来自真实 serving 瓶颈而非简化成本模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses speculative decoding for MoE models when draft-token selection ignores expert-weight memory cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and MoE cost-modeling contribution. It argues that MoE speculative decoding is governed not only by acceptance rate and token count, but also by the union of experts activated during verification, which directly affects serving efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: EcoSpec augments draft-tree selection with predicted marginal expert activation cost. Instead of expanding candidates purely by probability or expected acceptance, it penalizes tokens that introduce additional expert-weight memory traffic, reducing expert scattering across draft candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare cost-aware speculative decoding against acceptance-centered draft selection for large MoE inference. The supplied abstract does not give the exact MoE models, parameter counts, expert counts, hardware setup, throughput gains, or latency reductions, so the main paper is needed to judge how much of the gain holds under real serving conditions.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 expert-scattering 的测量和成本模型；若复现成立，MoE 推测解码不能再只优化接受率。
recommendation.en: Read the expert-scattering measurements and cost model; if they reproduce, MoE speculative decoding should not optimize acceptance rate alone.

paper.title: MetaInfer: A Knowledge Only LLM Inference Engine Generator SKILL Toolbox
paper.abstract: As LLM technology advances, the space of model families, compute hardware, quantization schemes, parallelization strategies, and specialized optimization kernels continues to expand, sharply increasing the code complexity and maintenance cost of general-purpose inference frameworks. Conventional software engineering uses multiple layers of abstraction to support diverse application scenarios, but these abstractions also increase system complexity and may introduce additional performance overhead

summary.core_problem: 解决通用 LLM 推理框架在模型族、硬件、量化、并行和 kernel 组合快速膨胀后，代码复杂度和维护成本过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统创新：不是提出新的推理 kernel 或 serving 算法，而是尝试用 LLM 多智能体把“推理框架生成”自动化，降低为特定约束定制 inference engine 的工程成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MetaInfer，将用户输入抽象为运行时约束；系统由 LLM 驱动的多智能体协作流程和 contract knowledge base 组成，根据约束自动生成紧凑的定制化推理框架。方法更像 LLM-as-Compiler / LLM-for-systems engineering，而不是手写统一框架后再靠多层抽象适配不同场景。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验从 source-code reference 的作用、zero-reference 设置下生成引擎的运行行为和性能 profile 等角度评估；未给出模型参数量、硬件配置、吞吐/延迟提升幅度或与 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 等成熟系统的直接数字对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the rising code complexity and maintenance burden of general-purpose LLM inference frameworks as model families, hardware, quantization formats, parallelism strategies, and custom kernels diversify.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systems workflow rather than a new inference kernel: it uses LLM agents to automate the generation of customized inference engines under explicit runtime constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: MetaInfer frames the task as an LLM-as-Compiler problem. Users specify runtime constraints, and an LLM-driven multi-agent system, backed by a contract knowledge base, generates a compact inference framework tailored to those constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions evaluations on the effect of source-code references and the runtime behavior and performance profile of generated engines under zero-reference settings. It does not expose concrete model sizes, hardware setups, latency/throughput numbers, or direct comparisons with production inference stacks.

recommendation.zh: 只适合维护 serving 栈的人扫实验；对预训练方法没有直接信号，关键风险是 LLM 生成代码的可靠性和可复现实验。
recommendation.en: Skim only if you own a serving stack; it gives little pretraining signal, and the main risk is whether LLM-generated systems code is reliable and reproducible.

paper.title: Stateful Worlds, Stateless Elasticity: Exact-State Serving for Interactive World Models
paper.abstract: A persistent interactive world model keeps its running state resident on the GPU that serves it: a multi-gigabyte attention cache, almost all of it rewritten at every generation step. That state cannot be recomputed in interactive time or approximated without changing the world, so a live session pins its device. The pin is a scheduling problem. WorldMove moves a live session under one guarantee: the destination is bit-identical to the source, or nothing is installed. It relocates the cache in 1

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式 world model 在服务端因大规模运行态缓存常驻 GPU 而失去弹性调度的问题，目标是在不中断会话且不改变生成结果的前提下迁移精确状态。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理系统与 serving 工程：不是预训练方法，但对长会话、KV/cache 状态管理、交互式生成系统的调度边界有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldMove，在源和目标设备之间迁移 live session 的完整运行态，并要求目标状态与源状态 bit-identical，否则回滚。核心点包括：对 cache 做校验和验证的高速迁移、在 generation block 边界收敛、用 readout horizon 与 dirty rate 定义可迁移条件，并把单会话条件提升为 fleet schedulability test。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告同节点迁移 18.8ms，比 save/load 快 101 倍；在 100Gb 网络上达到 92.1-94.8Gb/s 的校验后吞吐；活跃生成中的会话可在 block boundary 完成迁移并保持逐 bit 一致。没有给出标准 LLM baseline，而是与传统保存/加载方案比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the loss of elasticity in interactive world-model serving, where large live state caches pin sessions to a single GPU and prevent flexible scheduling.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving and inference-systems contribution rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant for researchers thinking about long-lived state, KV/cache mobility, and exactness constraints in interactive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes WorldMove, a mechanism to relocate a live session while guaranteeing bit-identical destination state or aborting the move. Key ideas include checksum-verified high-bandwidth cache transfer, convergence at generation block boundaries, an admissibility condition based on readout horizon and dirty rate, and a fleet-level schedulability test derived from the single-session condition.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 18.8 ms same-node migration, 101x faster than save/load, and 92.1-94.8 Gb/s verified throughput on 100 Gb fabric. An actively generating session can be migrated and resumed bit-for-bit at a block boundary. Evaluation is against conventional save/load rather than standard LLM baselines.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但对“状态不可重算时怎么做弹性调度”讲得很硬；只看迁移可行条件和 dirty-rate 约束就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the exact-state scheduling argument is solid; read only the admissibility condition and dirty-rate analysis.

paper.title: BlockServe: Block-Grained Continuous Batching for High-Throughput Diffusion LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Efficient serving of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is hindered by convergence heterogeneity: when batching multiple requests, different sequences converge at different rates, causing faster requests to stall behind slower stragglers and introducing compute bubbles and tail latency. We present BlockServe, a continuous batching framework that integrates block-grained scheduling -- immediately evicting completed requests at block boundaries -- with mixed-state execution that extends dual

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 diffusion LLM 在批量服务时的调度失配问题。dLLM 不是逐 token 生成，而是按 block 做多步去噪。不同请求会在不同 block 边界收敛或结束，快请求会被慢请求拖住，导致 active batch 中出现空转位置、GPU 利用率下降和尾延迟上升。AR LLM 的 token-level continuous batching 不能直接复用到这个场景。
summary.importance: 价值主要在 dLLM serving，而不是预训练目标本身。它给 diffusion LM 的系统可用性补了一块关键接口：block 长度、去噪步数、提前结束机制、padding 形状都会影响吞吐。对做新型语言建模范式的人，启发点是模型设计不能只看单请求延迟和质量，还要看 block 级执行能否被连续调度。否则 parallel denoising 的理论并行性会在真实多请求负载下被 straggler 抵消。
summary.technical_approach: BlockServe 把生成长度切成固定长度 block，每个 block 执行 S 步 diffusion denoising。系统维护一个 active set，允许不同请求处在不同 block index。核心是三部分。第一，block-grained scheduler 以一个 block-cycle 为调度量，执行完一个 block 后立即检查 EOS 或 block limit，完成的请求马上移出 active set，而不是等整个 batch 同步。第二，mixed-state memory manager 把不同 block 进度的请求重新映射到统一 dense tensor 中，通过显式 position alignment 和 gather-scatter indexing 支持异构 batch。这样可以沿用 dual cache 和 parallel decoding，不需要引入定制 kernel。第三，compute-aware admission controller 不再用固定 batch size，而是用 token budget 估计 dense tensor bounding box 的真实开销。当前 batch 的 row width、padding 和请求长度会影响可接纳请求数，因此控制器可以在长请求释放后回收 padding 空间，并补入更多短请求。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Dream 和 LLaDA 两类 dLLM 上进行，覆盖 5 个 benchmark。相对 Fast-dLLM，BlockServe 的吞吐提升为 1.9–10.6×，生成质量保持在相近水平。论文还报告 token-budget admission 可以把有效 batch capacity 提高约 2–4×。这些数字说明瓶颈主要来自调度和内存形状，而不是 diffusion step 本身的算子效率。更有用的实验信号是：完成请求在 block 边界立即驱逐后，compute bubbles 明显减少；使用 token budget 后，系统能利用 padding 回收带来的容量，而固定 batch size 做不到。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 convergence heterogeneity 的定义，它解释了为什么 AR continuous batching 不够用。再看 Figure 1 和 Algorithm 1，理解 block-cycle、eviction、refill 的执行顺序。方法部分重点看 scheduler、token budget admission 和 mixed-state memory manager。实验部分只需抓住三类结果：吞吐提升、质量是否退化、不同负载几何下的 capacity 变化。值得细看的是它对 block size、denoising steps、prompt/generation length 分布的敏感性；这些因素会反过来影响 dLLM 训练和推理接口的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a serving bottleneck specific to diffusion LLMs. These models generate blocks through iterative denoising rather than producing one token at a time. In a batch, requests can finish or converge at different block boundaries. Finished requests then wait for slower ones, leaving idle slots inside the active batch and increasing tail latency. Token-level continuous batching from autoregressive serving does not map cleanly to this execution model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on dLLM serving, but it is relevant to language-modeling research because it exposes a practical constraint of diffusion-style generation. Block length, number of denoising steps, early stopping, and padding geometry all affect whether parallel denoising translates into real throughput. For diffusion LM design, the lesson is that single-request latency is not enough; the generation process also needs a scheduling unit that works under concurrent workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: BlockServe divides each generation into fixed-length blocks, with each block processed by S denoising steps. It keeps an active set whose requests may be at different block indices. The system has three main components. A block-grained scheduler advances the active batch by one block-cycle, then immediately evicts requests that reach EOS or their block limit. A mixed-state memory manager packs heterogeneous requests into a unified dense tensor layout with explicit position alignment and gather-scatter indexing, extending dual cache and parallel decoding without custom kernels. A compute-aware admission controller replaces fixed batch size with a token budget based on the dense tensor bounding box. This lets the system recover padding and row-width slack after long requests leave, then admit more pending requests.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Dream and LLaDA on five benchmarks. BlockServe reports 1.9–10.6× higher throughput than Fast-dLLM while maintaining comparable generation quality. The token-budget admission policy increases effective batch capacity by about 2–4×. The useful signal is that much of the lost efficiency in batched dLLM inference comes from scheduling and tensor-shape waste, not only from the denoising computation itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the definition of convergence heterogeneity in the introduction. Then read Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 to understand the block-cycle execution loop. The most relevant method details are the block-grained scheduler, token-budget admission, and mixed-state memory layout. In the experiments, focus on throughput, quality retention, and how capacity changes under different request-length distributions. The sensitivity to block size, denoising steps, and prompt-generation length mix is the part most likely to inform diffusion LM design.

recommendation.zh: dLLM serving 的关键不是算子而是收敛异质性；只看调度设计和对 Fast-dLLM 的消融即可。
recommendation.en: The useful point is that dLLM serving is limited by convergence heterogeneity, not just kernels; read the scheduler and Fast-dLLM ablations.

paper.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding greatly increases the interactivity of autoregressive language models by trading off computation for extra tokens generated in a single forward pass. Factorized draft models are especially efficient because they predict future-token marginals in parallel, but their independence assumption causes acceptance rates to degrade sharply as the speculative budget grows. We analyze this limitation and introduce Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal tr

summary.core_problem: 解决 factorized draft model 在 speculative decoding 中因未来 token 独立假设过强而导致 acceptance rate 随预算增长快速下降的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作，但切中一个真实痛点：并行 draft 很快，却因为忽略条件依赖而在长 speculative budget 下失效。对做 serving、推测解码、以及非 Transformer 架构部署的人有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Weaver：在 factorized drafter 给出的 top-K future-token marginals 基础上，加一个轻量 autoregressive adapter 来构造 proposal tree，从而恢复候选 token 间的条件依赖，但避免完整词表投影的成本。系统侧又为 Gated Delta Net 层推导了 rollback-free 的 tree verification 算法，并在 SGLang 中实现优化 CUDA kernel。方法是模型侧和系统侧联合设计，不只是 kernel trick。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告相对标准 autoregressive decoding 达到 4.37× 加速，并超过高度优化的 DFlash baseline。重点实验应是随 speculative budget 增大时 acceptance rate 的退化对比，以及在 Gated Delta Net 架构上的验证。未给出模型参数与数据规模，说明论文更偏 serving/decoding 系统。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the sharp acceptance-rate drop in speculative decoding with factorized draft models, caused by overly strong independence assumptions over future tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, but it targets a real bottleneck: parallel drafting is fast yet breaks down at larger speculative budgets because it ignores conditional structure. It is useful for serving, speculative decoding, and deployment of non-standard architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that builds proposal trees from top-K future-token marginals predicted by a factorized drafter. This restores conditional dependencies among proposed tokens without paying for a full-vocabulary projection. On the systems side, it derives a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm for Gated Delta Net layers and implements optimized CUDA kernels in SGLang.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 4.37× speedup over autoregressive decoding and better performance than a highly optimized DFlash baseline. The key experiments likely focus on acceptance-rate degradation as speculative budget grows and on verification efficiency for Gated Delta Net models. No model or data scale is given, consistent with a serving-oriented paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 serving，这篇比一般 speculative decoding 小修小补更扎实：问题定义很准，先看 acceptance 随 budget 崩塌的分析，再看 rollback-free verification。
recommendation.en: If serving matters to you, this is more than a minor speculative-decoding tweak: read the analysis of acceptance collapse with larger budgets, then the rollback-free verification piece.

paper.title: Benchmarking KV-Cache Optimizations across Task Quality and System Performance for Long-Context Serving
paper.abstract: Large language model serving is increasingly limited by KV-cache growth under long-context workloads, yet existing KV-cache compression techniques are difficult to compare because they were evaluated on different models, tasks, budgets, and serving stacks. This paper presents a workload-aware benchmark of representative KV-cache optimization mechanisms spanning quantization, pruning, and merging, including KIVI, TurboQuant, SnapKV, and CaM, evaluated on LongBench-style multi-document QA, single-

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是长上下文推理中 KV-cache 优化方法难以公平比较的问题。已有方法通常各自使用不同模型、任务、压缩预算和 serving 栈，导致“压缩率高”是否真的带来端到端收益并不清楚。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接贡献不在预训练方法，而在长上下文 serving 评测。它有助于判断某类 KV-cache 压缩是否会改变长上下文能力的实际可用边界。对预训练研究员的启发点是：长上下文能力不能只看训练时 context length 或 benchmark 分数，还要看推理时 KV 内存、带宽、TTFT 和输出吞吐之间的约束。压缩率本身不是充分指标，实际收益取决于任务形态、上下文长度桶、模型结构和实现开销。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了一个 workload-aware benchmark，在统一设置下比较三类代表性 KV-cache 优化：量化类 KIVI、TurboQuant，剪枝/驱逐类 SnapKV，以及合并类 CaM。评测使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3，覆盖 LongBench 风格的多文档问答、单文档问答、few-shot learning 和摘要任务。系统指标包括 time-to-first-token、输出吞吐、prefill KV-cache 内存占用和实际压缩率。方法上的重点不是提出新的压缩算法，而是把质量指标和系统指标放在同一套实验协议里，避免只看 accuracy 或只看 memory saving 的片面结论。
summary.experiments: 实验选取 LongBench 中 6 个数据集衡量任务质量，并用 NarrativeQA、GovReport、Qasper 等长上下文数据集衡量系统性能。模型为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3。比较对象覆盖 KIVI、TurboQuant、SnapKV、CaM。结果强调几个现象：第一，不同压缩范式在不同任务上的质量损失差异明显，摘要、多文档 QA 和 few-shot learning 对 cache 处理的敏感性并不相同。第二，高压缩率不一定转化为更高输出吞吐或更低 TTFT，因为实现开销、访存模式和预填充阶段代价会抵消部分收益。第三，实际压缩率需要按上下文长度桶报告，平均数字容易掩盖长尾输入下的内存压力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看实验设置和结果分析部分，尤其是 workload 划分、指标定义、不同 context-length bucket 下的质量-效率曲线。背景部分可快速扫过，主要用于确认各类 KV-cache 方法的归类。最值得保留的是它的评测协议和指标组合：如果要做新的 KV-cache 压缩或长上下文 serving 方法，可以直接检查自己的实验是否同时覆盖任务质量、TTFT、吞吐、内存占用和实际压缩率。

summary_en.core_problem: This work addresses the lack of a fair comparison protocol for KV-cache optimization under long-context serving. Existing methods are usually evaluated with different models, tasks, compression budgets, and serving stacks, so it is hard to know whether a higher compression ratio translates into useful end-to-end gains.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation and systems benchmark rather than a pretraining method. It is still relevant for foundation-model research because long-context capability is constrained not only by training-time context length or benchmark scores, but also by KV memory, bandwidth, TTFT, and decoding throughput at inference time. A key lesson is that compression ratio alone is not a reliable proxy for serving performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a workload-aware benchmark that evaluates representative KV-cache optimization families under a unified setup: quantization methods such as KIVI and TurboQuant, pruning or eviction methods such as SnapKV, and merging methods such as CaM. The benchmark uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3. It covers LongBench-style multi-document QA, single-document QA, few-shot learning, and summarization. The measured metrics include task quality, time-to-first-token, output throughput, prefill KV-cache memory footprint, and realized compression ratio. The main methodological contribution is the joint measurement of quality and system behavior rather than a new compression algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates task quality on six LongBench-derived datasets and system performance on long-context workloads such as NarrativeQA, GovReport, and Qasper. It compares KIVI, TurboQuant, SnapKV, and CaM on two instruction-tuned 7B/8B-class models. The reported findings stress that task sensitivity differs across workloads: summarization, multi-document QA, and few-shot tasks do not tolerate the same cache manipulation patterns. The experiments also show that high nominal compression does not necessarily improve throughput or TTFT, because extra compute, memory access patterns, and prefill overhead can offset memory savings. Reporting results by context-length buckets is important, since aggregate compression numbers can hide the behavior on long inputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the experimental setup, metric definitions, and the quality-versus-systems trade-off plots across context-length buckets. The background section can be read quickly to check how the paper categorizes quantization, pruning, and merging methods. The most reusable part is the benchmark design: any new KV-cache compression method should be checked against task quality, TTFT, output throughput, memory footprint, and realized compression ratio under a shared workload mix.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果矩阵和长度分桶即可；它提醒内部压测别再用压缩率单指标选 KV-cache 方案。
recommendation.en: Read the result matrix and length buckets; it is a useful warning against choosing KV-cache methods by compression ratio alone.

paper.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. Furthermore, indiscriminately verifying these extended blocks wastes critical batch capacity on tokens with high rejection risks, severely degrading throughput in high-concurrency serving syst

summary.core_problem: 解决并行 speculative decoding 在长 draft block 上接受率快速下降，以及高并发 serving 中固定长度验证浪费 batch capacity 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与解码架构改进。它把 draft 质量和 verification 调度放在同一个 serving 目标下处理，比只优化单请求 latency 的 speculative decoding 更贴近真实部署。
summary.technical_approach: DSpark 使用半自回归 draft 架构：并行 backbone 一次产生多个候选 token，同时加入轻量 sequential module 建模 block 内 token 依赖，缓解后缀 token 的 acceptance decay。系统侧提出 confidence-scheduled verification，根据 draft token 置信度和负载动态决定每个请求验证多长，避免把 target model 的验证预算花在高拒绝风险 token 上。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 和具体提升数字。可确认的实验目标应包括 speculative decoding throughput、acceptance rate、block suffix acceptance decay，以及高并发 batch serving 下的吞吐表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two bottlenecks in speculative decoding: fast acceptance decay for long parallel draft blocks and wasted verification capacity under high-concurrency serving.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-system and decoding-architecture design. The useful part is that draft quality and load-aware verification are optimized together, which is closer to production serving than single-request speedup studies.
summary_en.technical_approach: DSpark uses a semi-autoregressive drafter: a parallel backbone proposes multiple tokens in one pass, while a lightweight sequential component injects intra-block dependency modeling to reduce suffix rejection. It also introduces confidence-scheduled verification, dynamically choosing verification lengths based on token confidence and serving load.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numeric gains. The likely evaluation axes are throughput, acceptance rate, suffix acceptance decay, and high-concurrency batch-serving efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University.

recommendation.zh: 服务侧值得扫，重点看 acceptance decay 的测量和动态验证策略；对预训练无直接动作，但会影响生成式架构的 serving 约束。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the acceptance-decay measurements and adaptive verification policy; it will not change pretraining, but it sharpens serving constraints for generative architectures.

paper.title: Quantize the Target, Quantize the Drafter: Efficient Inference with Qwen3.5-4B
paper.abstract: This report describes our approach to the Efficient Qwen Competition, where the goal is to enable low-latency serving of Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained NVIDIA A10G GPU. Our system combines a quantized target model with speculative decoding. To recover accuracy, we apply quantization-aware distillation to the target model while retaining the original quantization grid. To speed up decoding, a block-diffusion drafter specialized for the quantized target model is trained using a two-stage pro

summary.core_problem: 在资源受限的单卡 NVIDIA A10G（24GB VRAM）上部署 Qwen3.5-4B 时，需要同时满足低延迟推理与严格的质量阈值约束；现有单独使用量化或推测解码的方案，难以在目标模型精度、草稿模型接受率、端到端延迟三者之间取得平衡，尤其是量化后的目标模型分布偏移会破坏草稿模型的对齐。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：后训练量化与蒸馏、推测解码草稿模型的训练、目标-草稿的分布对齐是一个联合优化问题，不能割裂处理；两阶段草稿训练（先对齐高精度目标、再适配低精度目标）的思路可迁移到其他“目标模型发生分布偏移后需要重训辅助模块”的场景，例如持续预训练后重训推测解码草稿、重训检索增强的适配器等。
summary.technical_approach: 整体方案由量化目标模型与适配的推测解码系统两部分组成。目标模型侧：从现成的 AWQ INT4 PTQ 检查点出发，使用原始 BF16 模型作为教师，执行固定量化网格的量化感知蒸馏（QAD），通过前向 KL 做逐 token 蒸馏，权重更新后重新舍入回原 AWQ 尺度的 INT4 网格，最终以 W4A16 格式部署。推测解码侧：训练基于 DFlash 的块扩散草稿模型，利用目标模型多层隐藏状态作为条件，单次前向预测多个未来 token；采用两阶段训练，第一阶段用 BF16 目标模型及其生成的数据训练草稿，第二阶段用 QAD 后的量化目标模型及其生成的数据微调，解决量化导致的分布偏移。进一步对草稿模型做 GPTQ INT4 量化，并引入滑动窗口注意力（SWA）降低长上下文下的注意力开销，同时提升草稿接受长度。
summary.experiments: 该方案在 Efficient Qwen 竞赛中排名第 3（共 40+ 队伍）。端到端平均加速比达 6.978×：短输入（64/128 token）从 2582ms 降至 232ms，中等输入（2048/256）从 5441ms 降至 782ms，长输入（8192/256）从 6576ms 降至 2313ms。质量指标均满足阈值：MMLU-Pro 0.659（阈值 ≥0.621）、IFEval 0.845（阈值 ≥0.814）、GPQA-Diamond 0.667（阈值 ≥0.630）。组件消融显示：INT4 QAD 目标模型单独贡献 2.16× 加速；加入两阶段训练的 BF16 草稿后提升至 3.32×；草稿 INT4 量化后提升至 3.55×；草稿加入 SWA 后提升至 3.57×，其中 SWA 对长输入场景的增益最明显（从 2.49× 提升至 2.81×）。训练数据来自 Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 中随机抽取的 22 万样本，经目标模型再生后打包为 16384 长度序列。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点放在方法部分的两阶段草稿训练设计、QAD 的固定量化网格实现细节，以及表 2 的组件消融，理解每个模块对加速比和质量的边际贡献。图 2 的工作流示意图可快速建立整体认知。竞赛设置与主结果表 1 浏览即可，无需深入。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Deploying Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained single NVIDIA A10G GPU (24 GB VRAM) requires simultaneously meeting strict low-latency targets and quality thresholds. Standalone quantization or speculative decoding fails to balance target-model accuracy, draft-token acceptance rate, and end-to-end latency — in particular, distribution shift introduced by target-model quantization breaks alignment with a separately trained drafter.
summary_en.importance: The key takeaway for pretraining research is that post-training quantization/distillation, speculative-decoding drafter training, and target-drafter distribution alignment must be treated as a joint optimization problem rather than isolated steps. The two-stage drafter training recipe — first aligning to a high-precision target, then adapting to a low-precision shifted target — generalizes to other settings where auxiliary modules must be retrained after target-model distribution shifts, such as drafter refresh after continual pretraining or adapter adaptation for retrieval-augmented systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines a quantized target model with an adapted speculative decoding pipeline. On the target side, an existing AWQ INT4 post-training quantization checkpoint is used as initialization; quantization-aware distillation (QAD) is applied with the original BF16 model as teacher, minimizing per-token forward KL divergence while keeping the AWQ per-group quantization scales frozen. Updated BF16 weights are rounded back to the original INT4 grid at packing time, and the final model is served in W4A16 format. On the speculative decoding side, a lightweight DFlash-style block-diffusion drafter is trained on top of the frozen target, using multi-layer hidden states from the target as conditioning to predict multiple future tokens in one forward pass. A two-stage pipeline is used: Stage 1 trains the drafter from scratch against the BF16 target and its regenerated data; Stage 2 fine-tunes the drafter against the QAD quantized target and its regenerated data to absorb quantization-induced distribution shift. The drafter is further compressed with GPTQ INT4 post-training quantization and equipped with sliding-window attention to reduce long-context compute and improve acceptance length.
summary_en.experiments: The submission ranked 3rd out of 40+ teams in the Efficient Qwen Competition. End-to-end average speedup reaches 6.978× over the unoptimized baseline: short inputs (64/128 tokens) drop from 2582ms to 232ms, medium inputs (2048/256) from 5441ms to 782ms, and long inputs (8192/256) from 6576ms to 2313ms. All quality thresholds are satisfied: MMLU-Pro 0.659 (threshold ≥0.621), IFEval 0.845 (threshold ≥0.814), GPQA-Diamond 0.667 (threshold ≥0.630). Component ablation shows the INT4 QAD target alone delivers 2.16× speedup; adding the two-stage BF16 drafter raises it to 3.32×; INT4 quantization of the drafter brings it to 3.55×; sliding-window attention on the drafter reaches 3.57×, with the largest gains on long-context inputs (from 2.49× to 2.81×). Training data is regenerated by the target model from 220K randomly sampled examples from Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2, packed into 16,384-token sequences.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim pass, focus on the two-stage drafter training design, the fixed-grid QAD implementation details, and the component ablation table to understand the marginal contribution of each module to speedup and quality. The workflow diagram gives a quick overview of the full pipeline. The competition setup and main results table can be browsed lightly. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是会改写你对预训练的 prior，但把“量化 target + 量化 drafter + 两阶段适配”串成可落地 recipe，做 serving 的人该看实验分解。
recommendation.en: It will not change your pretraining priors, but the recipe of quantizing both target and drafter with two-stage adaptation is practical; read the ablations, not the hype.

paper.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
paper.abstract: Embodied AI models now span vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), but practical deployment remains fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot-side glue code, especially on heterogeneous edge devices. Existing inference runtimes are designed mainly for request-response serving and therefore do not satisfy the runtime contract of embodied deployment: multi-rate execution inside closed-loop control, latency-first batch-1 inference on

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 和 world-action embodied models 在异构机器人上部署时，被模型专用 Python 栈、后端假设和机器人胶水代码割裂的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理运行时和系统工程。它指出 embodied deployment 与常规 request-response serving 不同：需要闭环控制中的多速率执行、batch-1 低延迟推理，以及超出固定 token I/O 的机器人接口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Embodied.cpp，一个面向具身模型的可移植 C++ 推理运行时。系统将代表性 VLA 和 WAM 的执行路径抽象为五层：input adapters、sequence builders、backbone execution、head plugins、deployment adapters，并提供模块化多速率执行、低延迟融合推理和可扩展部署接口。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体机器人平台数量、模型规模、延迟、吞吐、内存或对比基线。论文重点似乎是架构分析和运行时设计，而不是新的模型训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles deployment fragmentation for VLA and world-action embodied models across heterogeneous robots, where model-specific Python stacks and robot-side glue code dominate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference runtime and systems abstraction. It highlights that embodied deployment differs from request-response serving: it needs multi-rate closed-loop execution, latency-first batch-1 inference, and embodied interfaces beyond fixed token I/O.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embodied.cpp is a portable C++ runtime for embodied models. It abstracts common execution into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters. It supports modular multi-rate execution, latency-oriented fused inference, and extensible robot deployment interfaces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not give model sizes, latency numbers, memory usage, robot counts, or quantitative baselines. The apparent emphasis is runtime architecture and deployment design rather than model training.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统分层即可；它提醒 VLA serving 的接口假设不同于 LLM，但没有预训练方法论增量。
recommendation.en: Only skim the runtime layering; it usefully exposes how VLA serving differs from LLM serving, but it does not move pretraining methodology.

paper.title: DiLaServe: High SLO Attainment Serving for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional autoregressive language models. By generating multiple tokens in parallel during each denoising step, they offer higher inference throughput while maintaining competitive quality. However, realizing these throughput gains while meeting latency SLOs in a serving system requires addressing challenges introduced by DLMs' unique characteristics. These include navigating the speed-quality tradeoff create

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）推理时每步都能并行解mask多个token，理论吞吐显著高于AR模型，但现有AR专用serving系统无法处理DLM独有的三个问题：置信度阈值带来的速度-质量显式旋钮、张量并行度与集群吞吐的trade-off、近似KV缓存刷新导致的步级计算成本不均。这些问题合起来使得DLM在生产环境中很难同时满足高吞吐和严格时延SLO。
summary.importance: 这是首个面向集群级DLM serving的完整系统设计。对预训练研究的价值在于：它把DLM特有的“置信度解mask步数、并行度、KV刷新策略”这些本来只在训练/建模时关心的超参，转化为服务端的动态调度决策；其测到的SLO提升和时延下降数字，直接给DLM是否值得在生产替代AR提供了工程化参考，也会反过来指导下一代DLM在训练时对齐serving友好的目标（例如更鲁棒的置信度校准）。
summary.technical_approach: DiLaServe基于vLLM和Ray扩展，调度粒度细化到单次去噪步。关键设计有三层：（1）请求级SLO感知阈值选择：根据每个请求剩余时延预算，选能在预算内完成的最高置信度阈值，优先保质量；（2）自适应负载控制：给每个请求设最大可用阈值上限，保证集群总负载不超过处理能力；（3）两阶段整数线性规划做集群重配置：第一阶段选每个张量并行度下的实例数，最大化平均置信度阈值与SLO达成率；第二阶段计算实例迁移方案以最小化服务中断。近似KV缓存的非均匀步级成本被直接纳入调度与ILP的耗时估计。
summary.experiments: 系统基于真实LLM服务流量trace评测。主要结果：相对基线，SLO达成率提升30.2个百分点，端到端时延降低46%，质量分数仅下降0.09；在多个准确性基准、高负载场景下，SLO达成率最高提升56.6个百分点，准确率仅下降0.9%。同时验证了近似KV缓存配合精细调度，能在几乎不损失质量的前提下进一步提升吞吐。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看Introduction中关于DLM与AR serving差异的三张示意图（置信度步数、并行度trade-off、KV刷新），直接建立问题直觉。方法部分重点读三部分：SLO阈值选择的决策逻辑、负载上界如何约束每个请求的阈值、两阶段ILP的决策变量与目标函数。实验部分读主表中SLO/时延/质量三者的trade-off数字即可。若要做系统实现再深入KV缓存刷新与调度器集成细节。预计阅读时间40–60分钟。
summary.authors_note: 文中未标注具体机构与作者名单，返回""

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can unmask multiple tokens in parallel per denoising step and thus have much higher theoretical throughput than autoregressive models. However, AR-oriented serving systems cannot handle three DLM-specific issues: the explicit speed-quality knob introduced by confidence-based unmasking, the throughput-latency trade-off of tensor parallelism under fluctuating load, and the per-step cost heterogeneity caused by approximate KV-cache refresh. Together these make it hard to deliver both high throughput and strict latency SLOs in production DLM deployments.
summary_en.importance: DiLaServe is the first complete cluster-scale serving system designed for DLMs. For pretraining research, its significance lies in translating modeling-time knobs — denoising steps, parallelism degree, KV refresh policy — into runtime scheduling decisions. The measured SLO and latency gains provide concrete engineering evidence for whether DLMs can replace AR models in production, and will feed back into how future DLMs are trained: better confidence calibration and serving-aware objectives during pretraining become first-order goals rather than afterthoughts.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiLaServe extends vLLM and Ray with scheduling at the granularity of individual denoising steps. The design has three layers: (1) SLO-aware threshold selection: for each request, pick the highest confidence threshold that still fits within the remaining latency budget, maximizing quality subject to the deadline; (2) adaptive load control: cap the maximum threshold each request can use so aggregate load stays within cluster capacity; (3) a two-stage integer linear program (ILP) for cluster reconfiguration: stage one chooses the number of instances at each tensor-parallel degree to maximize average confidence threshold and SLO attainment; stage two computes a migration plan minimizing service disruption. Non-uniform step costs from approximate KV caching are directly folded into scheduling cost estimates and the ILP.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation uses real-world LLM serving traces. Key results: 30.2 percentage point higher SLO attainment, 46% lower end-to-end latency, and only 0.09 quality-score drop versus baselines. Across multiple accuracy benchmarks under high load, SLO attainment improves by up to 56.6 percentage points with a 0.9% accuracy drop. Approximate KV caching combined with fine-grained scheduling is shown to further increase throughput with negligible quality loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a first pass, focus on the three schematic figures in the introduction that illustrate confidence-based step counts, the parallelism trade-off, and KV refresh — they give the right problem intuition immediately. In the method section, read the SLO-aware threshold policy, the load control bound on per-request thresholds, and the two-stage ILP's variables and objective. In experiments, the main tables summarizing the SLO / latency / quality trade-offs are sufficient. Dive into KV-cache refresh and scheduler integration details only if implementation is planned. Estimated reading time: 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DLM 若要和 AR 竞争，serving 约束绕不过；重点看调度目标如何把质量写进 SLO，而不是只看吞吐数字。
recommendation.en: If DLMs are to compete with AR models, serving constraints matter; read how the scheduler encodes quality into SLOs, not just the throughput plots.

paper.title: Speculative Pre-Positioning: Decoding Stateful Sessions to the Next Decision Point Off the Critical Path
paper.abstract: A stateless inference server (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) idles between requests while the accelerator waits; a stateful session reclaims that idle time. Speculative pre-positioning decodes the session forward to its next decision point with the target model's own forward pass and no draft model, moving the cross-request prefill and entry-decode off the critical path: the next request resumes from a pre-paid entry on its delta, or, when a confidence gate fires, is answered from a cached distribu

summary.core_problem: 解决状态无关推理服务在跨请求间空转、导致首 token 延迟仍受 prefill 和 entry decode 限制的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统侧的方法创新。它不改模型、不用 draft model，而是把一部分下一次请求的解码提前到关键路径之外做，对 serving 设计和 stateful session 有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 speculative pre-positioning：把会话视为有状态对象，在请求间隙用目标模型自身继续向前解码到下一个 decision point。下一次请求到来时，若用户输入只是该预先展开轨迹上的 delta，则可从已支付的 entry 继续；若置信门控触发，则直接用缓存分布回答，避免常规 decode。核心点是跨请求 prefill/entry-decode 前移、无 draft model、并用 confidence gate 控制误接收率。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键结果是：对能力足够的模型，门控覆盖率接近全覆盖，precision 约 87%；首 token 延迟约 1.0 ms，而仅有 prefix cache 的方案仍需约 39 ms decode。较小模型无法稳定通过门控，说明收益强依赖模型能力。未见完整参数量、数据和更系统 baseline 细节，结论目前更像系统原型信号。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the idle gaps of stateless inference servers, where first-token latency still pays cross-request prefill and entry decode on the critical path.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-side systems idea rather than a modeling change. It is interesting because it uses the target model itself, without a draft model, to move part of the next request's work off the critical path via stateful sessions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes speculative pre-positioning: treat a session as stateful and, during inter-request idle time, decode it forward with the target model to the next decision point. When the next request arrives, the server resumes from a pre-paid entry on the delta; if a confidence gate fires, it can answer from a cached distribution with no normal decode. The key ingredients are cross-request pre-computation, no auxiliary draft model, and a confidence gate to bound false accepts.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the main numbers are near-full gate coverage with about 87% precision for a capable model, and about 1.0 ms first-token latency versus roughly 39 ms decode even with prefix caching. A smaller model never clears the gate, suggesting the gain is capability-dependent. The abstract does not provide full model scales, datasets, or a broader baseline suite, so this currently reads as a promising systems prototype.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练论文，但它把“能力越强越能省推理”说得很具体；只看门控覆盖率、误接收界和与 prefix cache 的对比，别急着把 1ms 当通用结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it makes the 'better models can buy more serving efficiency' story concrete; read the gate coverage, false-accept bound, and prefix-cache comparison, not the 1 ms number as a universal result.

paper.title: HyperDFlash: MHC-Aligned Block Speculative Decoding with Gated Residual Reduction
paper.abstract: We present HyperDFlash, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework tailored to the novel multi-hyper-connection (MHC) architecture proposed by DeepSeek-V4. Despite the strong initial-token drafting performance of the native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) module in DeepSeek-V4, its draft accuracy degrades sharply at later positions, as error accumulation from unverified intermediate tokens harms acceptance rates. Although the original DFlash method supports efficient one-pass block drafting, i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但很工程化的问题：DeepSeek-V4 这类带 multi-hyper-connection（MHC）残差流的模型，原生带有 MTP 多 token 预测头，按理说很适合 speculative decoding，但实际只能把前一两个 draft token 做得较准，后面位置的接受率会快速下滑。原因不是单纯的 drafter 太弱，而是两层错配叠在一起：一是 MTP 顺序起草时会依赖尚未验证的中间 token，误差沿 block 累积；二是现有 DFlash 这类 block drafter 默认单路 hidden state，而 MHC 在预测前仍保留多路残差，若直接用普通中间层特征或静态线性 reducer 去适配，会破坏 target 预测路径的结构一致性。论文要解决的核心问题，就是如何为 MHC 架构设计一个与目标模型预测路径对齐的 block speculative decoding 方案，让长 block 的接受长度真正提升，而不是只在首 token 上有效。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在推理侧而不是预训练侧，但它有两点启发。第一，推理加速方法不能把 backbone 当成普通 Transformer 来套，像 MHC 这种残差组织方式会直接决定 drafter 应该看什么特征、怎样做 path collapse；也就是说，架构设计和 decoding 机制需要联动考虑。第二，这篇工作说明原生 MTP 并不自动等于好的 speculative drafter。MTP 的训练目标偏顺序外推，容易在未验证 token 上滚雪球；而 block drafting 如果能直接锚定 target 的最终预测态，接受长度会更稳。这个观察对以后做 pretrain-time MTP、multi-token head、以及训练时就为推理加速留接口的工作有参考价值。贡献量级偏工程优化，不是范式变化，但在“新架构如何配套推理机制”这个点上讲得比较实。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三个部件组成，核心思想都是“不要把 MHC 当成普通 hidden state 处理”，而是尽量复用 target 原生预测路径。

第一步是条件特征对齐。常规 DFlash 会取某个聚合后的中间层特征作为 drafter 的 target-side conditioning signal，这在普通 Transformer 上问题不大，但在 DeepSeek-V4 里，真正送入 LM head 之前的表示仍是 pre-collapse 的多路径 MHC residual。作者因此不再取中间层聚合特征，而是直接使用 target 已经为 MTP 缓存好的 final pre-collapse MHC residual state 作为 block drafting 的条件输入。这样做减少了额外计算，也避免 conditioning signal 与最终预测态之间的语义漂移。

第二步是提出 Inherited HC-Gate Reducer。普通 DFlash 的 reducer 本质是把 m 路 residual flatten 后做一个从 md 到 d 的大线性投影。论文指出这在 MHC 下有两个问题：参数量大，而且更关键的是它是静态线性映射，无法表达 target 自身 hc_head 那种输入相关的 path-wise gating。DeepSeek-V4 的 hc_head 先对 flatten 后的多路径残差做归一化，再为每条 path 预测一个独立 sigmoid gate，然后对整条 path 做缩放并聚合。HyperDFlash 在 drafter 侧复刻这一函数形式，加了轻量 per-path RMSNorm，并直接用 target hc_head 的权重初始化 gate 参数。这样 reducer 从一开始就与 target 的 collapse 机制同构，不需要从头学一个 dense projection。文中强调，参数减少三个数量级只是结构对齐带来的副产物，不是主要目标。

第三步是 targeted LM-head distillation。作者观察到 speculative decoding 的收益对前几个 draft position 特别敏感，因为只要前面某个 token 错了，后续接受前缀就被截断。因此训练时不是做泛化的全分布蒸馏，而是有针对性地用 KL distillation 去拉齐早期位置的 draft logits，重点提升最影响 accepted prefix length 的那些位置。这个设计和“平均提升整段 token 质量”不同，它更贴近 speculative decoding 的真实目标函数。

从方法取舍上看，这篇工作没有重新训练一个完全独立的 drafter，也没有改 target 结构，而是把 target 已有的 MHC/MTP 中间产物拿来复用，再用最小改动把 DFlash 适配到 MHC。这个路线更像是架构感知的 decoding co-design。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验覆盖 math、code、conversation 三类任务，比较对象包括原生 MTP、vanilla DFlash，以及 HyperDFlash。论文的主结论很明确：HyperDFlash 在 accepted token length 和端到端生成速度上都优于前两者，且优势主要来自后续 draft 位置接受率下降更慢，而不是只提升第一个 token 的命中。

能从正文中明确提取的一个硬数字是参数规模：对于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，若用通用 DFlash 的静态全连接 reducer，fc: R^{md}→R^d 约有 6700 万参数；而 Inherited HC-Gate Reducer 由于只做 path-wise gating，参数量低三个数量级。这说明作者不是靠堆大 reducer 提升 draft 质量，而是靠结构对齐。

实验逻辑上，关键消融应当包括三类：1）conditioning feature 用中间层聚合特征还是 final pre-collapse MHC residual；2）reducer 用普通 dense projection 还是 inherited gated reducer；3）是否加入 targeted KL distillation。按方法叙述推断，这三项都会对 accepted prefix length 有可分离贡献，其中第二项最能体现“与 MHC 对齐”的必要性，第三项则更偏向提升早期位置接受率。若精读全文，建议重点核对各 benchmark 上的 acceptance-by-position 曲线、平均 accepted length、以及真实 wall-clock speedup，而不只看 token/s，因为 speculative decoding 很容易出现理论接受率提升但系统收益有限的情况。

由于当前提供的全文片段不含完整表格和最终数值，无法安全填写更细的提升幅度、batch 设置和 block size 细节。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看方法设计是否真的抓住了 MHC 的结构特征。建议阅读顺序：
1. 先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认作者要解决的不是一般 speculative decoding，而是 MTP 在后续位置接受率塌陷的问题。
2. 再看 Figure 2 和 Section 2.1/2.2。这里是全文最有信息量的部分。重点理解为什么 final pre-collapse residual 比中间层特征更合适，以及为什么 static linear reducer 在 MHC 下是结构错配，不只是参数多。
3. 看 reducer 公式和与 target hc_head 的对应关系。若你关心架构—推理解耦是否成立，这里最值得细想。
4. 实验部分优先看 acceptance rate 随 draft position 的曲线、平均 accepted length、真实 latency/speedup。只看总体吞吐容易误判。

预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。若你做推理系统或在设计带 MTP/MHC 的新 backbone，这篇值得多看一遍；若你只关心预训练目标本身，可以把它当作“架构会反向约束 decoding 设计”的案例。
