summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a fairly specific systems problem: DeepSeek-V4 has a native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) module and a multi-hyper-connection (MHC) residual design, so it looks like a natural fit for speculative decoding. In practice, however, native MTP only drafts the first one or two positions well; acceptance drops sharply at later positions. The issue is not just weak drafting. There are two mismatches. First, sequential MTP drafting compounds errors because later draft positions depend on unverified earlier draft tokens. Second, existing block drafters such as DFlash assume a conventional single-stream hidden state, while MHC keeps multiple residual paths until right before prediction. If one simply plugs in intermediate features or a generic dense reducer, the drafter becomes misaligned with the target model’s actual prediction pathway. The core problem is therefore how to build a block speculative decoding scheme that is structurally aligned with MHC, so that accepted prefix length improves beyond the first token or two.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly on the inference side, not pretraining proper, but it carries two useful lessons for foundation-model work. First, decoding acceleration cannot treat every backbone as a generic Transformer. Architectural choices such as MHC directly constrain what features the drafter should condition on and how multi-path states should be collapsed. Second, a native MTP head is not automatically a strong speculative drafter. MTP is trained in a sequential extrapolation regime, which makes it vulnerable to error accumulation on unverified tokens. A block drafter anchored to the target’s final prediction state can be much more stable. That matters for future work on pretrain-time MTP, multi-token heads, and architectures designed with downstream decoding acceleration in mind. The contribution is incremental rather than paradigm-shifting, but the architecture-aware decoding argument is concrete and well motivated.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components, all built around the same principle: do not force MHC into the mold of a standard single-stream hidden state.

First, the conditioning signal is changed. Standard DFlash-style drafting uses an aggregated intermediate-layer feature from the target model as the conditioning context. For DeepSeek-V4, that is a poor proxy because the representation right before the LM head is still a pre-collapse multi-path MHC residual. HyperDFlash therefore uses the target’s final pre-collapse MHC residual state, already stored for MTP, as the target-side conditioning feature for block drafting. This reduces redundant computation and keeps the drafter closer to the target’s actual prediction state.

Second, the paper introduces an Inherited HC-Gate Reducer. A generic DFlash reducer flattens the m-path residual and applies a large static projection from md to d. The paper argues that this is fundamentally mismatched to MHC: it is parameter-heavy, but more importantly it cannot express the target model’s input-dependent path aggregation. DeepSeek-V4’s native hc_head first normalizes the flattened multi-path residual, then predicts one independent sigmoid gate per path, and finally scales and aggregates the full residual paths. HyperDFlash mirrors this functional form on the drafter side, adds a lightweight per-path RMSNorm, and initializes the gate parameters from the pretrained target hc_head. So the drafter starts from a collapse mechanism already aligned with the target’s own prediction pathway, instead of learning an arbitrary dense reduction from scratch.

Third, the training objective includes targeted LM-head distillation. The paper emphasizes that speculative decoding is disproportionately sensitive to early draft positions: once an early token is wrong, the accepted prefix is truncated. Instead of generic full-distribution distillation, they apply a targeted KL objective to improve early-position draft logits, where gains matter most for accepted block length.

A notable design choice is that the paper does not retrain a fully separate drafter or alter the target architecture. It reuses target-side MHC/MTP states and adapts DFlash with minimal but architecture-aware changes. This is better understood as decoding co-design with the backbone, rather than a generic speculative decoding recipe.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the experiments cover math, code, and conversational benchmarks, with comparisons against native MTP and vanilla DFlash. The main empirical claim is clear: HyperDFlash improves both accepted token length and end-to-end generation speed, and the gain comes from slower degradation at later draft positions rather than only a better first-token hit rate.

One concrete number stated in the text concerns parameterization. For DeepSeek-V4-Flash, a generic DFlash reducer using a dense projection fc: R^{md} to R^d would require about 67M parameters. The proposed inherited gated reducer reduces this by roughly three orders of magnitude. That is important because the improvement is not coming from a larger reducer; it comes from structural alignment.

The critical ablations should include: (1) intermediate aggregated features versus final pre-collapse MHC residual as the conditioning source, (2) a generic dense reducer versus the inherited HC-gate reducer, and (3) with versus without targeted KL distillation. Based on the method section, these components likely contribute in separable ways: the reducer choice is the clearest test of MHC alignment, while the distillation term should mostly help early-position acceptance. For a careful read, the most informative plots are acceptance-by-position curves, average accepted prefix length, and real wall-clock speedup. Token throughput alone can be misleading in speculative decoding.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so I cannot safely provide exact benchmark deltas, block sizes, or latency numbers beyond what is explicitly stated.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper unless you are actively working on speculative decoding or architecture-aware serving. Read it in this order:
1. Introduction and Figure 1: understand that the target problem is not generic speculative decoding, but the positional collapse of native MTP acceptance.
2. Figure 2 and Sections 2.1/2.2: this is the core. Focus on why final pre-collapse residuals are better conditioning signals than intermediate features, and why a static linear reducer is structurally wrong for MHC.
3. The reducer equations and their correspondence to the target hc_head: this is the most interesting part if you care about whether decoding can remain architecture-agnostic.
4. In experiments, prioritize acceptance-versus-position curves, average accepted length, and actual latency/speedup over aggregate token/s.

Roughly 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. It is most useful for readers thinking about MTP-style pretraining heads, MHC-like backbones, or inference mechanisms that should be anticipated during model design.

recommendation.zh: MTP+多残差路径架构的推测解码不能照搬EAGLE/DFlash，对齐pre-collapse residual这点值得抄；数字不全，重点看§3的结构对齐设计。
recommendation.en: Don't port EAGLE/DFlash naively to MTP + multi-path-residual models; the pre-collapse-residual alignment trick is worth stealing; numbers are incomplete—read §3 for the structural design.

paper.title: NaviCache: Test-Time Self-Calibration Caching for Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) is constrained by immense computational costs. While offline calibration-based acceleration suffers from calibration data dependency, prohibitive calibration duration, and susceptibility to distribution shifts, offline calibration-free methods eliminate these hurdles. However, since they rely on instantaneous zero-order approximations where the mapping between input and output differences varies in real-time, they are susceptible to observational noise and ignore th

summary.core_problem: 解决视频扩散模型推理成本高、现有缓存加速方法依赖离线校准或容易受扩散轨迹非平稳性影响的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法：把视频 diffusion 的 feature evolution 建模为测试时自校准的状态估计问题，减少对离线 calibration data 的依赖。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NaviCache，一个 plug-and-play test-time self-calibration caching 方法。它把特征演化类比为惯性导航系统，跟踪输入变化与输出变化之间的相对耦合，并用 dual-state estimation 同时估计 feature change ratio 及其潜在漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频生成模型规模、数据集、速度提升和质量指标数值；主要声称相比离线校准和零阶近似式缓存，更能适应分布变化和扩散轨迹的非平稳性。
summary.authors_note: Qi Tian、Fei Wu、Zhou Zhao 是较知名的视觉与多媒体研究者；具体机构未在给定元数据中确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high inference cost of video diffusion models and the brittleness of existing cache-based acceleration methods under calibration dependence and non-stationary diffusion trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for video generation. It reframes feature caching as a test-time self-calibrated state estimation problem, avoiding heavy offline calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: NaviCache is a plug-and-play caching method that treats feature evolution as an inertial navigation problem. It models the relative coupling between input and output changes and uses a dual-state estimator to track both the feature change ratio and its latent drift.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include model scale, datasets, speedup numbers, or quality metrics. It claims improved robustness over offline calibration and instantaneous zero-order approximation methods.
summary_en.authors_note: Qi Tian, Fei Wu, and Zhou Zhao are recognizable researchers in vision and multimedia; affiliations are not confirmed from the supplied metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看状态估计式缓存建模；对 LLM 预训练没有直接信号，扩散 serving 可作为旁路参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the state-estimation view of caching; it has little direct signal for LLM pretraining but is useful side knowledge for diffusion serving.

paper.title: Quantization Inflates Reasoning: Token Inflation as a Hidden Cost of Low-Bit Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Quantization is widely used to reduce the inference cost of large language models, but its effect on reasoning models is not fully captured by final-answer accuracy or per-token latency. We show that low-bit post-training quantization can introduce a hidden test-time compute cost: quantized reasoning models often generate longer chains of thought even when they still answer correctly. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, scientific question answering, and agentic tool-use benchmarks,

summary.core_problem: 现有低比特训练后量化（PTQ）的评估体系仅关注最终答案准确率和单token延迟，完全忽略了推理类LLM的核心成本变量——推理阶段生成的思维链（CoT）token数量；低比特PTQ会导致推理模型在正确率基本不变的情况下生成更长的推理轨迹，产生隐藏的端到端推理成本膨胀，抵消甚至超过量化带来的单token加速收益。
summary.importance: 该工作系统性揭示了量化与推理计算行为的耦合效应，填补了推理模型量化评估的关键盲区。对预训练-部署闭环的具体影响包括三点：1）推翻了“量化后正确率不变则部署成本降低”的默认假设，要求推理模型部署时必须测量端到端延迟，而非仅看单token速度；2）为后训练、量化感知训练（QAT）提出了新的优化目标——控制推理token开销，而非仅约束权重精度损失；3）对推理增强预训练（如R1类模型的训练）有间接启示：模型的推理长度偏好对权重的数值精度非常敏感，训练时的数值稳定性会直接影响部署时的推理成本。
summary.technical_approach: 1）定义核心指标CoT Token Inflation Ratio（CTIR）：量化模型与全精度基线在同一benchmark上的平均推理token数的比值，用于量化膨胀程度，计算时严格拆分推理token（<think>标签内或CoT段）与答案token，避免指标偏差。2）严格控制变量实验：设置temperature=0消除采样噪声，仅评估权重-only PTQ（隔离量化算法、激活量化等其他变量），覆盖4B到30B参数的dense、MoE两类推理架构，横跨数学、代码、科学问答、工具调用四类重推理任务，同时加入轻推理的通用语言benchmark作为对照组，验证膨胀效应的任务相关性。3）行为分析：对推理轨迹的语义重复度、中间步骤数量做统计，区分“冗余措辞”和“重复推理”两类膨胀来源，验证额外推理步骤对正确率无贡献。4）缓解策略评估：分别测试prompt调控（要求推理简洁）、解码约束（限制最大推理长度）、量化感知训练（QAT）三种方案的效果，对比其准确率-长度的trade-off。
summary.experiments: 评测模型包括Qwen3-4B-Thinking、Phi-4-14B（dense架构），Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking（MoE架构）；量化方法覆盖GPTQ、AWQ、SmoothQuant、ParoQuant等主流权重-only PTQ，位宽为INT4、INT3。核心结果：1）INT4/INT3量化在多数推理benchmark上最终答案准确率损失<2%（几乎无损），但CTIR可达1.15~1.4（推理token数增加15%~40%）；例如MoE模型的INT3量化在AIME25上准确率仅降0.3%，但CTIR达1.32。2）膨胀程度与任务推理强度正相关：轻推理的通用语言benchmark（HellaSwag、MMLU-Pro）的CTIR仅1.02~1.07，几乎无膨胀。3）行为层面：量化模型的推理轨迹中，语义重复片段占比提升8%~15%，中间验证步骤数量增加20%以上，这些额外步骤未带来正确率提升。4）缓解策略效果：prompt要求简洁仅在部分benchmark上降低CTIR，同时导致准确率下降3%~5%；解码硬截断推理长度会大幅降低正确率；QAT可将准确率损失控制在1%以内，同时将CTIR降到1.05以内，是当前最优的缓解方向。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先级：1）第4章的核心实验结果表格，重点对比不同模型、不同量化位宽、不同任务下的CTIR与准确率变化，这是全文的核心实证依据；2）第6章的行为分析部分，明确膨胀的具体表现是重复推理而非冗余措辞，理解其对计算成本的实际影响；3）第5章CTIR的定义与计算细节，注意推理token与答案token的拆分逻辑，避免后续复现或使用时出现指标偏差；4）第7章的缓解策略对比，重点分析QAT能同时控制精度损失和token膨胀的内在原因。可跳过附录中具体量化算法的参数配置细节（除非从事量化工程落地）。值得深挖的方向：推理模型的数值精度如何影响其“终止推理、输出答案”的决策阈值，是否可以在预训练、RL训练阶段引入推理长度正则化，来提升模型的量化鲁棒性，从训练源头降低部署时的隐藏成本。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation protocols for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) only track final-answer accuracy and per-token latency, completely ignoring a core cost variable for reasoning-optimized LLMs: the number of chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens generated at inference time. Low-bit PTQ can cause reasoning models to produce significantly longer reasoning trajectories while maintaining nearly unchanged answer accuracy, creating a hidden end-to-end inference cost inflation that offsets or even outweighs the per-token speedup from quantization.
summary_en.importance: This work systematically reveals the coupling effect between quantization and reasoning computational behavior, filling a critical blind spot in the evaluation of quantized reasoning models. Its concrete impacts on the pretraining-deployment loop include three points: 1) It overturns the default assumption that "unchanged accuracy after quantization equals lower deployment cost", requiring end-to-end latency measurement (instead of per-token speed only) for reasoning model deployment. 2) It proposes a new optimization target for post-training and quantization-aware training (QAT): controlling reasoning token overhead, rather than only constraining weight precision loss. 3) It provides indirect implications for reasoning-enhanced pretraining (e.g., R1-style model training): a model's reasoning length preference is highly sensitive to weight numerical precision, so numerical stability during training directly affects inference cost at deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Define the core metric CoT Token Inflation Ratio (CTIR): the ratio of the average number of reasoning tokens generated by a quantized model versus its full-precision baseline on the same benchmark, used to quantify inflation degree. Calculation strictly splits reasoning tokens (within <think> tags or CoT segments) and answer tokens to avoid metric bias. 2) Strict controlled variable experiments: set temperature=0 to eliminate sampling noise, evaluate weight-only PTQ only (to isolate variables like quantization algorithm and activation quantization), cover dense and MoE reasoning architectures with 4B to 30B parameters, span four reasoning-heavy task categories (mathematics, code generation, scientific QA, agentic tool use), and add light-reasoning general language benchmarks as control groups to verify the task correlation of inflation. 3) Behavioral analysis: quantify semantic repetition rate and number of intermediate steps in reasoning trajectories, distinguish two inflation sources (redundant wording vs repeated reasoning), and verify that extra reasoning steps contribute nothing to accuracy. 4) Mitigation strategy evaluation: test three approaches respectively (prompt regulation for concise reasoning, decoding constraints on maximum reasoning length, QAT) and compare their accuracy-length trade-offs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated models include Qwen3-4B-Thinking, Phi-4-14B (dense), and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking (MoE). Quantization methods cover mainstream weight-only PTQ approaches including GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, ParoQuant, with bit widths INT4 and INT3. Core results: 1) INT4/INT3 quantization introduces <2% final-answer accuracy loss (nearly lossless) on most reasoning benchmarks, but CTIR reaches 1.15–1.4 (15%–40% increase in reasoning tokens). For example, INT3 quantization on the MoE model reduces AIME25 accuracy by only 0.3% but reaches a CTIR of 1.32. 2) Inflation degree positively correlates with task reasoning intensity: CTIR for light-reasoning general language benchmarks (HellaSwag, MMLU-Pro) is only 1.02–1.07, with negligible inflation. 3) Behavioral findings: quantized models show 8%–15% higher proportion of semantically repeated segments in reasoning trajectories, and the number of intermediate verification steps increases by over 20%, with these extra steps bringing no accuracy improvement. 4) Mitigation performance: Prompting for conciseness only reduces CTIR on a subset of benchmarks, while causing 3%–5% accuracy drop; hard truncation of reasoning length severely hurts accuracy; QAT keeps accuracy loss within 1% while suppressing CTIR to below 1.05, making it the most promising mitigation direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Priority reading order: 1) Core experimental result tables in Section 4, especially the comparison of CTIR and accuracy changes across models, quantization bit widths, and tasks — this is the core empirical evidence of the paper. 2) Behavioral analysis in Section 6, to clarify that inflation manifests as repeated reasoning rather than redundant wording, and understand its actual impact on computational cost. 3) CTIR definition and calculation details in Section 5, especially the split logic between reasoning tokens and answer tokens, to avoid metric bias in reproduction or application. 4) Mitigation strategy comparison in Section 7, focus on the internal reason why QAT can simultaneously control precision loss and token inflation. Skip appendix sections on specific quantization algorithm parameter configurations (unless working on quantization engineering deployment). Worth deeper exploration: How numerical precision of reasoning models affects their decision threshold for "terminating reasoning and outputting answers", and whether reasoning length regularization can be introduced during pretraining or RL training to improve model quantization robustness, reducing hidden deployment costs from the training source.

recommendation.zh: 量化reasoning模型的'准确率不掉=没事'被打脸：token变长直接吞掉端到端加速，立刻在内部Serving测算里复现这个指标。
recommendation.en: Kills the naive 'accuracy preserved, speedup achieved' story for quantized reasoning models—token inflation eats the wall-clock win; add this metric to your serving eval now.

paper.title: Dustin: Draft-Augmented Sparse Verification for Efficient Long-Context Generation with Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: While speculative decoding improves inference throughput for multi-batch long-context Large Language Models (LLMs), its efficiency is often limited by a verification bottleneck where Key-Value (KV) cache loading dominates latency. Existing compression methods fail in this regime: static eviction incurs accuracy loss due to saliency shift, while dynamic selection introduces prohibitive computational overhead during the verification path. We propose Dustin, a sparse verification framework designed

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文 speculative decoding 在真实大模型推理里最卡的一段：verification 阶段的 KV cache 读取。问题不在于 speculative decoding 没有减少算力，而在于长上下文、多 batch 下，验证阶段仍要反复搬运大体量 KV，内存带宽成为主瓶颈。已有 KV 压缩方法要么做静态淘汰，容易因为 saliency shift 丢掉后续会变重要的 token；要么做动态选择，但每步重算重要性本身就太贵，放在 verification 路径上得不偿失。作者要解决的是：能不能在 speculative verification 这个特殊场景下，用足够便宜的方式找出未来几个验证步真正关键的 KV token，从而在不明显伤害生成质量的前提下，把 verification 的带宽成本压下去。
summary.importance: 它主要属于推理效率，而不是预训练方法，但对基座研究仍有两点实际价值。第一，长上下文模型的训练与部署越来越一体化，很多 pretrain 研究最后都要落到 32k、64k 甚至更长上下文的 serving 约束上；这篇工作把“verification 不是算力瓶颈，而是 KV 读带宽瓶颈”讲得很具体。第二，它说明在多步验证场景里，token 重要性不是单靠 target model 的历史注意力就能稳定预测的，因为未来几个 token 的 saliency 会漂移；引入 draft model 的 lookahead 信号后，才能更接近 verification 真正需要的 token 子集。这种“用便宜模型预测昂贵模型未来注意力”的思路，对训练期做稀疏注意力近似、课程式上下文裁剪也有启发。
summary.technical_approach: Dustin 的核心是一个面向 speculative verification 的稀疏 KV 选择框架。作者先把问题形式化成在验证窗口 [i, i+w-1] 上选择固定预算 k 个 KV 位置，使保留下来的注意力质量尽量接近全量注意力。为此定义了 ARR，衡量被选 token 覆盖了多少原始注意力质量，并在附录里说明 ARR 与输出 logit 的 KL divergence 强负相关，因此可作为稀疏前向 fidelity 的代理指标。方法上有两个关键设计。第一是 hybrid token selection：不用单一来源估计 token 重要性，而是融合 target model 的 historical attention 与 draft model 的 lookahead attention。前者便宜且反映已发生的依赖，后者能看到 verification 窗口内未来 token 的潜在关注点，适合应对 saliency shift。第二是 sparse estimation：为了避免动态选择本身过慢，作者不在所有层和头上完整物化注意力，而是搜索一个最小但足够有效的 attention head 子集，只在这些头上做重要性估计。这样做的逻辑很清楚：verification 路径里任何额外计算都必须比“直接跑全 KV”更便宜，否则压缩没有意义。文中还把 Dustin 与几类基线区分开来：静态 eviction 方法因为永久丢上下文，在多步验证里容易失真；基于完整 attention 重打分的方法精度高但开销过大；Quest 这类 page-level 近似虽然避免精确 QK^T，但估分仍有不小成本，且不如作者的稀疏估计快。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Llama3 与 Qwen2.5 系列，评测集包括 LongBench 和 PG-19。分析部分主要用 Qwen2.5-32B 作为 target model、Qwen2.5-0.5B 作为 draft model，并在 LongReward 数据上研究时间维度和层间行为，数据平均上下文长度约 13.5k。系统结果里，作者报告在 Qwen2.5-72B、32k context、batch size 16 的设定下，self-attention 计算可加速 27.85×，最终 decoding phase 达到最高 9.17× 提速，同时保持很小的精度损失。引言里还有一个很关键的系统观察：在 32k 输入长度、batch 16 时，verification 最多占到总解码延迟的 87.5%，这解释了为什么优化 verification 比继续抠 draft 端更有收益。方法验证上，作者先证明只看历史注意力不够，因为 verification 一次要处理未来 w 个 token，过去的 saliency 不能稳定外推；只看 draft lookahead 也不够，因为小模型对重要 token 的判断有偏差。混合策略在 ARR 上更接近 oracle，且 ARR 与 logit KL 的相关性支持它作为代理指标。文中还提到一个负结果：如果用朴素方式在所有头和层上重算注意力重要性，超过 4k token 后，额外开销会比直接做全缓存 self-attention 还大，这个结论对任何想在 verification 路径上做“精细动态选择”的方法都很关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议按“问题诊断—指标—系统设计—端到端结果”的顺序看。先看 Introduction，抓住 verification 在长上下文 speculative decoding 里的带宽瓶颈，以及静态/动态 KV 压缩各自为什么不合适。然后看 Observation 部分，尤其是作者如何比较 historical attention 和 lookahead attention 的局限，这一段决定了 hybrid 设计是否站得住。接着看 ARR 的定义和它与 logit KL 的关系，理解作者为什么用 ARR 做快速分析。最后看主结果表，重点关注 32k、batch 16、72B 这类最接近真实部署压力的设定。若只花 20 分钟，读引言、ARR 定义、hybrid policy、head subset search、主结果表和 5.4.1 的开销分析即可。若想判断能否迁移到自己的系统，值得细看不同 KV budget、不同 verification window、不同模型家族下的精度-速度折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the real bottleneck of long-context speculative decoding: verification-time KV cache loading. In large-batch, long-context generation, speculative decoding reduces some compute, but verification still has to read massive KV caches, so memory bandwidth dominates latency. Existing KV compression methods are a poor fit here. Static eviction loses accuracy because token saliency shifts over time, while dynamic selection often costs too much because importance has to be recomputed on the verification path. The paper asks whether one can cheaply identify the small subset of KV tokens that matter for a multi-step verification window, so that verification becomes sparse without noticeably hurting generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model work for two reasons. First, long-context pretraining and long-context serving are increasingly coupled in practice; once models are trained for 32k or longer contexts, deployment is constrained by KV bandwidth rather than pure FLOPs. The paper makes that bottleneck concrete. Second, it shows that token importance in speculative verification cannot be predicted well from target-model history alone because saliency drifts across future steps. Bringing in lookahead signals from the draft model is therefore not just a heuristic but a way to better match the actual verification objective. That idea may transfer to training-time sparse attention approximations or context-selection schemes where a cheap model predicts what the expensive model will need next.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dustin is a sparse verification framework specialized for speculative decoding. The problem is formulated as selecting a fixed budget of k KV positions for a verification window [i, i+w-1], with the goal of preserving as much of the original attention mass as possible. To evaluate selection quality, the paper defines Attention Recovery Rate (ARR), which measures how much attention mass is retained by the selected KV subset. The appendix further shows that ARR is strongly negatively correlated with output-logit KL divergence, making it a useful proxy for sparse-forward fidelity. The method has two main components. The first is a hybrid token-selection policy that combines historical attention from the target model with lookahead attention from the draft model. Historical attention is cheap and reflects established dependencies, while draft lookahead provides information about future tokens inside the verification block and helps handle saliency shift. The second is a sparse estimation scheme designed to keep the selector itself cheap. Instead of materializing attention importance across all heads and layers, Dustin searches for a minimal subset of attention heads that is sufficient for accurate importance estimation. This is a crucial systems choice: any dynamic selector on the verification path must be cheaper than simply running dense attention over the full KV cache, otherwise compression is pointless. The paper also positions Dustin against several baselines. Static eviction permanently discards context and therefore struggles under saliency shift. Full dynamic rescoring is accurate but too expensive. Page-level approximations such as Quest avoid exact QK^T but still incur non-trivial scoring overhead and remain slower than Dustin’s sparse estimator in the authors’ analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover the Llama3 and Qwen2.5 families on LongBench and PG-19. The analysis sections mainly use Qwen2.5-32B as the target model and Qwen2.5-0.5B as the draft model, with LongReward as the analysis dataset, whose average context length is about 13.5k tokens. The headline system result is up to 27.85x acceleration for self-attention computation and up to 9.17x decoding-phase speedup on Qwen2.5-72B at 32k context length and batch size 16, with only minimal accuracy loss. One of the most informative observations appears early: at 32k input length and batch size 16, verification can account for as much as 87.5% of total decoding latency. That explains why optimizing verification matters more than squeezing a bit more speed from the draft side. On the method side, the paper shows that historical attention alone is insufficient because speculative verification processes a future block of w tokens, so past saliency does not extrapolate reliably. Draft lookahead alone is also insufficient because the smaller model is imperfect at predicting which tokens the target model will care about. The hybrid policy gets closer to the oracle in ARR, and the ARR-to-logit-KL relationship supports ARR as a meaningful proxy. Another practically important result is negative: a naive dynamic selector that recomputes importance from all heads and layers becomes slower than full-cache self-attention beyond 4k tokens. That finding is broadly relevant for any method that tries to do fine-grained dynamic KV selection during verification.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim order is: bottleneck diagnosis, metric, system design, then end-to-end results. Start with the introduction to understand why verification, not drafting, dominates latency in long-context speculative decoding, and why both static and standard dynamic KV compression are mismatched to this regime. Then read the observation section comparing historical attention and draft lookahead; this is the empirical basis for the hybrid policy. Next, read the ARR definition and the evidence connecting ARR to logit KL, since ARR is the paper’s main analysis tool. Finally, inspect the main result tables, especially the 32k, batch-16, 72B settings that are closest to realistic deployment pressure. If time is limited to about 20 minutes, focus on the introduction, ARR, the hybrid policy, the head-subset search, the main throughput tables, and the overhead analysis in the section discussing naive dynamic scoring. If evaluating transferability to another serving stack, pay extra attention to the trade-offs across KV budgets, verification window sizes, and model families.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 serving 的人值得看；它不是改模型而是改验证路径，读 latency breakdown 和 token/head 选择开销， headline speedup 先别全信。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about long-context serving: it attacks the verification path rather than the model, but check the latency breakdown and selector overhead before trusting the headline speedup.

paper.title: EnerInfer: Energy-Aware On-Device LLM Inference
paper.abstract: On-device LLM inference is increasingly attractive for privacy-preserving, reliable, and cost-effective deployment, yet its energy and thermal costs remain a critical bottleneck. Existing systems primarily optimize for decoding speed, implicitly assuming that faster execution is always preferable. We show instead that on-device LLM inference often has exploitable configuration slack: modestly lowering NPU and memory frequencies preserves quality of experience (QoE) while substantially improving

summary.core_problem: 移动端 LLM 推理不应只优化 tokens/s；在很多交互场景里，默认满频运行 NPU 和内存会带来不必要的能耗与发热，而用户体验只需要满足一个较低但稳定的吞吐下限。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对端侧模型部署和模型设计有参考价值。它提醒模型研究者：端侧 LLM 的可用性不只由参数量、量化精度和解码速度决定，还受 NPU/DDR 频率、内存带宽瓶颈、热约束和请求到达模式影响。对做小模型、端侧模型、推理友好架构的人，能提供一个更接近真实设备的能耗视角。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是把端侧 LLM 推理的控制目标从“尽可能快”改为“在满足 QoE 吞吐约束和温度约束下，选择更省电的 NPU/内存频率配置”。论文先系统测量不同 NPU 与 DDR 频率组合下的吞吐、功耗和能效，覆盖自构造的不同超参数 LLM、生产级 LLM、不同推理引擎和不同平台。关键观察是：decode 阶段高度受内存带宽限制，满频并不总是带来成比例的吞吐收益；同时，不同模型、引擎、平台之间没有稳定的配置排序，因此不能简单用固定 profile 或最低可用频率规则解决。论文还把热约束纳入调度问题，因为连续请求会让外壳温度持续上升，且响应长度和请求间隔难以预测。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的代表性结果显示，在文本润色类场景中，默认端侧推理功耗超过云端 offloading 所需功耗的 138%，主要额外功耗来自 NPU 和内存。通过降低 NPU 与内存频率，仍能维持 10 tokens/s 以上吞吐，同时 NPU+Mem 功耗下降 44%，tokens/J 能效提升 38%。实验覆盖手机、笔记本和开发板，并使用自构造 LLM 与生产级 LLM。论文强调一个重要负结果：不同模型和推理引擎下，配置能效排序不稳定，离线 profile 很难迁移到生产环境。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20 分钟。先看 Introduction 中关于 configuration slack、QoE 吞吐需求和三个挑战的定义；再看 §3 的 profiling 结果，重点关注吞吐-功耗曲线、不同频率组合的 Pareto 关系，以及“配置排序不稳定”的实验图。如果关注端侧 serving，再读后续系统设计和热控制部分；如果只关心预训练研究，可以把重点放在这些结果对模型尺寸、KV cache、解码长度和内存带宽敏感性的启发上。

summary_en.core_problem: On-device LLM inference is often optimized for maximum decoding speed, but many user-facing scenarios only require a modest throughput target. Running the NPU and memory at peak frequency wastes energy and increases thermal pressure without improving perceived quality.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for researchers working on deployable LLMs and small-model design. It shows that endpoint viability depends on hardware frequency control, memory bandwidth, thermal dynamics, and request patterns, not only on model size, quantization, or raw tokens per second.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work reframes on-device inference control as an energy-aware configuration problem: choose NPU and DDR frequency settings that satisfy QoE throughput constraints and thermal limits. It profiles throughput, power, and energy efficiency across NPU/memory frequency pairs, using synthetic LLMs with varied hyperparameters as well as production-grade models, multiple inference engines, and several device classes. A central observation is that autoregressive decoding is strongly memory-bandwidth-bound, so peak frequency can be inefficient. Another important finding is that configuration rankings are not stable across models, engines, or platforms, which makes fixed offline profiling and simple feedback rules unreliable.
summary_en.experiments: The reported example shows that default on-device inference in a text-polishing scenario consumes more than 138% of the power required by cloud offloading, with most of the excess attributed to NPU and memory. A lower NPU/memory frequency setting still keeps throughput above 10 tokens/s, reduces NPU plus memory power by 44%, and improves energy efficiency by 38% in tokens per joule. The evaluation spans a smartphone, a laptop, and a development board, with both self-engineered model variants and production-grade LLMs. The most useful empirical result is the lack of a stable energy-efficiency ordering among hardware configurations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is enough for most LLM researchers. Read the introduction for the QoE-driven framing, the configuration-slack observation, and the three system challenges. Then focus on Section 3 profiling results: throughput-power curves, Pareto trade-offs across frequency pairs, and evidence that frequency rankings do not generalize. Readers working on edge serving should continue into the controller and thermal-management sections. Readers focused on pretraining can mainly extract implications for model size, KV-cache behavior, decoding length, and memory-bandwidth sensitivity.

recommendation.zh: 端侧 serving 研究员应看配置搜索和热模型；pretrain 侧只需记住 latency-optimal 常不是 deployment-optimal。
recommendation.en: On-device serving people should read the config search and thermal model; for pretraining, just remember latency-optimal is often not deployment-optimal.

paper.title: Think Again or Think Longer? Selective Verification for Budget-Aware Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time reasoning is increasingly used as a serving-time control knob, but extra reasoning is not uniformly valuable: it can repair failed attempts, waste compute on already-correct answers, or introduce harmful answer changes. We study this as a deployment allocation problem rather than a new-verifier problem. We introduce \sevra, Selective Verification for Reasoning Allocation, a serving-layer controller that decides whether to preserve a frozen solver's initial answer or invoke active verif

summary.core_problem: 这项工作把“是否再推理一次”定义为服务层的资源分配问题：给定冻结求解器的一次初始作答，系统应判断接受答案，还是调用主动验证来修复潜在错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对推理模型的部署和训练目标设计有参考意义。它强调 test-time compute 不是简单增加 token 或调用次数，而要看一次干预能否修复当前样本，以及是否会把正确答案改错。这个视角对后训练中的 verifier、process reward、self-correction 数据构造也有启发：训练信号不应只奖励“多想”，还应区分 helpful fix 和 harmful flip。
summary.technical_approach: SeVRA 使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B reasoning model 先生成基础答案，再由一个轻量 gate 决定是否触发 active verification。active verification 不是普通续写，而是要求同一个冻结模型为候选答案构造至少两个针对性检查，例如重建方程、检查单位和边界、代回候选答案、走独立解法；只有检查失败时才修改答案。gate 的训练标签来自离线执行后的结果：一次验证是否把错误答案修好，或者是否把正确答案改错。部署时 gate 只能看到题目、初始解答和运行时可见特征，不能访问 gold answer。作者比较了三类 gate：基于 completion status、token count、finalizer use、估计难度、约束密度等廉价特征的 logistic gate；Qwen3-0.6B 4-bit QLoRA sequence classifier；Qwen3-1.7B 4-bit QLoRA sequence classifier。方法的关键不在 verifier 模型更强，而在把验证看成带收益和风险的选择性动作。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用冻结 Qwen3-4B。MATH500 上，SeVRA 达到 76.3% accuracy，高于 always verifying 的 75.5%，同时 post-generation tokens 减少 26.8%，并降低 harmful flips。GSM8K 的 frozen transfer 中，gate 只验证少量样本，相比 short-base solver 有提升，并且没有观察到 harmful flips。作者也做了预算匹配比较：接受初始答案、继续推理、主动验证、总是验证、增加初始 reasoning budget。一个重要结果是，在这些数学任务上，调大初始解题 budget 能达到相近 accuracy，而且 realized total model tokens 更少。因此 SeVRA 更适合需要显式验证、有限重试、答案修改审计的场景，而不是所有场景下的通用省算策略。CommonsenseQA 诊断显示动作选择具有任务依赖性：always-on verification 会伤害性能，self-consistency 只有在明显更高 token 成本下才有收益。廉价 feature gate 的表现接近 0.6B 和 1.7B QLoRA gate，在可接受小幅 accuracy gap 时更适合部署。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Problem Formulation 中 helpful fix、harmful flip、realized total model tokens 的定义；看 Method 中 active verification prompt 和 gate label 的构造；看实验部分的预算匹配表，而不只看 MATH500 accuracy。最值得关注的是它如何把“验证是否有用”从样本难度中拆出来，以及为什么必须和调大初始 token budget 做公平比较。Appendix A 的 intervention screening 和 Appendix B 的 prompt 也值得扫读，因为它们决定了 selective policy 的上限。

summary_en.core_problem: This work frames extra reasoning as a serving-time allocation problem: after a frozen solver produces an initial answer, the system must decide whether to accept it or spend another call on active verification.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding the interface between reasoning models, verifiers, and test-time compute. Its main lesson is that more reasoning is not uniformly beneficial. A second pass can repair failures, waste compute on already correct answers, or flip a correct answer into an incorrect one. This distinction is relevant for post-training data design as well: useful supervision should separate helpful fixes from harmful revisions, rather than simply rewarding longer traces or more self-correction attempts.
summary_en.technical_approach: SeVRA keeps the solver and intervention prompts frozen. A Qwen3-4B reasoning model first generates a base solution and answer. A lightweight gate then predicts whether active verification is likely to help, using only the problem, the base attempt, and serving-visible metadata such as completion status, token counts, finalizer use, estimated difficulty, verification need, and constraint density. Active verification asks the same frozen model to construct and execute at least two candidate-specific checks before changing the answer. These checks can reconstruct equations, test units and bounds, substitute the candidate answer, or solve through an independent route. The gate is trained offline with labels derived from intervention outcomes: whether verification repaired an incorrect answer or damaged a correct one. The paper compares a cheap logistic feature gate with Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B 4-bit QLoRA sequence-classifier gates.
summary_en.experiments: With a frozen Qwen3-4B solver, SeVRA reaches 76.3% accuracy on MATH500, compared with 75.5% for always verifying, while reducing post-generation tokens by 26.8% and lowering harmful flips. In frozen transfer to GSM8K, it verifies only a small fraction of examples, improves over the short-base solver, and reports no observed harmful flips. The budget-matched comparisons are the most important part: accepting the base answer, continuing, active verification, always verifying, and increasing the initial reasoning budget are all compared under realized token usage. On the tested math benchmarks, a longer initial solve reaches a similar accuracy region with fewer total realized model tokens. A CommonsenseQA diagnostic shows that the best action depends on the workload: always-on verification hurts, while self-consistency helps only at much higher token cost. The cheap feature gate nearly matches the larger QLoRA gates, making it the more practical option when the small accuracy gap is acceptable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation, especially the definitions of helpful fix, harmful flip, intervention rate, and realized total model tokens. Then read the method section for the active-verification prompt and the gate-label construction. In the experiments, prioritize the budget-matched tables over the headline accuracy numbers. Appendix A is useful for understanding why active verification was selected over continuation or critique-and-repair, and Appendix B is worth checking because the prompt defines the intervention being allocated.

recommendation.zh: test-time compute分配文章，结论很值得注意：加verifier门控不如直接把初始CoT拉长，做budgeted reasoning的人看§4与Table 3即可。
recommendation.en: A test-time compute allocation paper whose punchline is that gated verification underperforms simply lengthening the initial CoT; read §4 and Table 3 if you work on budgeted reasoning.

paper.title: Token-Operations-Oriented Inference Optimization Techniques for Large Models
paper.abstract: Large model inference optimization serves as a key foundation for supporting the scalable, low-cost, and highly stable operation of large model services. Centered on token-oriented inference optimization technology, this paper proposes for the first time a four-layer technical architecture consisting of Multi-model Fusion, Model Optimization, Compute-Model Fusion, and Compute-Network-Model Fusion. It systematically reviews the key technologies and current industry status across these four levels

summary.core_problem: 大模型推理优化技术缺乏统一的分层架构，难以系统指导工业场景下降本提效的落地实践。
summary.importance: 提出面向token操作的四层推理优化技术架构，系统梳理各层关键技术与行业落地现状，给出工业场景下的技术落地路径。
summary.technical_approach: 将现有推理优化技术划分为多模型融合、模型优化、计算-模型融合、计算-网络-模型融合四个层级，做系统性综述与业务场景价值分析。
summary.experiments: 综述性工作，无原创实验，结合真实业务场景分析各类技术的应用价值与落地效果。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM inference optimization lacks a unified layered technical architecture to systematically guide cost reduction and efficiency improvement in industrial deployment scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a token-oriented four-layer technical architecture for inference optimization, systematically reviewing key technologies and industry adoption status across layers to provide practical deployment guidance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organizes existing inference optimization techniques into four layers: multi-model fusion, model optimization, compute-model fusion, and compute-network-model fusion, then conducts a systematic review and business scenario value analysis.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey paper with no original experiments; it analyzes application value of technologies based on real-world business deployment cases.

recommendation.zh: 面向工业服务的推理优化四层分类框架，无原创研究结论，适合Serving工程团队参考，预训练研究员无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Industry-focused four-layer taxonomy of LLM inference optimizations with no novel research findings; useful for serving engineers, skip for pretraining work.

paper.title: Cost-Optimal LLM Routing with Limited User Feedback under User Satisfaction Guarantees
paper.abstract: Inference costs for large language model (LLM) applications are rapidly growing, driven by surging demand and rising infrastructure cost. Users expect high-quality responses, and in commercial settings this is formally codified in Service Level Agreements (SLAs), creating a fundamental tension between cost and quality. Recent progress on cost-aware LLM request routing has shown potential to resolve this tension, but existing approaches rely on complete feedback signals, offline training, extensi

summary.core_problem: 解决生产环境中多 LLM 路由的成本-质量权衡问题：只有稀疏、单侧用户反馈时，如何在线学习满足 SLA 的最低成本路由策略。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏系统与在线决策，而不是预训练本身；但它对推理服务层的模型选择、反馈稀疏下的策略学习、以及真实用户信号如何约束模型部署有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SLARouter，一种在线路由算法，在有限用户反馈下学习 cost-optimal policy，并同时给出成本最优与严格 SLA 合规的理论保证。方法重点在于把生产中的 one-sided sparse feedback 纳入在线决策，而不是依赖完整离线标注或按 benchmark 单独调参。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多种 LLM benchmark 上验证，无需按 benchmark 单独调参即可满足 SLA 约束并降低运行成本；但未给出涉及的模型集合、路由候选、成本降幅和质量约束的具体数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies cost-quality trade-offs in production LLM routing: how to learn an online routing policy that minimizes cost while satisfying SLAs under sparse one-sided user feedback.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a systems and online decision-making contribution rather than pretraining. Still, it is relevant for model serving, sparse-feedback learning, and how real user signals constrain deployment choices.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes SLARouter, an online routing algorithm that learns a cost-optimal policy from limited user feedback while providing theoretical guarantees for both cost optimality and strict SLA compliance. The key novelty is handling production-style one-sided sparse feedback without offline full supervision or per-benchmark tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports results across multiple LLM benchmarks, claiming SLA satisfaction without benchmark-specific tuning and reduced operating cost. It does not provide the routed model set, exact cost savings, or quality thresholds in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但如果你管线上游训练、下游 serving 一体化，这类稀疏反馈路由会反过来影响该训多大模型；读理论保证和成本曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you think train-serve jointly, sparse-feedback routing changes which model sizes are worth training; read the guarantees and cost curves, not the whole paper.

paper.title: JetFlow: Breaking the Scaling Ceiling of Speculative Decoding with Parallel Tree Drafting
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them in parallel, but it faces a scaling limitation: increasing the draft budget improves speed only when acceptance remains high and drafting overhead stays low. This ceiling has been difficult to break because prior head-based SD methods face a causality-efficiency dilemma. Autoregressive drafters produce path-conditioned candidates that are effective for tree speculative

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 speculative decoding 在大 draft budget 下的扩展瓶颈：草稿 token 增多时，如果接受率下降或草稿生成成本上升，端到端加速很快失效。
summary.importance: 这篇论文主要属于推理效率和 serving 优化，但对预训练研究也有间接价值。它把多 token 预测、tree speculative decoding 和因果条件建模放在同一个问题里处理。对基座训练而言，值得关注的是：如果未来在预训练或 mid-training 中加入多 token prediction head，不能只追求并行预测多个位置，还要保证不同候选分支之间满足自回归因果条件。否则模型可能生成单点上看合理、组合起来不一致的候选树，导致验证预算浪费。
summary.technical_approach: JetFlow 的核心是 causal parallel tree drafting。已有 head-based speculative decoding 面临一个取舍：EAGLE 这类自回归 drafter 能生成 path-conditioned 候选，质量较好，但树深增加时需要更多顺序 draft pass；DFlash 这类双向 block-diffusion drafter 可以一遍生成多个位置，但每个位置更像 branch-agnostic marginal，候选之间可能互不一致。JetFlow 训练一个因果并行 draft head，在一次 forward 中预测多个树节点，同时通过 block-level causal attention over hidden states 保留分支内的路径条件。这样每个分支的 draft distribution 更接近目标模型的自回归分解，tree verification 时更容易利用更大的 draft token budget。论文还设计了相应的 tree-drafting 算法，并把方法接入工业级 serving engine 做真实负载评测。
summary.experiments: 在低 draft budget 场景下，使用 16 个 draft tokens 时，JetFlow 达到有竞争力的端到端加速。更关键的是高 budget 场景：使用 256 个 draft tokens 时，在 MATH-500 上达到 τ=10.7，并取得约 9.5 倍端到端加速；在 MT-Bench 上仍保持 τ=5.9，并取得超过 4 倍加速。论文还在不同请求率下接入 serving engine 测试，结果显示在小到中等负载下相对基线更有优势，在 B200 这类高端 GPU 上收益更明显。这里的关键信号不是单个 benchmark 的数字，而是 draft budget 扩大后接受长度仍能增长，说明并行草稿的因果一致性确实改善了预算利用率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看 Section 2 或方法开头关于 speculative decoding 加速公式的推导，它清楚说明了接受率 α、draft cost c 和 draft length N 的约束关系。随后看 JetFlow 的 causal parallel draft head 和 block-level causal attention 设计，特别是它如何区别于 EAGLE 的顺序路径建模和 DFlash 的并行但分支无关建模。实验部分优先看 draft budget 从 16 扩到 256 时的曲线，以及 serving engine 中不同 request rate 和 GPU 类型下的吞吐/延迟结果。预计阅读 30 到 40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a scaling ceiling in speculative decoding. Increasing the draft budget only helps when the acceptance rate stays high and the drafting overhead remains small. Existing head-based methods struggle to satisfy both conditions at large tree sizes.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference and serving paper, but it has useful implications for pretraining and mid-training designs that add multi-token prediction heads. The main lesson is that parallel prediction is not enough. A useful draft tree must preserve causal consistency along each branch. Otherwise, the model may produce tokens that are individually plausible but mutually inconsistent, wasting verification capacity and limiting speedup.
summary_en.technical_approach: JetFlow introduces causal parallel tree drafting. Prior head-based speculative decoding methods face a tradeoff. Autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE generate path-conditioned candidates, which improves acceptance, but drafting cost grows with tree depth. Bidirectional block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate many positions in one pass, but their branch-agnostic marginals can form inconsistent candidate trees. JetFlow trains a causal prediction head that predicts multiple tree nodes in a single forward pass while using block-level causal attention over hidden states to preserve branch-wise conditioning. This makes each branch closer to the target model’s autoregressive factorization. The paper also develops tree-drafting algorithms around this head and integrates the method into an industry-grade serving engine.
summary_en.experiments: With a small draft budget of 16 tokens, JetFlow reports competitive end-to-end speedups. The more informative setting is the large-budget regime. With 256 draft tokens, JetFlow reaches τ=10.7 and about 9.5x end-to-end speedup on MATH-500. On MT-Bench, it still reaches τ=5.9 and more than 4x speedup. The serving experiments evaluate different request rates and show stronger gains under small to moderate loads, with particularly clear benefits on higher-end GPUs such as B200. The key result is that the accepted length continues to scale when the draft budget increases, suggesting that causal branch conditioning improves budget utilization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the derivation of the speculative decoding speed model first, especially the roles of acceptance rate α, draft cost c, and draft length N. Then focus on the causal parallel draft head and the block-level causal attention mechanism. The most useful comparison is against EAGLE-style sequential path-conditioned drafting and DFlash-style one-pass but branch-agnostic drafting. In the experiments, prioritize the curves that scale the draft budget from 16 to 256 and the serving-engine results across request rates and GPU types. Expected reading time is about 30 to 40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和 speed/budget 曲线；若接受率随树宽稳定，值得在服务栈复现，不影响预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the method and speed-vs-budget curves; if acceptance stays stable with tree width, it is worth reproducing in serving, not in pretraining.

paper.title: TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: As LLM agents are deployed in long-horizon sessions, context accumulation drives up inference costs. Existing approaches utilize text pruning or dynamic memory eviction to minimize token footprints; however, their unconstrained sequence mutations alter layouts, introducing prefix mismatches and cache invalidation. This reveals a critical trade-off between text sparsity and prompt cache continuity. To address this, we present TokenPilot, a dual-granularity context management framework. Globally,

summary.core_problem: 长会话Agent中，如何在减少上下文token成本的同时避免前缀变化导致的prompt cache失效。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧系统/策略：把“文本剪枝”与“KV/prefix cache连续性”这个工程矛盾显式化；对预训练启发有限，但对长上下文服务与agent部署很实用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双粒度上下文管理：全局的 Ingestion-Aware Compaction 在输入闸门处稳定前缀、过滤开放环境噪声；局部的 Lifecycle-Aware Eviction 跟踪片段剩余效用，用保守的批量turn调度在相关性过期后再卸载片段，以维持cache命中。
summary.experiments: 在 PinchBench 与 Claw-Eval 的 isolated/continuous 两种模式下评测；摘要声称成本降低约61%/56%（具体指标与质量损失未在摘要展开）。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon LLM agents, reduce context token cost without breaking prompt-cache continuity due to prefix mutations.
summary_en.importance: Inference-time systems contribution: makes the pruning vs cache-continuity trade-off explicit; limited pretraining impact but practical for long-context serving and agent deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-granularity context management: global Ingestion-Aware Compaction stabilizes prefixes and filters open-world noise; local Lifecycle-Aware Eviction tracks residual utility and evicts in conservative batch-turn schedules to preserve cache hits.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on PinchBench and Claw-Eval in isolated and continuous modes; claims ~61%/56% cost reduction (quality trade-offs not detailed in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 工程味很重：如果你在做长会话服务，只看它如何“稳定前缀以保cache”；对建模/预训练没新东西。
recommendation.en: Mostly systems engineering: read only for the prefix-stabilization idea to preserve caching; little to learn for modeling or pretraining.

Xi’an University of Electronic Science and Technology

paper.title: Budget-Constrained Step-Level Diffusion Caching
paper.abstract: Step-level caching accelerates diffusion models by exploiting temporal redundancy across denoising steps. Existing methods make per-step cache decisions using threshold-based heuristics, without directly optimizing for final output quality. As a result, their inference latency varies across inputs and is difficult to control at deployment. In this work, we propose BudCache, which inverts this formulation: rather than letting per-step error thresholds dictate the runtime cost, we fix the compute

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型推理的step-level caching如何在可控预算下最大化最终生成质量，而不是用启发式阈值导致时延不可控。
summary.importance: 推理侧效率工作：把“缓存决策”从局部阈值改成全局预算优化，对部署可控时延有现实价值；对预训练研究的直接影响有限但可作为生成模型serving参考。
summary.technical_approach: BudCache：先固定compute budget，再离线搜索最优的step选择/缓存策略以保最终输出；用Simulated Annealing + deterministic Hill Climbing解决组合搜索；在预算极紧时引入cache-aware schedule alignment，调整时间离散化以匹配被选中的step集合；在线推理不做搜索、不做阈值判断。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型/数据集/加速比-质量曲线等细节；仅描述“离线搜索分钟级完成、在线无额外开销”。

summary_en.core_problem: How to do step-level caching for diffusion inference under a fixed compute budget while preserving final sample quality, avoiding heuristic thresholds and unpredictable latency.
summary_en.importance: An inference-efficiency contribution: reframes caching as global budgeted optimization, useful for controllable deployment latency; only indirect relevance to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: BudCache fixes a compute budget and performs offline search for the cache/step-selection policy that best preserves final output; uses simulated annealing plus deterministic hill climbing; adds cache-aware schedule alignment by adapting time discretization to the selected steps; no online search/thresholding overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete model/dataset details and quality-vs-speed numbers; claims minute-level offline search and zero online overhead.

recommendation.zh: 把“阈值启发式”改成“预算约束下的全局策略搜索”这点值得借鉴；只需看方法段和质量-时延曲线，别指望预训练启示。
recommendation.en: Worth it for the reframing from threshold heuristics to budgeted global policy search; read the method + quality/latency curves, not for pretraining insights.

paper.title: Can I Buy Your KV Cache?
paper.abstract: Right now, across the world, AI agents are repeating the same absurd act: to read one document, they each recompute it from scratch. Every agent re-runs prefill, the most compute-intensive step a large model takes, over identical text, only to rebuild a key-value (KV) cache identical to the one the agent before it just built. The same answer, computed a million times. We make a proposal that is almost offensively simple: compute it once. Let a publisher precompute a document's KV cache, and let

summary.core_problem: 多个 agent 反复读取同一文档时会重复执行昂贵 prefill，论文探讨能否把文档 KV cache 预计算并复用。
summary.importance: 贡献更像系统设想和小规模验证：把 KV cache 从单次请求内部状态变成可交易、可复用的计算资产。它对 serving 和 agent 工作流有启发，但距离完整生产系统还需要处理模型版本、tokenizer、位置编码、精度、隐私和信任边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出由发布者为文档预计算 KV cache，后续 agent 购买或加载该 cache，从而跳过 prefill；作者强调在相同模型和相同 token 前缀下，加载 KV 后继续生成应与从头 prefill token-exact，并讨论 KV 放置和传输成本问题。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B 上验证预计算 KV 与从头 prefill 在 greedy 生成的 24/24 个 token 以及 logits 层面匹配；报告 KV 复用的计算成本比 prefill 低 9-50 倍，且上下文越长差距越大。摘要未显示大规模线上负载实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether agents repeatedly reading the same document can reuse a precomputed KV cache instead of paying the prefill cost each time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is closer to a systems proposal with a small empirical check: it treats KV cache as a reusable compute artifact rather than a per-request transient state. It is relevant to serving and agent workloads, but a production design still needs to solve model-versioning, tokenizer, positional encoding, precision, privacy, and trust-boundary issues.
summary_en.technical_approach: A publisher precomputes a document's KV cache, and downstream agents load that cache to skip prefill. Under the same model and token prefix, continuation from the loaded KV should be token-exact relative to recomputing prefill. The paper also discusses where the KV should live, since shipping large KV tensors can erase the benefit.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-4B, loading a precomputed KV matches full prefill for 24/24 greedy tokens and at the logits level. The reported compute cost of reuse is 9-50x lower than prefill, with larger gains for longer inputs. The abstract does not show large-scale serving experiments.

recommendation.zh: 想法朴素但命中 agent 负载痛点；看 token-exact 条件和成本模型即可，安全与版本问题先打问号。
recommendation.en: The idea is simple but hits a real agent-serving pain point; read the token-exact conditions and cost model, while treating security and versioning as open issues.

paper.title: External Experience Serving in Production LLM Systems: A Deployment-Oriented Study of Quality-Cost Trade-offs
paper.abstract: Production LLM systems accumulate reusable operational experience, but the practical deployment issue is not merely whether such experience can help. It is how different serving strategies trade off quality against online cost under realistic constraints. Injecting external experience can improve task quality, yet it also increases prompt burden, latency, and serving pressure. We study \textit{external experience serving} as a deployment-oriented quality-cost trade-off problem. We evaluate this

summary.core_problem: 研究生产 LLM 系统中如何注入可复用外部经验，并在质量、prompt 成本、延迟和 serving 压力之间做取舍。
summary.importance: 贡献是部署侧系统分析，而不是新模型训练方法。它把 external experience serving 明确建模为质量-成本问题，对 RAG/memory 类系统的上线策略有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较无经验基线、随机经验控制、全局 prompt 注入和检索式选择注入。核心变量是经验是否按 case 依赖选择，以及注入带来的输出质量收益能否覆盖 prompt burden 和在线成本。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在真实生产内容审核场景中进行，并用 tool-use 和 GPQA 作为不同输出成本 regime 的对照任务。摘要结论是：当经验具有 case-dependence 时，选择性检索注入比无条件全局注入有更好的质量-成本工作点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how production LLM systems should serve reusable external experience while trading off quality, prompt cost, latency, and serving pressure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a deployment-oriented systems analysis rather than a training method. It frames external experience serving as a quality-cost optimization problem, which is relevant to RAG and memory-style production systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: It compares no-experience baselines, random experience controls, global prompt injection, and retrieval-based selective injection. The central variable is whether experience should be injected unconditionally or selected per case.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation uses a real production moderation setting, with tool-use and GPQA as contrast tasks for different output-cost regimes. The abstract reports that selective retrieval gives a better operating point than unconditional global injection when experience is case-dependent.

recommendation.zh: 读部署 trade-off 图就够了；它验证 selective memory 的成本直觉，不改变预训练侧 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the deployment trade-off curves only; it validates the selective-memory cost intuition without changing pretraining priors.

paper.title: INFRAMIND: Infrastructure-Aware Multi-Agent Orchestration
paper.abstract: Existing multi-agent LLM orchestration methods, ranging from brute-force ensembles to learned routers, select models and topologies based on task and model features. However, these methods do not consider the runtime state of the serving infrastructure. On shared GPU clusters under concurrent load, this infrastructure blindness causes systematic resource underutilization: preferred models accumulate deep request queues while equally capable alternatives sit idle. In multi-agent pipelines, where

summary.core_problem: 多 agent LLM 编排通常只看任务和模型能力，不看服务基础设施的实时状态，导致共享 GPU 集群下延迟和资源利用率恶化。
summary.importance: 贡献偏系统侧，讨论的是 agent 编排与 serving 状态的耦合，而不是模型训练本身；对做大规模推理服务和在线评测的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 INFRAMIND，把基础设施信号纳入整个多 agent 栈：规划器在拓扑和角色选择时感知 infra 状态，路由器在每一步根据队列、KV-cache 压力和延迟做模型选择，调度器再联合优化执行顺序。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点是在共享 GPU、并发负载和多步 agent pipeline 场景下比较 infra-aware 与 task-only orchestration 的吞吐和延迟；未见与预训练或模型能力提升直接相关的实验。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent LLM orchestration ignores live serving-state signals, causing poor utilization and compounded latency on shared GPU clusters.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems contribution around agent orchestration and serving awareness rather than model training, but it is relevant to large-scale inference operations.
summary_en.technical_approach: INFRAMIND injects infrastructure signals into the full multi-agent stack: an infra-aware planner chooses topology and roles, a per-step router uses queue depth, KV-cache pressure, and latency signals, and a scheduler coordinates execution accordingly.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the abstract, the evaluation focuses on throughput and latency under concurrent shared-cluster settings for multi-step agent pipelines, not on pretraining or model-quality gains.

recommendation.zh: 更像 serving-aware agent orchestration，不是 pretrain 论文；若你管线上线或大规模评测，只看系统图和延迟分解就够了。
recommendation.en: This is serving-aware agent orchestration, not a pretraining paper; read it only if you care about deployment or large-scale eval latency breakdowns.

paper.title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) re-encode the entire prefix at every denoising step, causing recomputation that scales   quadratically with context length and becomes prohibitive for long-context scenarios. We propose Prefilling-dLLM, a training-free   prefill-decode disaggregation framework for dLLMs that partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches their KV representations once,   and selects the top-K most relevant chunks with intra-chunk token sparsity for decoding, showing that spars

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion language model 在长上下文推理时每个去噪步都要重编码整段前缀、导致计算随上下文长度急剧膨胀的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇对 dLLM 很相关，因为它抓住了 diffusion LM 与 AR LM 在推理路径上的核心差异：dLLM 没有天然的 KV-cache 复用。贡献类型是训练无关的推理系统/算法改进，不改模型本体，但直接影响 dLLM 是否能进入长上下文可用区间。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prefilling-dLLM，一个 training-free 的 prefill-decode disaggregation 框架。方法把前缀切成 N 个 chunk，只缓存一次各 chunk 的 KV 表示；解码时只选 top-K 相关 chunk，并在 chunk 内再做 token sparsity，从而把每步复杂度从依赖完整上下文的二次复杂度，降到主要依赖 decode length 的复杂度。另一个关键点是为非连续缓存 chunk KV 设计并行 attention kernel。作者还观察到给每个 chunk prepend BOS token 有助于稳定检索和质量。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 和 InfiniteBench 上评测，摘要称在 dLLM 加速方法中达到当前最优质量，并在 8K 到 32K 上下文下获得 9.1x 到 28.0x 的速度提升。机构包含港大、密歇根和 LMSYS，说明工作更偏系统与评测结合。摘要未给出具体 dLLM 基座、参数规模和与 dense baseline 的精确质量差距，但从问题设定看是 dLLM 长上下文推理里较实用的一步。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括香港大学、密歇根大学安娜堡分校和 LMSYS。LMSYS 在推理系统、评测和开源 serving 生态上有持续影响力。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the long-context inference bottleneck in diffusion LMs, where the full prefix is re-encoded at every denoising step and cost explodes with context length.
summary_en.importance: This is quite relevant for dLLMs because it targets a core inference-path weakness relative to autoregressive LMs: dLLMs do not naturally inherit efficient KV-cache reuse. The contribution is a training-free inference/system method rather than a new model, but it directly affects whether dLLMs are practical in long-context settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prefilling-dLLM is a training-free prefill-decode disaggregation framework. It partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches each chunk's KV once, then selects top-K relevant chunks during decoding and applies intra-chunk token sparsity. This reduces per-step complexity from being quadratic in the full context to being quadratic mainly in the decode length. The paper also introduces an attention kernel that can decode over non-contiguously cached chunk KVs in parallel. An additional empirical trick is prepending BOS tokens to each chunk to stabilize retrieval and quality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on LongBench and InfiniteBench, reporting state-of-the-art quality among dLLM acceleration methods and 9.1x-28.0x speedups at 8K-32K contexts. The institutions include HKU, University of Michigan, and LMSYS, suggesting a systems-oriented effort. The abstract does not specify the exact dLLM backbone, parameter scale, or dense-baseline quality deltas, but the setup is clearly relevant to practical long-context dLLM serving.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include The University of Hong Kong, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, and LMSYS. LMSYS has a strong track record in inference systems, evaluation, and open serving infrastructure.

recommendation.zh: 做 dLLM 的人该看，尤其是 sparse prefilling 竟能赢 dense attention 这一点；先盯复杂度分析、chunk 检索策略和 BOS trick，别急着把结论外推到所有生成范式。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about dLLMs: the interesting part is that sparse prefilling can beat dense attention; focus on the complexity argument, chunk retrieval, and the BOS trick before generalizing the result.

paper.title: RKSC: Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing and Confident Early Exit for Multi-Step LLM Inference
paper.abstract: We introduce RKSC (Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing), a training-free inference framework that eliminates two structural redundancies in multi-branch LLM reasoning pipelines. ASKS (Attention-Similarity KV Sharing) computes the prefix KV cache once and broadcasts it to all semantically similar branches via hidden-state cosine similarity, strictly generalising the token-exact prefix caching used by vLLM and SGLang. CGEE (Confidence-Gated Early Exit) applies two complementary exit mechanisms: (1) i

summary.core_problem: 多分支、多步推理流水线中，LLM 会在相似分支上重复构建 KV cache，并在 verification 阶段做大量冗余前向计算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统优化。它不是改预训练或模型结构，而是针对 reasoning-time compute 的结构性浪费提出训练无关的缓存共享和早退机制，对理解 test-time scaling 的系统成本有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RKSC 包含三部分：ASKS 用 hidden-state cosine similarity 判断语义相似前缀，把一次计算得到的 prefix KV cache 广播给相似分支，扩展了 vLLM/SGLang 的 token-exact prefix caching；CGEE 用分支生成置信度跳过 verification forward，或在中间层 entropy 稳定时提前停止；RSBCM 用 attention-weighted depth-priority eviction 控制 cache 增长。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 5 个 7B-10B 模型家族、4 个 benchmark、1000 道问题上评估，并声称取得平均加速；给定摘要被截断，无法确认具体加速幅度、精度损失和 baseline 设置是否完整。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-branch reasoning pipelines repeatedly build KV caches for similar branches and spend redundant compute in verification passes.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution rather than a pretraining or architecture paper. It is useful mainly as a signal about where reasoning-time compute is wasted in practical test-time scaling pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: RKSC has three components: ASKS shares prefix KV caches across semantically similar branches using hidden-state cosine similarity, generalizing token-exact prefix caching in vLLM/SGLang; CGEE skips verification when branch confidence is decisive or exits at an intermediate layer when per-layer entropy stabilizes; RSBCM bounds cache growth with attention-weighted depth-priority eviction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments across five 7B-10B model families, four benchmarks, and 1,000 problems, with a claimed mean speedup. The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact speedup, accuracy tradeoff, and baseline details cannot be verified here.

recommendation.zh: 只看缓存共享判据和早退阈值；setup 若没有严格质量损失分析，结论只能当 serving trick。
recommendation.en: Read only the cache-sharing criterion and exit thresholds; without a clean quality-loss analysis, treat it as a serving trick.

paper.title: From Rigid to Dynamic: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Inference for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: Existing sparse attention and KV cache compression methods for long-context LLM inference typically apply fixed sparsity patterns or uniform budgets across all attention heads, overlooking the substantial variation in attention behavior among heads and contexts. We observe two distinct entropy patterns among attention heads: Rigid Heads, whose entropy stays near zero across input segments, and Dynamic Heads, whose entropy fluctuates significantly. Crucially, the distribution of these types is co

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 LLM 推理中，固定稀疏注意力模式和统一 KV cache 预算没有利用不同 attention head、不同上下文片段之间的行为差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法创新。它把注意力熵作为在线信号，用来区分更稳定的 head 和更依赖上下文的 head，对长上下文 prefill 与 decode 阶段分别做自适应计算分配和 KV 保留。这类工作不直接改预训练，但会影响长上下文训练目标与推理时真实瓶颈的判断。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EntropyInfer，一个 training-free 框架。prefill 阶段按 head 和 segment 粒度计算 attention entropy，把低熵、行为稳定的 Rigid Heads 与熵波动明显的 Dynamic Heads 区分开，并动态分配计算预算。decode 阶段提出 latent KV cache compression，不只依赖 prefill token 的重要性，还利用已生成输出 token 来识别更关键的 cache entries。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 Llama、Qwen 和 openPangu 系列模型上做了实验，覆盖长上下文推理场景。具体数据集、上下文长度、压缩率、延迟收益和精度损失未在摘要中给出，需要看正文表格确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LLM inference often uses fixed sparse attention patterns or uniform KV-cache budgets, ignoring large head-level and context-dependent variation in attention behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It uses attention entropy as an online signal to allocate compute and cache budget per head and segment. It does not change pretraining directly, but it gives useful evidence about which long-context attention behaviors actually matter at serving time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes EntropyInfer, a training-free framework. During prefilling, it measures attention entropy at the head and segment level, separating low-entropy Rigid Heads from high-variance Dynamic Heads and allocating compute adaptively. During decoding, it introduces latent KV-cache compression that uses generated output tokens, not only prefill tokens, to decide which cache entries to retain.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on Llama, Qwen, and openPangu model families in long-context settings. The exact datasets, context lengths, compression ratios, latency gains, and accuracy tradeoffs are not visible from the abstract and need to be checked in the main tables.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵分组和 decode cache 部分；若 Table 里精度-压缩曲线干净，可作为长上下文 serving ablation 候选。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy grouping and decode-cache sections; if the accuracy-compression curves are clean, this is worth reproducing as a long-context serving ablation.

paper.title: Enabling KV Caching of Shared Prefix for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching for shared prefixes is essential for high-throughput large language model (LLM) serving, but it faces critical challenges in emerging diffusion language models (DLMs). In DLMs, bidirectional attention means that updating any token dynamically alters the entire context and its corresponding KVs. Thus, existing caching techniques developed for LLMs, which assume that KVs remain invariant once computed, corrupt the shared prefix KVs. Our experiments show that applying these t

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散语言模型在共享前缀场景下无法直接复用 KV cache 的问题；双向注意力会让任意 token 更新污染整段上下文的 KV，导致现有 LLM 缓存方法在 DLM 上几乎失效。
summary.importance: 这是面向新型语言建模范式的 serving 基础设施问题。贡献类型主要是推理系统方法：把 AR LLM 中成熟的 shared-prefix caching 迁移到 DLM 时，先明确指出“直接套用会精度崩塌”，再给出可工作的缓存策略。对判断 DLM 是否具备实际部署前景有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 bidirectional prefix caching（bicache）。核心观察是：共享前缀对应的 KV 在浅层相对稳定、可复用，而深层会因双向上下文更新而失真；可复用的浅层深度又取决于请求中 shared prefix token 的占比。基于此，方法动态识别一个安全的浅层边界，只缓存并复用这些层的前缀 KV，避免深层缓存带来的语义污染。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模，但实验结论很明确：把现有 LLM 的 shared-prefix caching 直接用于 DLM，会让准确率接近 0；bicache 在保持精度的同时提升吞吐。论文的关键实验应包括：不同共享前缀比例下的安全缓存深度分析、与无缓存/错误缓存/静态层数缓存的对比，以及吞吐-精度权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles shared-prefix KV caching for diffusion language models, where bidirectional attention makes any token update alter the whole context and invalidates standard LLM caching assumptions.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-enablement problem for an alternative LM paradigm. The contribution is mainly systems-oriented: it shows that naively reusing AR-LM prefix caching in DLMs can collapse accuracy, then provides a workable caching scheme. That matters if one wants DLMs to be deployable rather than just trainable.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes bidirectional prefix caching (bicache). The key observation is that shared-prefix KVs remain relatively stable and reusable in shallow layers, while deeper layers become corrupted by bidirectional context updates; the safe shallow depth depends on the fraction of shared-prefix tokens in each request. Bicache dynamically selects this safe boundary and only reuses prefix KVs there.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full model scales, but the main empirical result is clear: applying existing LLM shared-prefix caching to DLMs drives accuracy close to zero, whereas bicache preserves accuracy while improving throughput. The important experiments likely analyze safe cache depth vs. shared-prefix ratio and compare against no-cache, naive cache, and static-depth baselines.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 DLM，不要只盯训练目标；这篇把“能不能像 AR 一样高吞吐部署”这个硬约束讲清了，先看失败案例和层深稳定性分析。
recommendation.en: If you care about DLMs, do not stop at the objective; this paper makes the serving constraint concrete, and the failure case plus layerwise stability analysis are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: AgentCompile: An LLM-Guided Compiler for Direct CUDA Inference
paper.abstract: Transformer inference increasingly depends on specialized compiler and runtime support, but real model graphs still require semantic decisions about which regions are worth specializing and which CUDA implementation families are plausible. We present AgentCompile, an LLM-guided CUDA inference compiler that uses LLM outputs only as advisory search metadata. Given compiler-derived region summaries and bounded candidate spaces, the LLM proposes semantic labels, candidate priorities, parameter hints

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：真实 Transformer 推理图的 CUDA 专用化需要大量语义判断与实现搜索，传统编译器难以高效决定“哪些子图值得特化、该尝试哪类 kernel 实现”。
summary.importance: 它的重要性在于把 LLM 作为编译搜索的 advisory signal，而不是直接生成不受约束代码，属于推理系统与编译器方向的工程方法创新。对基座研究员的价值主要在 serving 侧：更快的推理编译链会反过来影响架构选择、算子设计和训练后部署约束。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 AgentCompile，一个 LLM-guided CUDA inference compiler。LLM 只接收编译器生成的 region summaries 和受限候选空间，输出语义标签、候选优先级、参数提示与风险标注；真正的 CUDA 候选由模板系统实例化，再由编译器检查接口与硬件约束、做经验验证、按实测延迟选优，并在不适合特化时回退。核心设计是把 LLM 放在“搜索元数据建议层”，而不是代码生成执行层，以控制正确性与风险。
summary.experiments: 实验在端到端自回归生成场景上评估，模型包括 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct，覆盖五类代表性 workload。相对 PyTorch eager，平均加速分别为 5.66x、4.05x 和 4.26x。摘要未给出与 TensorRT-LLM、vLLM 或 TVM/Triton 类系统的直接对比，因此当前更适合把它看作“LLM 参与编译搜索”的 proof-of-concept，而非已定型的通用最优编译栈。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical compiler problem: real Transformer inference graphs require semantic decisions about which regions are worth specializing and which CUDA implementation families should be explored.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is to use an LLM as an advisory signal inside the compiler search loop, rather than as an unconstrained code generator. For foundation-model researchers, the relevance is mostly on the serving side: better inference compilation can feed back into architecture choices, operator design, and deployment-aware training constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose AgentCompile, an LLM-guided CUDA inference compiler. The LLM only sees compiler-derived region summaries and bounded candidate spaces, and returns semantic labels, candidate priorities, parameter hints, and risk annotations. Actual CUDA candidates are instantiated from templates, then checked for interface and hardware constraints, empirically validated, selected by measured latency, and safely fallen back when specialization is unsupported or not worthwhile. The key design is to keep the LLM at the metadata/scheduling layer, not the executable code layer.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is on end-to-end autoregressive generation with Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct across five representative workloads. Reported average speedups over PyTorch eager are 5.66x, 4.05x, and 4.26x, respectively. The abstract does not mention direct comparisons against stronger inference stacks such as TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, TVM, or Triton-based systems, so this is best read as a proof of concept for LLM-assisted compiler search rather than a settled production compiler result.

recommendation.zh: 思路比结果更值得看：把 LLM 限定在编译搜索元数据层是个干净设计，能学到如何让模型参与系统决策而不碰 correctness；只看方法图和 baseline 设定即可。
recommendation.en: The idea matters more than the headline speedups: constraining the LLM to compiler-search metadata is a clean design that lets models help systems without touching correctness; read the method diagram and baseline setup first.

paper.title: QCFuse: Query-Aware Cache Fusion via Compressed View for Efficient RAG Serving
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language model (LLM) answer quality by grounding generation in external evidence, but processing retrieved contexts makes the prefill stage a dominant serving cost. RAG cache fusion reduces this cost by reusing precomputed key-value (KV) caches for retrieved chunks and selectively recomputing tokens under the current prompt. Existing selectors, however, face a dilemma between quality and efficiency: fast query-agnostic or final-layer query-to-c

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG场景下的KV缓存融合方案在选择需要重计算的token时面临质量和效率的两难：查询无关的选择器或仅用最后一层注意力的选择器会丢失关键上下文，全视角的查询感知选择器需要提前加载所有层的KV缓存，打断分层流水线并行，大幅增加延迟。
summary.importance: 优化了RAG服务的预填充阶段效率，对大模型推理部署的成本降低有实际工程价值，也为缓存复用与查询感知的结合提供了新的轻量化思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出QCFuse压缩视角查询感知选择器，从两个维度压缩选择器的计算开销：1）离线阶段为每个RAG语块选择代表性锚点token，在线阶段仅用锚点集合计算查询与语块的相关性，无需遍历全部上下文token；2）离线阶段识别出查询-上下文注意力最能定位相关token的关键层，在线阶段仅扫描这些关键层的注意力信号，无需遍历所有层；整体方案兼容分层缓存融合流水线，不打断并行流程。
summary.experiments: 在多款开源LLM和数据集上测试，相同生成质量下，QCFuse的预填充阶段速度比完全预计算平均快1.7倍，比最强的保质量基线ProphetKV平均快1.5倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言部分了解缓存融合的现有瓶颈，第3章重点看锚点探测和关键层 profiling 的核心设计，实验部分看端到端延迟和质量对比即可，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache fusion schemes for RAG scenarios face a quality-efficiency dilemma when selecting tokens for recomputation: query-agnostic selectors or selectors only using last-layer attention miss critical context, while full-view query-aware selectors require preloading KV caches of all layers, breaking layer-wise pipeline parallelism and significantly increasing latency.
summary_en.importance: QCFuse optimizes prefill stage efficiency for RAG serving, delivering practical engineering value for reducing LLM inference deployment costs, and provides a new lightweight approach for combining cache reuse with query awareness.
summary_en.technical_approach: QCFuse is a compressed-view query-aware selector that reduces computation overhead from two dimensions: 1) Offline stage selects representative anchor tokens for each RAG chunk; during online serving, query-chunk relevance is computed only over anchor sets, eliminating the need to traverse all context tokens. 2) Offline stage identifies critical layers where query-to-context attention best localizes relevant tokens; during online serving, the selector only scans attention signals from these critical layers, avoiding full layer traversal. The entire scheme is compatible with layer-wise cache fusion pipelines and does not interrupt parallel processing.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple open-source LLMs and datasets, at matched generation quality, QCFuse achieves an average 1.7× prefill speedup over full prefill, and 1.5× average speedup over ProphetKV, the strongest quality-preserving baseline.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction to understand existing bottlenecks of cache fusion, focus on the core designs of anchor probing and critical layer profiling in Section 3, and review end-to-end latency and quality comparisons in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 setup 很实；做长上下文 serving 的只看 compressed view selector 和 critical-layer profiling 两个点就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the setup looks practical; if you care about long-context serving, just read the compressed-view selector and critical-layer profiling pieces.

paper.title: Entropy Gate: Entropy Quenching for Near-Lossless Token Compression in LLM Pipelines
paper.abstract: LLM pipelines waste substantial token budgets on low-information content: repeated context, verbose responses, and redundant boilerplate. We introduce Entropy Gate, a token compression framework applying entropy quenching $-$ a thermodynamic process that progressively freezes out low-energy tokens while preserving semantic fidelity. Each token receives a multi-factor information energy $E(t)$ combining statistical, structural, and positional components. An adaptive quenching schedule $T(τ) = T_0

summary.core_problem: 在不明显损伤语义的前提下压缩 LLM pipeline 中冗余 token，降低上下文和响应的 token 成本。
summary.importance: 这是推理侧 token compression 工作。问题本身对 serving 和长上下文成本有现实意义，但从摘要看包装术语较多，真正的新机制和与现有 summarization/pruning 方法的差异还需要谨慎核查。
